title: Let's Learn English · Level 2
zh: 安娜和皮特搭档主持节目：职场、旅行、生活中的 30 个情景，机器人教授讲语法。接在第一级后面学。
credit: 听力内容来自 VOA Learning English《Let's Learn English – Level 2》，公共领域，learningenglish.voanews.com

lessons.title: Budget Cuts
lessons.zh: 预算削减：公司里的传言

lines.en: Hum. Oh! "Important meeting. Everyone must come." Well, back to work! And my boss has called a meeting. I wonder what it's about. Maybe we're all getting raises! Ooo, there's Jonathan! Maybe he knows.
lines.zh: 嗯。哦！“重要会议，所有人必须参加。”好吧，回去上班了！我的上司召集开会。我想知道是关于什么的。也许我们都要涨工资了！哦，乔纳森在那儿！也许他知道。

lines.en: Hi! I'm Professor Bot! This video is all about work. People talk about jobs and things that happen at work. Your assignment is to find as many work words as you can. Don't worry, I'll help.
lines.zh: 嗨！我是机器人教授！这个视频讲的是工作。人们会聊到职业和工作中发生的事。你的任务是找出尽可能多的工作相关词汇。别担心，我会帮你。

lines.en: So, Jonathan, what do you think today's meeting is about? The email sounded important.
lines.zh: 那么，乔纳森，你觉得今天的会是关于什么的？邮件听起来很重要。

lines.en: Well, I have heard people in the building talking about budget cuts.
lines.zh: 嗯，我听楼里的人在说预算削减。

lines.en: Oh! Budget cuts? Wait, who has been talking about budget cuts?
lines.zh: 哦！预算削减？等等，谁一直在说预算削减？

lines.en: Mark in Accounting.
lines.zh: 会计部的马克。

lines.en: Mark in Accounting? That's one person. That's not "people."
lines.zh: 会计部的马克？那只是一个人，不是“人们”。

lines.en: I know, but Mark knows everything that goes on at The Studio.
lines.zh: 我知道，可马克对工作室里发生的事无所不知。

lines.en: That is true. But wait, look at us. We shouldn't gossip. That's how rumors start. We'll just go to the meeting and see what happens.
lines.zh: 那倒是。不过等等，看看我们。我们不该说闲话，谣言就是这么开始的。我们就去开会，看看会发生什么。

lines.en: You're right. No more talk about budget cuts.
lines.zh: 你说得对。不再说预算削减的事了。

lines.en: Budget cuts? Oh no!
lines.zh: 预算削减？哦不！

lines.en: I just heard Anna and Jonathan talking about budget cuts.
lines.zh: 我刚听到安娜和乔纳森在说预算削减。

lines.en: That must be what the meeting is about. When there are budget cuts, people lose their jobs.
lines.zh: 那会议一定就是关于这个的。一有预算削减，就有人丢工作。

lines.en: Not you. You're a good reporter.
lines.zh: 不会是你。你是个好记者。

lines.en: And it's not you. You've done a great job as a videographer.
lines.zh: 也不会是你。你当摄像师干得很棒。

lines.en: I can't go back to being a detective. Criminals scare me!
lines.zh: 我可不能回去当侦探，罪犯让我害怕！

lines.en: And I can't go back to being a teacher! High school kids scare me!
lines.zh: 我也不能回去当老师！高中生让我害怕！

lines.en: Did you hear any work words? They talked about a lot of jobs. You can make the name of a job by adding an ending to a verb! Kaveh reports, so, he's a reporter. Amelia used to detect, so she was a detective. If you teach, you're a teacher. And a videographer….uh, I think you understand. Back to the story.
lines.zh: 你听到工作相关的词了吗？他们聊到了很多职业。在动词后面加个词尾就能变成职业名称！卡维报道，所以他是记者（reporter）。阿米莉亚以前侦查，所以她是侦探（detective）。如果你教书，你就是老师（teacher）。至于摄像师……呃，我想你明白了。回到故事。

lines.en: Penelope, have you heard the news? Today's meeting is about budget cuts.
lines.zh: 佩内洛普，你听说了吗？今天的会是关于预算削减的。

lines.en: That's awful! What should I do?
lines.zh: 太可怕了！我该怎么办？

lines.en: Update your résumé. I've already updated mine. I'll see you at the meeting.
lines.zh: 更新你的简历。我已经更新了我的。会上见。

lines.en: Hello everyone! Quiet, please. Quiet, please!
lines.zh: 大家好！请安静，请安静！

lines.en: This meeting won't take long. Then you can all leave.
lines.zh: 会不会开很久，开完你们就可以走了。

lines.en: What is wrong with everyone? You look like I'm going to fire you. Ha-ha-ha-ha-ha! Seriously, what is wrong with everyone?
lines.zh: 大家怎么了？看起来好像我要开除你们似的。哈哈哈哈哈！说真的，大家怎么了？

lines.en: Excuse me, Ms. Weaver?
lines.zh: 打扰一下，韦弗女士？

lines.en: Yes, Anna.
lines.zh: 什么事，安娜。

lines.en: Well, everyone has been worrying about, you know … We've been worrying that you are going to fire us!
lines.zh: 嗯，大家一直在担心，您知道的……我们一直担心您要开除我们！

lines.en: I'm not going to fire any of you! No! The reason for this meeting is to tell you what a good job you've been doing and give out new assignments. Budget cuts have been happening. But only one person has lost their job -- Mark in Accounting? Now, let's talk about those new assignments.
lines.zh: 我谁都不会开除！不会！开这个会是要告诉大家你们一直干得很好，并且分配新任务。预算削减确实一直在进行，但只有一个人丢了工作——会计部的马克？好，我们来说说新任务吧。

lines.en: Ms. Weaver's team is doing a good job! How did you do? Did you find all of the work words? Here's a list you can check.
lines.zh: 韦弗女士的团队干得不错！你呢？你找到所有工作相关的词了吗？这是一份词表，你可以对照一下。

qs.q: What does Anna think the meeting is about at first?
qs.why: "Maybe we're all getting raises!"

qs.q: Who has been talking about budget cuts?
qs.why: "Mark in Accounting."

qs.q: Who lost their job?
qs.why: "only one person has lost their job -- Mark in Accounting"

lessons.title: The Interview
lessons.zh: 面试：给安娜找个“不一样”的搭档

lines.en: Ms. Weaver is giving new assignments out. I am ready to take on anything she gives me. Well, except reporting traffic from a helicopter. Wish me luck.
lines.zh: 韦弗女士在分配新任务。她给我什么我都准备接下来。嗯，除了坐直升机报道路况。祝我好运吧。

lines.en: I wonder what Anna's new assignment will be? Professor Bot here! While you are watching, look for phrasal, or two-word verbs. Some stay together, like "go back" and some can come apart, like "give [assignments] out." Good luck, Anna!
lines.zh: 我好奇安娜的新任务会是什么？我是机器人教授！看视频时，注意找短语动词，也就是两个词组成的动词。有些总在一起，比如“go back”；有些可以拆开，比如“give [assignments] out”。祝你好运，安娜！

lines.en: So, as I said at the meeting last week, I have new assignments for everyone at The Studio. Anna, you're good at asking questions. So, I want you to go back to hosting and reporting.
lines.zh: 就像我上周在会上说的，我给工作室的每个人都安排了新任务。安娜，你擅长提问，所以我希望你回去做主持和报道。

lines.en: That sounds great.
lines.zh: 听起来很棒。

lines.en: You're also a team player. So, I want you team up with someone ...
lines.zh: 你也很有团队精神，所以我希望你和某个人搭档……

lines.en: That sounds even better!
lines.zh: 那听起来更棒了！

lines.en: ... someone who is very "different" from you.
lines.zh: ……一个和你很“不一样”的人。

lines.en: That sounds ... what do you mean "different"?
lines.zh: 那听起来……您说的“不一样”是什么意思？

lines.en: Well, you are very cheerful, you're a people person. I want you to team up with someone who ... isn't.
lines.zh: 嗯，你非常开朗，很会和人打交道。我希望你和一个……不是这样的人搭档。

lines.en: Ms. Weaver, I will find that person.
lines.zh: 韦弗女士，我会找到那个人的。

lines.en: Excuse me. Are you using this chair?
lines.zh: 打扰一下，这把椅子有人坐吗？

lines.en: Yes.
lines.zh: 有。

lines.en: Pete, hi! Thanks for meeting me.
lines.zh: 皮特，嗨！谢谢你来见我。

lines.en: Sure. But I don't have lots of time, Anna. I'm busy looking for work.
lines.zh: 没事。不过我时间不多，安娜。我正忙着找工作呢。

lines.en: Pete, you can tear these want ads up and throw them away! I have good news!
lines.zh: 皮特，你可以把这些招聘广告撕了扔掉！我有好消息！

lines.en: Anna, I was working on that crossword puzzle.
lines.zh: 安娜，我刚才在做那个填字游戏。

lines.en: Oh. Sorry. Sorry. Pete, forget about the crossword puzzle. I have a job offer for you!
lines.zh: 哦，抱歉，抱歉。皮特，别管填字游戏了。我有个工作机会给你！

lines.en: I'm listening.
lines.zh: 你说，我听着。

lines.en: My boss wants me to team up with someone to host a talk show. But the person must be different from me. So, I thought of you.
lines.zh: 我上司希望我和一个人搭档主持一档访谈节目。但那人必须和我不一样，所以我想到了你。

lines.en: Different from you? What do you mean?
lines.zh: 和你不一样？什么意思？

lines.en: I'm sorry, Pete, I don't have time right now. Here's my boss's address. Your interview is tomorrow morning at 10 am.
lines.zh: 抱歉，皮特，我现在没时间。这是我上司的地址，你的面试在明天上午 10 点。

lines.en: But what do you mean "different"?
lines.zh: 可你说的“不一样”到底是什么意思？

lines.en: Just be yourself, Pete. Just be yourself.
lines.zh: 做你自己就好，皮特。做你自己就好。

lines.en: Did you find any two-word verbs? Here's one example. Pete can throw the want ads away! Throw away is a two-word verb.
lines.zh: 你找到两个词组成的动词了吗？举个例子：皮特可以把招聘广告扔掉（throw away）！throw away 就是一个短语动词。

lines.en: Thanks for coming in, Pete.
lines.zh: 谢谢你过来，皮特。

lines.en: Thanks for the opportunity, Ms. Weaver.
lines.zh: 谢谢您给我这个机会，韦弗女士。

lines.en: I need to find out if you have the skills for this job. And I want you to be completely honest.
lines.zh: 我需要弄清楚你有没有做这份工作的能力。我希望你完全诚实。

lines.en: Okay.
lines.zh: 好的。

lines.en: First, let's talk about your personal skills. Pete, are you a people person?
lines.zh: 首先，我们谈谈你的个人能力。皮特，你很会和人打交道吗？

lines.en: Well, okay, sometimes I think people talk too much.
lines.zh: 嗯，好吧，有时候我觉得人们话太多了。

lines.en: Pete, what work of yours are you most proud of?
lines.zh: 皮特，你最自豪的作品是什么？

lines.en: Last year, I locked myself in a cabin and wrote a book. I didn't speak to anybody the entire time! It was the best two months of my life.
lines.zh: 去年，我把自己关在一间小木屋里写了一本书，整整两个月没跟任何人说话！那是我这辈子最美好的两个月。

lines.en: Okay. I think I've heard enough.
lines.zh: 好，我想我听够了。

lines.en: Hey! Hey, Pete, how was the interview with Ms. Weaver?
lines.zh: 嘿！嘿，皮特，和韦弗女士的面试怎么样？

lines.en: Well, she said I was grumpy and not good with people.
lines.zh: 嗯，她说我脾气古怪，不擅长和人打交道。

lines.en: And … ?
lines.zh: 然后呢……？

lines.en: And, I got the job!
lines.zh: 然后，我得到这份工作了！

lines.en: I knew it! Congratulations! Let's go celebrate.
lines.zh: 我就知道！恭喜你！我们去庆祝一下吧。

lines.en: Okay!
lines.zh: 好！

lines.en: Did you find more two-word verbs? Here is the list.
lines.zh: 你找到更多短语动词了吗？这是词表。

qs.q: What is Anna's new assignment?
opts: hosting a show with a partner
qs.a: hosting a show with a partner
qs.why: 她要和一个搭档主持访谈节目。

qs.q: Why does Anna think of Pete?
opts: He is very different from her.
qs.a: He is very different from her.
qs.why: "the person must be different from me. So, I thought of you."

qs.q: What happens after Pete's interview?
qs.why: "And, I got the job!"

lessons.title: He Said - She Said
lessons.zh: 他说，她说：迟到的两种说法

lines.en: Today, Pete and I are meeting with a consultant who will help us with our new show. Yesterday, Pete had promised to meet me here at 8:00 am. but he did not come on time.
lines.zh: 今天，皮特和我要见一位顾问，她会帮我们做新节目。昨天皮特答应早上 8 点在这里和我碰面，可他没有准时来。

lines.en: Uh-oh. It's bad to be late for a business meeting. But while we wait for Pete, let's talk about a new verb tense -- past perfect! You know the past tense, right? Like, "Pete promised to meet me here at 8:00 a.m." Past perfect is a little different. When we talk about two things in the past, we can use the past perfect for the first event. Put "had" before the past participle. "Pete had promised he would meet Anna." Here's your assignment: find sentences with the past perfect tense. Remember, look for "had!"
lines.zh: 哎呀，商务会议迟到可不好。不过在等皮特的时候，我们来讲一个新时态——过去完成时！你知道一般过去时吧？比如“Pete promised to meet me here at 8:00 a.m.”。过去完成时有点不一样：说过去的两件事时，先发生的那件可以用过去完成时，在过去分词前加 had，比如“Pete had promised he would meet Anna.”。你的任务是：找出用过去完成时的句子。记住，找 had！

lines.en: You two are late -- exactly 43 minutes late! What happened?
lines.zh: 你们俩迟到了——整整迟到 43 分钟！怎么回事？

lines.en: He had to get his "special" coffee -- SPECIAL coffee!
lines.zh: 他非得去买他的“特调”咖啡——特调咖啡！

lines.en: She had to feed her birds -- HER birds!
lines.zh: 她非得去喂她的鸟——她的鸟！

lines.en: Okay, I can see already that you need my help. You can't both talk at the same time. You have to take turns. Alright, Anna, you go first.
lines.zh: 好，我已经看出来你们需要我的帮助了。你们不能两个人同时说话，得轮流说。好，安娜，你先说。

lines.en: Sure. Kelly, see, Pete and I live in the same building. So, we decided to meet at 8:00 a.m. - 8:00 a.m. to come to work together. I had waited 15 minutes when Pete arrived!
lines.zh: 好。凯莉，你看，皮特和我住同一栋楼，所以我们约好早上 8 点——8 点碰面一起来上班。我等了 15 分钟皮特才到！

lines.en: After Pete had wasted time waiting for coffee, we were late. I left you a message.
lines.zh: 皮特排队买咖啡浪费了时间之后，我们就迟到了。我给你留了言。

lines.en: Hum. I didn't get that message.
lines.zh: 嗯，我没收到那条留言。

lines.en: Oh. Sorry.
lines.zh: 哦，抱歉。

lines.en: Pete?
lines.zh: 皮特？

lines.en: Anna left a message. That's the right thing to do. Did you find some examples of the past perfect sentences? I did. Anna said,
lines.zh: 安娜留了言，这么做是对的。你找到过去完成时的例句了吗？我找到了。安娜说：

lines.en: "After Pete had wasted time waiting for coffee, we were late.
lines.zh: “After Pete had wasted time waiting for coffee, we were late.”

lines.en: Look at that coffee! It looks more like dessert! Okay, keep watching for past perfect!
lines.zh: 看看那杯咖啡！看着更像甜点！好，继续找过去完成时！

lines.en: Yeah, that's not why we're late. This is why we're late: I had arrived on time at 8:00 a.m. but didn't see Anna. She was standing behind a tree. I think she was hugging it. I always walk to work. But she said that would take too long and that a scooter would be much faster. It was awful. I hated it. And it added too much time to our commute!
lines.zh: 是啊，我们不是因为这个迟到的。我们迟到是因为：我 8 点准时到了，可没看到安娜。她站在一棵树后面，我想她是在抱那棵树。我总是走路上班，可她说那样太慢，滑板车快多了。太糟了，我讨厌那东西。而且它让我们的通勤时间变得更长了！

lines.en: Then Anna stopped by a pond to feed the birds. She had named them after characters from books and yelled the names out loud … Romeo! Juliet! Sherlock!
lines.zh: 然后安娜又在一个池塘边停下来喂鸟。她用书里人物的名字给它们起了名，还大声喊它们的名字……罗密欧！朱丽叶！夏洛克！

lines.en: By the time she had fed all the birds, we were late.
lines.zh: 等她喂完所有的鸟，我们已经迟到了。

lines.en: This is what I think. You two see the same event very differently. Does this happen often with you two?
lines.zh: 我是这么看的：你们俩对同一件事的看法很不一样。你们俩经常这样吗？

lines.en: Yes.
lines.zh: 是。

lines.en: No.
lines.zh: 不是。

lines.en: No.
lines.zh: 不是。

lines.en: Yes.
lines.zh: 是。

lines.en: Okay. This is good. This is good! It's good to see things differently. I have an idea: we will call the show "He Said, She Said." For every story, you tell a different point of view.
lines.zh: 好，这很好，这很好！看法不同是好事。我有个主意：节目就叫《他说，她说》。每个故事，你们各讲一个角度。

lines.en: That is a great idea, Kelly! Pete, we are different. That's why I thought of you for this job!
lines.zh: 好主意，凯莉！皮特，我们不一样，所以我才想到让你来做这份工作！

lines.en: I think you two understand perfectly.
lines.zh: 我觉得你们俩完全懂了。

lines.en: Let's get to work!
lines.zh: 我们开工吧！

lines.en: She named the birds? Really?
lines.zh: 她给鸟起了名字？真的？

lines.en: Yeah…
lines.zh: 是啊……

qs.q: How late were Anna and Pete?
qs.why: "exactly 43 minutes late!"

qs.q: What tense does Professor Bot teach?
qs.why: 过去完成时：had + 过去分词。

qs.q: What is the name of the new show?
qs.why: "we will call the show 'He Said, She Said.'"

lessons.title: Run Away With the Circus!
lessons.zh: 跟着马戏团去流浪：同意和反对

lines.en: Hello, I'm Anna …
lines.zh: 你好，我是安娜……

lines.en: … and I'm Pete. Welcome to "He Said,
lines.zh: ……我是皮特。欢迎收看《他说，

lines.en: … She Said"!
Because there are always two sides …
lines.zh: 因为任何事总有两面……

lines.en: to every story!
lines.zh: ……说法！

lines.en: Today's show is about Circus Arts!
lines.zh: 今天的节目讲马戏艺术！

lines.en: Circus? That's not an art form.
lines.zh: 马戏？那不是艺术形式。

lines.en: Yes, it is.
lines.zh: 是的，它是。

lines.en: No, it isn't.
lines.zh: 不，不是。

lines.en: Yes, it is.
lines.zh: 是的，它是。

lines.en: No, it isn't.
lines.zh: 不，不是。

lines.en: Yes, it is!
lines.zh: 是，它就是！

lines.en: No, it isn't.
lines.zh: 不，不是。

lines.en: Yes, it is!
lines.zh: 是，它就是！

lines.en: No, it isn't.
lines.zh: 不，不是。

lines.en: Yes, it is!
lines.zh: 是，它就是！

lines.en: Oh dear. Anna and Pete do not agree about Circus Arts. But that's okay. Today's lesson is about agreeing and disagreeing. Let's listen to how Anna and Pete disagree or agree. Let's hope these two can agree on something.
lines.zh: 哎呀，安娜和皮特在马戏艺术上意见不一。不过没关系，今天的课就是讲同意和反对。我们来听听安娜和皮特怎么表达反对或同意，希望他俩能在某件事上达成一致。

lines.en: Today, let's run away with the circus!
lines.zh: 今天，我们跟着马戏团去流浪吧！

lines.en: Recently, I went to a circus festival. There was a huge circus tent. And many different circus performers. It was a celebration of circus arts!
lines.zh: 最近我去了一个马戏节，有一个巨大的马戏帐篷，还有很多不同的马戏演员。那是一场马戏艺术的盛会！

lines.en: That looks fun, Anna. But I don't think circus performers are artists. I think they're athletes with interesting skills … and costumes.
lines.zh: 看起来很好玩，安娜。不过我不认为马戏演员是艺术家。我觉得他们是有特殊技能……和服装的运动员。

lines.en: Hmm, that is a very interesting point of view, Pete. And I completely disagree.
lines.zh: 嗯，这个观点很有意思，皮特。而我完全不同意。

lines.en: Anna, Michelangelo was an artist. Rembrandt was an artist. People who swing from ropes are not artists. I know it's not easy to swing from a bar and catch someone by the hands. You have to be very athletic to do that.
lines.zh: 安娜，米开朗基罗是艺术家，伦勃朗是艺术家。在绳子上荡来荡去的人不是艺术家。我知道从横杆上荡过去再抓住别人的手不容易，得很有运动能力才行。

lines.en: That's a good point, Pete. They are athletic. But they are called trapeze artists. Trapeze … ARTISTS.
lines.zh: 说得有道理，皮特，他们是很有运动能力。可他们被叫作空中飞人艺术家（trapeze artists）。空中飞人……艺术家。

lines.en: I hear what you're saying, Anna. I do. But where is the art? Look at these guys. They're jugglers.
lines.zh: 我明白你的意思，安娜，我真明白。可艺术在哪儿？看看这些人，他们是杂耍演员。

lines.en: Yes, they are skilled in the art of juggling.
lines.zh: 是啊，他们精通杂耍这门艺术。

lines.en: They have a special skill. But are they artists?
lines.zh: 他们有特殊技能。可他们是艺术家吗？

lines.en: Yes!
lines.zh: 是！

lines.en: No!
lines.zh: 不是！

lines.en: They're just throwing things back and forth.
lines.zh: 他们只是把东西扔过来扔过去。

lines.en: Kind of like you and me, Pete. We're going back and forth on this issue.
lines.zh: 有点像你和我，皮特。我们在这个问题上也是你来我往。

lines.en: I don't think we'll ever agree on this one.
lines.zh: 我觉得我们在这件事上永远达不成一致。

lines.en: No, but we can agree that these young people are amazing.
lines.zh: 是啊，不过我们可以同意，这些年轻人很了不起。

lines.en: Okay, yeah. We can agree on that. But, still, they are very athletic – flipping and throwing each other around.
lines.zh: 好吧，是的，这点我们可以同意。不过，他们还是很有运动能力——又翻跟头又互相抛来抛去。

lines.en: Yes, I agree with you on that point.
lines.zh: 是的，在这一点上我同意你。

lines.en: They did it! They agreed!! Anna says she agrees that the performers are athletic. "That's a good point, Pete. They are athletic. I agree with you on that point. " Now look for other ways they agree.
lines.zh: 他们做到了！他们达成一致了！！安娜说她同意演员们很有运动能力：“That's a good point, Pete. They are athletic. I agree with you on that point.”现在找找他们表达同意的其他说法。

lines.en: Anna? Anna!!
lines.zh: 安娜？安娜！！

lines.en: Sorry! Sorry! But he's an artist too. He is telling a story with his sticks and his costume.
lines.zh: 抱歉！抱歉！可他也是艺术家。他在用他的棍子和服装讲故事。

lines.en: What story? What costume?
lines.zh: 什么故事？什么服装？

lines.en: I see your point, Pete. I really do. But circus performers do more than physical tricks. Look! Look at these amazing performers!
lines.zh: 我明白你的观点，皮特，我真明白。但马戏演员做的不只是体能技巧。看！看这些了不起的演员！

lines.en: I will admit -- I like their costumes.
lines.zh: 我承认——我喜欢他们的服装。

lines.en: You know, Pete. Let's let the performers speak for themselves.
lines.zh: 你知道吗，皮特，我们让演员们自己来说吧。

lines.en: Kate and Piper tell stories while hanging upside down on a ring!
lines.zh: 凯特和派珀倒挂在一个圆环上讲故事！

lines.en: Was it hard to interview them upside down?
lines.zh: 倒着采访她们难吗？

lines.en: I interviewed them right side up, Pete. Kate says circus performing may be athletic but it's not competitive. With most sports, you compete.
lines.zh: 我是正着采访她们的，皮特。凯特说，马戏表演也许需要运动能力，但它不是竞技。大多数体育运动都是要比赛的。

lines.en: It's an art form because like, other sports are competing. This is simply performing and having fun.
lines.zh: 它是一种艺术形式，因为其他运动都是比赛，而这只是表演、找乐子。

lines.en: Okay, Kate made a really good point. In athletics, there is a lot of competition. But still …
lines.zh: 好吧，凯特说得很有道理。体育运动里有很多竞争。不过还是……

lines.en: Here's Piper, Pete. Please pay attention, Pete.
lines.zh: 这是派珀，皮特。请认真听，皮特。

lines.en: But, I -
lines.zh: 可是，我——

lines.en: Shh.
lines.zh: 嘘。

lines.en: Well, when you're up in the air doing circus you have to perform. And so, we learn to embody characters, and to move fluidly and gracefully … in artistic ways.
lines.zh: 嗯，你在空中表演马戏时，必须要演。所以我们学着去化身为角色，动作要流畅优雅……用艺术的方式。

lines.en: And that …is why they are artists!
lines.zh: 而这……就是她们是艺术家的原因！

lines.en: You're right, Anna. Oh, you're right. It's just so beautiful.
lines.zh: 你说得对，安娜。哦，你说得对。实在太美了。

lines.en: I know. I know, Pete.
lines.zh: 我知道，我知道，皮特。

lines.en: Good job you two! I'm so glad that Anna and Pete finally agree! Pete said, " You're right, Anna." I agree, too. Circus arts are beautiful. Remember the website!
lines.zh: 你们俩干得好！真高兴安娜和皮特终于达成一致了！皮特说：“You're right, Anna.”我也同意，马戏艺术很美。记得去网站看看！

qs.q: What do Anna and Pete disagree about?
qs.why: "Circus? That's not an art form."

qs.q: What do they agree on first?
qs.why: "Yes, I agree with you on that point."

qs.q: According to Kate, how is circus different from most sports?
qs.why: "other sports are competing. This is simply performing and having fun."

lessons.title: Greatest Vacation of All Time
lessons.zh: 史上最棒的假期：比较级和最高级

lines.en: "Do you need a vacation?" Wow. That was the best vacation I have ever had … in my head. A beach is much better than here. I need a vacation!
lines.zh: “你需要度假吗？”哇，那是我度过的最棒的假期……在我脑子里。海滩比这儿好多了。我需要度假！

lines.en: I hear you, Anna. I need a vacation too but not at the beach. Sand is not good for robots! When we compare things, we use special forms of adjectives. "Better" is a comparative adjective. That is used to compare two things. "Best" is a superlative adjective. It shows that one thing has more of ...something than ALL of the others. Try to find more of these adjectives. Look for ER or EST at the end.
lines.zh: 我懂你，安娜。我也需要度假，不过不去海滩，沙子对机器人不好！比较东西时，我们用形容词的特殊形式。better 是比较级，用来比较两样东西；best 是最高级，表示某样东西比其他所有的都更……。试着找找更多这样的形容词，看结尾有没有 -er 或 -est。

lines.en: NO! You can't get your money back. I don't care that it was your worst vacation ever!
lines.zh: 不行！你不能退钱。我才不管那是不是你最糟糕的一次假期！

lines.en: Hello! Have a seat! Welcome to the World's Best Vacation Travel Agency!
lines.zh: 你好！请坐！欢迎来到世界最佳度假旅行社！

lines.en: Thank you and congratulations!
lines.zh: 谢谢您，恭喜您！

lines.en: For what?
lines.zh: 恭喜什么？

lines.en: For being the world's best travel agency.
lines.zh: 恭喜你们成为世界上最好的旅行社。

lines.en: Right … thanks.
lines.zh: 对……谢谢。

lines.en: Trudy, hold my calls. I am going to sell our most expensive vacation.
lines.zh: 特鲁迪，帮我挡掉所有电话。我要卖我们最贵的度假套餐了。

lines.en: Sure thing, Boss.
lines.zh: 没问题，老板。

lines.en: The Mountain Getaway is good for you. It's a little pricey. But think of it -- you, on top of a mountain for seven days!
lines.zh: “山间度假”很适合你。有点小贵，不过想想看——你在山顶待上七天！

lines.en: I'm afraid of high places.
lines.zh: 我怕高。

lines.en: Of course you are. That's why our Deep Sea Adventure is better for you! It is pricier than the Mountain Getaway. Just you and the animals of the sea!
lines.zh: 你当然怕。所以我们的“深海探险”更适合你！它比“山间度假”更贵。只有你和海洋动物！

lines.en: Shark! Shark!
lines.zh: 鲨鱼！鲨鱼！

lines.en: No, there are no sharks in your dream vacation! You need the Safari Camp Out! It is our priciest vacation. But I think it's the best one for you. During the day, you'll see elephants, giraffes and lions. At night, you'll sleep out under the stars.
lines.zh: 不，你梦想的假期里没有鲨鱼！你需要“野生动物露营”！这是我们最贵的套餐，但我觉得它最适合你。白天你会看到大象、长颈鹿和狮子，晚上你睡在星空下。

lines.en: Look, I think this was a bad idea.
lines.zh: 听着，我觉得这是个馊主意。

lines.en: Sure, you can leave. But then you won't see the latest vacation technology.
lines.zh: 当然，你可以走。不过那样你就看不到最新的度假科技了。

lines.en: Did you find all of those adjectives? Dan started with good - The mountain getaway; then he moved to better - The Deep Sea Adventure. And finally, he said the Safari Campout was the best vacation for Anna!
lines.zh: 你找到所有这些形容词了吗？丹从 good 开始——山间度假；然后变成 better——深海探险；最后他说野生动物露营是最适合安娜的（best）假期！

lines.en: Exactly what is the "latest vacation technology" … exactly?
lines.zh: “最新的度假科技”到底是什么……到底？

lines.en: I'm happy you asked. Meet the Travel Max 2000!
lines.zh: 很高兴你问了。来见见旅行大师 2000！

lines.en: Wow.
lines.zh: 哇。

lines.en: So, tell me, how do you like to travel?
lines.zh: 那么，告诉我，你喜欢怎么旅行？

lines.en: Well, I like travel that is cozy and romantic but still exciting.
lines.zh: 嗯，我喜欢舒适浪漫但又刺激的旅行。

lines.en: Great. Tell me more.
lines.zh: 很好，多说点。

lines.en: I like traveling in a plane but not in a helicopter! Planes are a little scary but helicopters are scarier! My favorite way of traveling is by train. Ships can be the scariest! Have you seen the movie "Titanic"? Oh, and no horses. But I will ride a camel. And no bike tours. Biking is THE slowest AND least romantic way to travel. Excuse me, but I think the Travel Max 2000 is on fire.
lines.zh: 我喜欢坐飞机，但不坐直升机！飞机有点吓人，直升机更吓人！我最喜欢坐火车旅行。坐船可能最吓人！你看过《泰坦尼克号》吗？哦，还有，不骑马，不过我会骑骆驼。也不要自行车游，骑车是最慢、最不浪漫的旅行方式。不好意思，我觉得旅行大师 2000 着火了。

lines.en: Yes, we're both on fire! We really want to sell you the most ex-, I mean, best vacation ever!
lines.zh: 是的，我们俩都火力全开！我们真的很想卖给你最贵的——我是说，有史以来最棒的假期！

lines.en: No, I mean it's really on fire!
lines.zh: 不，我是说它真的着火了！

lines.en: You killed it. You killed the Travel Max 2000!
lines.zh: 你把它弄坏了。你把旅行大师 2000 弄坏了！

lines.en: I am so sorry! Can I help you fix it?
lines.zh: 真对不起！我能帮你修吗？

lines.en: No, no!
lines.zh: 不，不！

lines.en: Don't cry. I know what you need -- a vacation!
lines.zh: 别哭。我知道你需要什么——度个假！

lines.en: The Safari Campout looks fun. It is the priciest. But I think you deserve it.
lines.zh: 野生动物露营看起来很好玩。它是最贵的，不过我觉得你值得。

lines.en: No, no!
lines.zh: 不，不！

lines.en: Oh Anna. This is the smokiest lesson yet! There were a lot of comparatives and superlatives but … I can't breathe. Just go to the website to learn the best ways to use them!
lines.zh: 哦，安娜。这是迄今为止烟最大的一课！比较级和最高级用了不少，可是……我喘不过气了。去网站学学它们最好的用法吧！

qs.q: Why doesn't Anna want the Mountain Getaway?
opts: She is afraid of high places.
qs.a: She is afraid of high places.
qs.why: "I'm afraid of high places."

qs.q: Which vacation is the priciest?
qs.why: "It is our priciest vacation."

qs.q: What is Anna's favorite way to travel?
qs.why: "My favorite way of traveling is by train."

lessons.title: Will It Float?
lessons.zh: 它能浮起来吗？坐水陆两用车游华盛顿

lines.en: Anna, thanks for taking me on a tour of D.C. today.
lines.zh: 安娜，谢谢你今天带我游览华盛顿。

lines.en: Sure thing, Penelope. You are new to town. And a tour is the best way to see more of the city!
lines.zh: 没问题，佩内洛普。你刚来这座城市，跟团游是了解城市最好的方式！

lines.en: So, which tour are we taking – the one that goes through the city on a bus? Or the one that goes along the river in a boat?
lines.zh: 那我们参加哪个游览——坐公交穿过市区的那个？还是坐船沿河的那个？

lines.en: Both!
lines.zh: 两个都参加！

lines.en: What? Anna, this isn't going to be one of those trips, is it?
lines.zh: 什么？安娜，这不会又是那种出行吧？

lines.en: No. Follow me.
lines.zh: 不会。跟我来。

lines.en: In this lesson, you are going to hear lots of prepositions! What's a preposition, you ask? It's a word that shows relationships between things. Anna says they are going on a tour through the city and along the river. Through and along are both prepositions. Watch for more!
lines.zh: 这一课你会听到很多介词！你问什么是介词？就是表示事物之间关系的词。安娜说她们要穿过（through）市区、沿着（along）河游览，through 和 along 都是介词。注意找更多！

lines.en: Well, Penelope, there's our ride!
lines.zh: 好了，佩内洛普，我们的车来了！

lines.en: What is it?
lines.zh: 这是什么？

lines.en: It's the famous DC Ducks -- the boat with wheels! We will ride on the road and then sail on the water!
lines.zh: 这是有名的华盛顿鸭子船——带轮子的船！我们会先在路上开，然后在水上航行！

lines.en: Who thinks of these things?
lines.zh: 谁想出来的这些东西？

lines.en: I don't know. But I'm glad they do! Let's get aboard, Sailor!
lines.zh: 不知道，不过我很高兴有人想出来了！上船吧，水手！

lines.en: (looking at a brochure about the boat) Hey, did you know that this bus … um, boat was created during World War II to carry people and supplies?
lines.zh: （看着关于这艘船的小册子）嘿，你知道吗，这辆公交……呃，这艘船是二战时造出来运送人员和物资的？

lines.en: Wow. You know, a tour is so much more interesting with Fun Facts, like that one.
lines.zh: 哇。你知道吗，有这样的趣闻，游览就有意思多了。

lines.en: I agree. I love Fun Facts!
lines.zh: 我同意，我爱听趣闻！

lines.en: Did I hear you say you love Fun Facts?
lines.zh: 我刚才是不是听到你们说爱听趣闻？

lines.en: Anna & Penelope: Yeah.
lines.zh: 是啊。

lines.en: Well, I have tons of Fun Facts for this tour!
lines.zh: 那这一路我有一大堆趣闻！

lines.en: Anna & Penelope: Great!
lines.zh: 太好了！

lines.en: Penelope, where are his parents?
lines.zh: 佩内洛普，他爸妈在哪儿？

lines.en: Maybe - maybe he's the Captain's son and he helps his dad on tours!
lines.zh: 也许——也许他是船长的儿子，帮爸爸带游客！

lines.en: Oh yeah! It would be so awesome to ride around the city in a boat all day with your dad!
lines.zh: 哦，对啊！能整天跟着爸爸坐船在城里转，那该多棒！

lines.en: This is amazing, Anna. There are so many beautiful buildings along this road!
lines.zh: 太美了，安娜。这条路两边有好多漂亮的建筑！

lines.en: Hey, the Washington Monument is on the left!
lines.zh: 嘿，华盛顿纪念碑在左边！

lines.en: I have a Fun Fact too! Did you know that the Washington Monument was damaged in an earthquake? Whoa. Did you feel that?!
lines.zh: 我也有个趣闻！你知道华盛顿纪念碑在一次地震中受过损吗？哇！你感觉到了吗？！

lines.en: "around the city in a boat," "along this road and "on the left." All of these are prepositions showing place. Let's watch for more places and prepositions!
lines.zh: 我听到了：“around the city in a boat”“along this road”和“on the left”。这些都是表示地点的介词。我们继续找更多地点和介词！

lines.en: Look, Anna, we're across from the White House!
lines.zh: 看，安娜，我们在白宫对面了！

lines.en: Penelope, the only thing between us and the President is the street … and a park … and a security gate .... and police officers … with guns.
lines.zh: 佩内洛普，我们和总统之间只隔着一条街……一个公园……一道安保门……还有警察……带着枪。

lines.en: Excuse me, do you want to know a Fun Fact about the White House?
lines.zh: 打扰一下，你们想知道一个关于白宫的趣闻吗？

lines.en: Anna & Penelope: Yes!
lines.zh: 想！

lines.en: Inside the White House there is a swimming pool, a movie theater and 32 bathrooms!
lines.zh: 白宫里面有一个游泳池、一个电影院，还有 32 个卫生间！

lines.en: Thirty-two bathrooms! That's a lot of bathrooms!
lines.zh: 32 个卫生间！好多卫生间啊！

lines.en: I'd be happy with two. I live in a house with my mom, four sisters, two aunts and only one bathroom!
lines.zh: 我有两个就满足了。我和我妈妈、四个姐妹、两个阿姨住在一栋房子里，只有一个卫生间！

lines.en: Oh my! You know, Anna, we should give him a tip!
lines.zh: 天哪！你知道吗，安娜，我们应该给他小费！

lines.en: Of course! It is polite to tip your tour guide! Luckily, I have lots of dollar bills!
lines.zh: 当然！给导游小费是礼貌！幸好我有很多一美元的钞票！

lines.en: That was a great Fun Fact! Here you go!
lines.zh: 这个趣闻太棒了！给你！

lines.en: Thank you! I can tell you Fun Facts all day!
lines.zh: 谢谢！我能给你们讲一整天的趣闻！

lines.en: Did you hear any more prepositions of place? I heard "between us and the president" "inside the White House" and "in a house."
lines.zh: 你听到更多表示地点的介词了吗？我听到了“between us and the president”“inside the White House”和“in a house”。

lines.en: And did you hear that the Duck Boat can go on the river? I don't believe it. Join us next time to find out which preposition we will use: The boat went ON the river or The boat went INTO the river?
lines.zh: 你们听说鸭子船能下河吗？我可不信。下次接着看，看我们要用哪个介词：船开到了河上（ON），还是船开进了河里（INTO）？

qs.q: What is special about the DC Ducks?
opts: It is a boat with wheels.
qs.a: It is a boat with wheels.
qs.why: "the boat with wheels!"

qs.q: How many bathrooms are in the White House, says the boy?
qs.why: "32 bathrooms!"

qs.q: Why do Anna and Penelope give the boy money?
qs.why: "It is polite to tip your tour guide!"

lessons.title: Tip Your Tour Guide
lessons.zh: 给导游小费：神秘的小导游

lines.en: Welcome back! Anna and Penelope are taking a tour with DC Ducks. In this lesson, we are looking for prepositions. Listen for in, on, at, under and over - some important prepositions of place.
lines.zh: 欢迎回来！安娜和佩内洛普正坐华盛顿鸭子船游览。这一课我们找介词，注意听 in、on、at、under 和 over——这些是重要的地点介词。

lines.en: Penelope, the Lincoln Memorial is coming up on your left!
lines.zh: 佩内洛普，林肯纪念堂马上就在你左边了！

lines.en: You're going to love my Lincoln Memorial Fun Fact!
lines.zh: 你们会喜欢我的林肯纪念堂趣闻的！

lines.en: Oh, please tell us!
lines.zh: 哦，快告诉我们！

lines.en: On a wall inside the memorial, the word "FUTURE" was carved wrong! They carved "EUTURE"!
lines.zh: 纪念堂里面的一面墙上，“FUTURE”这个词刻错了！刻成了“EUTURE”！

lines.en: Well, we all make mistakes.
lines.zh: 嗯，谁都会犯错。

lines.en: Yeah, but this mistake was carved in stone!
lines.zh: 是啊，可这个错是刻在石头上的！

lines.en: You're right. That is pretty bad. Here's another dollar!
lines.zh: 你说得对，那确实挺糟的。再给你一美元！

lines.en: More fun facts, please! (Crossing the river) I love riding over bridges! The water looks so pretty from here!
lines.zh: 再来点趣闻吧！（过河）我爱坐车过桥！从这儿看水好漂亮！

lines.en: Penelope, this is amazing! A minute ago, we were riding along the river, and now we're riding in the river! Awesome.
lines.zh: 佩内洛普，太神奇了！一分钟前我们还沿着河开，现在就在河里开了！太棒了。

lines.en: Hey, we're passing by the Pentagon on our right!
lines.zh: 嘿，我们从五角大楼旁边经过，它在我们右边！

lines.en: Penelope, you love riding over the water on a bridge. But I love riding under a bridge in a boat!
lines.zh: 佩内洛普，你喜欢坐车在桥上过河，可我喜欢坐船从桥下穿过！

lines.en: Anna, look! An airplane is flying right over our heads!
lines.zh: 安娜，看！一架飞机正从我们头顶飞过！

lines.en: Wow! This is the closest I've ever been to an airplane in flight. Well, I've been inside a flying airplane. But not outside of an airplane as it flies over my head!
lines.zh: 哇！这是我离飞行中的飞机最近的一次。嗯，我在飞行中的飞机里面待过，可从没在飞机外面看着它从头顶飞过！

lines.en: And now we're driving out of the water. I still can't believe this thing drives and sails!
lines.zh: 现在我们要开出水面了。我还是不敢相信这东西又能开又能航行！

lines.en: I know. It's amazing.
lines.zh: 我知道，太神奇了。

lines.en: After we ride along these railroad tracks, you'll see my favorite part of the tour! The U.S. Treasury where they make money!
lines.zh: 我们沿着这段铁轨开过去之后，你们就会看到我最喜欢的部分！美国财政部，就是印钱的地方！

lines.en: That young man is making a lot of money, too. Did you hear these prepositions? On your left, on our right, in the river, over bridges, over our heads, over my head, on a bridge. As you watch more, look for 'inside' and 'outside.'
lines.zh: 那个小伙子也赚了不少钱呢。你听到这些介词了吗？on your left, on our right, in the river, over bridges, over our heads, over my head, on a bridge。接着看，注意找 inside 和 outside。

lines.en: Look, the U.S. Capitol is coming up!
lines.zh: 看，美国国会大厦到了！

lines.en: I have a great Fun Fact about the U.S. Capitol.
lines.zh: 我有一个关于国会大厦的好趣闻。

lines.en: What is it?
lines.zh: 是什么？

lines.en: There are tunnels under the Capitol. They connect the Capitol and office buildings of lawmakers.
lines.zh: 国会大厦下面有隧道，连接国会大厦和议员们的办公楼。

lines.en: I bet they built them years ago for secret reasons!
lines.zh: 我敢说这是多年前为了什么秘密原因建的！

lines.en: No. The lawmakers did not want to walk around outside in bad weather.
lines.zh: 不是。议员们只是不想在坏天气里走外面。

lines.en: Oh.
lines.zh: 哦。

lines.en: We're back at Union Station!
lines.zh: 我们回到联合车站了！

lines.en: Do you want to know a creepy Fun Fact about Union Station? (he points to Union Station)
lines.zh: 你们想听一个关于联合车站的吓人趣闻吗？（他指着联合车站）

lines.en: The creepier the better!
lines.zh: 越吓人越好！

lines.en: Many years ago, inside Union Station, there was a funeral home!
lines.zh: 很多年前，联合车站里面有一家殡仪馆！

lines.en: A funeral home?! You mean, for dead people?!
lines.zh: 殡仪馆？！你是说，给死人用的？！

lines.en: Do you know another kind of funeral home?
lines.zh: 你还知道别种殡仪馆吗？

lines.en: No!
lines.zh: 不知道！

lines.en: Well, I've gotta run!
lines.zh: 好了，我得走了！

lines.en: Thanks for giving us the great tour!
lines.zh: 谢谢你带我们玩得这么开心！

lines.en: Captain, that was awesome! And your son is a great tour guide!
lines.zh: 船长，太棒了！您儿子是个很棒的导游！

lines.en: What son?
lines.zh: 什么儿子？

lines.en: Him.
lines.zh: 他。

lines.en: I've never seen that boy in my life! See ya, ladies!
lines.zh: 我这辈子从没见过那孩子！再见了，女士们！

lines.en: I learned many new Fun Facts in this lesson. Did you learn about prepositions?
lines.zh: 这一课我学到了好多新趣闻。你学到介词了吗？

lines.en: Here's a list of all the prepositions used in this lesson. Wow! That's a lot! I know, let's not read them. Let's sing them! Hit it, boys! Take it away singers!
lines.zh: 这是本课用到的所有介词。哇！好多！我知道了，我们别读了，唱出来吧！奏乐，伙计们！歌手们，开唱！

qs.q: What mistake is in the Lincoln Memorial?
qs.why: "They carved 'EUTURE'!"

qs.q: Why were the tunnels under the Capitol built?
opts: Lawmakers didn't want to walk outside in bad weather.
qs.a: Lawmakers didn't want to walk outside in bad weather.
qs.why: "The lawmakers did not want to walk around outside in bad weather."

qs.q: Who is the boy?
qs.why: "I've never seen that boy in my life!"

lessons.title: The Best Barbecue
lessons.zh: 最好的烧烤：被动语态

lines.en: Thanks for meeting me.
lines.zh: 谢谢你来见我。

lines.en: Sure.
lines.zh: 没问题。

lines.en: I'd like to get your advice on my latest project.
lines.zh: 我想听听你对我最新项目的建议。

lines.en: Of course. I heard you were sent to cover a big food festival that has all kinds of barbecue. So, how did it go?
lines.zh: 当然。听说你被派去报道一个有各种烧烤的大型美食节。怎么样？

lines.en: Well, things started out great! But then, well, maybe you should watch it yourself.
lines.zh: 嗯，一开始很顺利！可后来……还是你自己看吧。

lines.en: Hi English learners! Your lesson today is about my favorite food -- barbecue! Your assignment is to find passive sentences. What are those, you might ask? In passive sentences the subject receives the action!
lines.zh: 各位英语学习者好！今天这课讲我最爱的食物——烧烤！你的任务是找出被动句。你问那是什么？在被动句里，主语是动作的承受者！

lines.en: For example, "Anna was sent to cover a food festival."
lines.zh: 比如：“Anna was sent to cover a food festival.”（安娜被派去报道一个美食节。）

lines.en: Passive sentences have a form of the BE verb + the past participle of the main verb. This lesson is LOADED with passive sentences. Hey! That's a passive sentence, too!
lines.zh: 被动句的结构是 BE 动词 + 主要动词的过去分词。这一课“装满了”被动句。嘿！这句也是被动句！

lines.en: Okay, now, it's Barbecue Time!
lines.zh: 好了，烧烤时间到！

lines.en: Today, a Barbecue Battle is being held in Washington, D.C. This festival, which is known as one of the biggest food festivals in the United States, brings together barbecue lovers from all over the country! Barbecue is meat that is cooked over an open fire or on a grill.
lines.zh: 今天，华盛顿正在举办一场“烧烤大战”。这个节日被认为是美国最大的美食节之一，把全国各地的烧烤爱好者聚到了一起！烧烤就是在明火或烤架上烤的肉。

lines.en: Chicken, pork and beef are all common meats to grill on a barbecue! No matter which meat you like to barbecue, the sauce is very important. Sauces are taken very seriously by chefs. Most ingredients are kept secret!
lines.zh: 鸡肉、猪肉和牛肉都是常见的烧烤肉类！不管你喜欢烤什么肉，酱汁都非常重要。厨师们对酱汁非常认真，大多数配料都是保密的！

lines.en: So, can you tell us what is in your barbecue sauce?
lines.zh: 那么，你能告诉我们你的烧烤酱里有什么吗？

lines.en: No, I can't tell you.
lines.zh: 厨师 1：不，我不能告诉你。

lines.en: So, tell us, what is the secret ingredient in your barbecue sauce?
lines.zh: 那你告诉我们，你的烧烤酱里的秘密配料是什么？

lines.en: (says nothing.)
lines.zh: 厨师 2：（什么也不说。）

lines.en: Sauces are made by the barbecue chefs themselves. Most sauces are made with a tomato sauce, vinegar, and spices.
lines.zh: 酱汁是烧烤厨师们自己做的。大多数酱汁是用番茄酱、醋和香料做的。

lines.en: How many passive sentences did you find? Here is one I found:
lines.zh: 你找到了多少个被动句？我找到了这一句：

lines.en: Today, a Barbecue Battle is being held on the National Mall in Washington, D.C. Now you try. Turn this sentence from active to passive.
lines.zh: 今天，华盛顿国家广场上正在举办一场烧烤大战。现在你来试试，把这个句子从主动变成被动。

lines.en: Professor Bot loves Barbecue!
lines.zh: Professor Bot loves Barbecue!（机器人教授爱烧烤！）

lines.en: Barbecue is loved by Prof. Bot.
lines.zh: Barbecue is loved by Prof. Bot.（烧烤被机器人教授所爱。）

lines.en: Good job! And yes, I do.
lines.zh: 做得好！没错，我确实爱。

lines.en: There are some areas of the U.S. that are known for their tasty barbecue. The states of Texas, North and South Carolina and the cities of Memphis and Kansas City are known as the Barbecue Belt. People who are loyal to barbecue are really loyal to their favorite barbecue. That is why this festival is called a battle! Let's ask a couple of people which barbecue is best.
lines.zh: 美国有些地区以美味的烧烤出名。德克萨斯州、南北卡罗来纳州，还有孟菲斯和堪萨斯城被称为“烧烤带”。人们对自己最爱的烧烤非常忠诚，所以这个节日才叫“大战”！我们来问几个人哪种烧烤最好。

lines.en: Texas, of course!
lines.zh: 路人 1：当然是德克萨斯！

lines.en: Carolina barbecue is the very best.
lines.zh: 路人 2：卡罗来纳烧烤是最好的。

lines.en: Kansas City!
lines.zh: 路人 3：堪萨斯城！

lines.en: Memphis style!
lines.zh: 路人 4：孟菲斯风味！

lines.en: Kansas City!
lines.zh: 路人 3：堪萨斯城！

lines.en: Texas!
lines.zh: 路人 5：德克萨斯！

lines.en: Kansas!
lines.zh: 路人 3：堪萨斯！

lines.en: Texas!
lines.zh: 路人 5：德克萨斯！

lines.en: Kansas!
lines.zh: 路人 3：堪萨斯！

lines.en: Texas!
lines.zh: 路人 5：德克萨斯！

lines.en: I say Kansas.
lines.zh: 路人 3：我说是堪萨斯。

lines.en: Texas!
lines.zh: 路人 5：德克萨斯！

lines.en: She keeps saying Texas, I say Kansas.
lines.zh: 路人 3：她一直说德克萨斯，我说堪萨斯。

lines.en: This is Anna Matteo reporting.
lines.zh: 安娜·马泰奥报道。

lines.en: Kelly, people feel so strongly about barbecue. Unbelievable! So, what do you think of my project?
lines.zh: 凯莉，大家对烧烤的感情好强烈啊，真不敢相信！那你觉得我的项目怎么样？

lines.en: This is what I think. There is no way that Texas has the best barbecue. I am from Kansas City and we have THE best barbecue in the whole country. My mother and father owned a barbecue restaurant, which was really famous! So, I know barbecue! Anna, I know barbecue! I know barbecue! I know barbecue!
lines.zh: 我是这么想的：德克萨斯绝不可能有最好的烧烤。我是堪萨斯城人，我们那儿有全国最好的烧烤。我爸妈开过一家烧烤餐厅，特别有名！所以我懂烧烤！安娜，我懂烧烤！我懂烧烤！我懂烧烤！

lines.en: Oh my. Kelly knows a lot about barbecue! And you know more about passive sentences! Be sure you go to the website to learn even more! Ah! Now, if you'll excuse me .. I'm hungry
lines.zh: 天哪。凯莉很懂烧烤！你也更懂被动句了！一定要去网站学更多！啊！现在，失陪了……我饿了。

qs.q: What is barbecue?
opts: meat cooked over an open fire or on a grill
qs.a: meat cooked over an open fire or on a grill
qs.why: "Barbecue is meat that is cooked over an open fire or on a grill."

qs.q: Which sentence is passive?
opts: Barbecue is loved by Prof. Bot.
qs.a: Barbecue is loved by Prof. Bot.
qs.why: BE 动词 + 过去分词。

qs.q: Where is Kelly from?
qs.why: "I am from Kansas City."

lessons.title: Pets Are Family, Too!
lessons.zh: 宠物也是家人！反意疑问句

lines.en: Hi Ashley!
lines.zh: 嗨，阿什莉！

lines.en: Hey, Anna! How was your weekend?
lines.zh: 嘿，安娜！周末过得怎么样？

lines.en: It was great! I went to the D.C. State Fair.
lines.zh: 很好！我去了华盛顿州集市。

lines.en: I would have gone, but I was busy. How was it?
lines.zh: 我本来想去的，可我很忙。怎么样？

lines.en: It was awesome! I won first place in a pet contest!
lines.zh: 太棒了！我在一个宠物比赛里得了第一名！

lines.en: But, you don't have a pet, do you?
lines.zh: 可你没有宠物啊，对吧？

lines.en: Yes and no. What do you mean by "pet"?
lines.zh: 算有也算没有。你说的“宠物”是什么意思？

lines.en: A pet is an animal that lives with you. People love their pets. "Ashley said, you don't have a pet, do you? She used a tag question, a small question at the end of a sentence. Let's look for more of them!
lines.zh: 宠物就是和你住在一起的动物，人们都很爱自己的宠物。阿什莉说：“you don't have a pet, do you?”她用了一个反意疑问句，就是句子末尾的一个小问句。我们来找更多！

lines.en: Look, a pet! Who's this cute little dog?
lines.zh: 看，一只宠物！这只可爱的小狗是谁呀？

lines.en: Oh, right. You haven't met my dog, have you? This is Dublin.
lines.zh: 哦，对。你还没见过我的狗，对吧？这是都柏林。

lines.en: Hi, Dublin! Nice to meet you. He's so cute!
lines.zh: 嗨，都柏林！很高兴认识你。它太可爱了！

lines.en: Thanks! So, tell me about the state fair.
lines.zh: 谢谢！那么，跟我说说州集市吧。

lines.en: Oh, there were the usual things -- fair food, cute babies, music. But there must have been a dozen different contests! And some were pretty strange.
lines.zh: 哦，有常见的东西——集市小吃、可爱的宝宝、音乐。不过肯定有十几种不同的比赛！有些还挺奇怪的。

lines.en: There was a contest to see who could spit a watermelon seed the farthest. You should have seen all the people who wanted to spit a watermelon seed! And, it was pretty fun to watch. But Ashley, the pet contests were the best. There was a pet parade. Lots of people walked with their dogs.
lines.zh: 有个比赛看谁吐西瓜子吐得最远。你真该看看那么多人想吐西瓜子！看着挺好玩的。不过阿什莉，宠物比赛最棒。有宠物游行，好多人带着狗走。

lines.en: That sounds so fun. But Anna, tell me, how did you win a pet contest without a pet?
lines.zh: 听起来真好玩。不过安娜，告诉我，你没有宠物怎么赢的宠物比赛？

lines.en: Okay, the closest thing I have is my pet rock.
lines.zh: 好吧，我最接近宠物的东西是我的宠物石头。

lines.en: I know it's silly, but I've had it since I was a little girl. So, for a joke, I brought it to the fair. But then I was invited to enter the "One-of-Kind Pet" contest. And I won! (holds up first place ribbon)
lines.zh: 我知道这很傻，不过我从小就有它了。所以，为了好玩，我把它带到了集市。结果有人邀请我参加“独一无二宠物”比赛。我赢了！（举起第一名的绶带）

lines.en: Anna, only you could have won a pet contest with a pet rock. I should have brought Dublin. He would've won a contest!
lines.zh: 安娜，也只有你能用宠物石头赢宠物比赛。我真该带都柏林去，它肯定能赢个比赛！

lines.en: It's not very easy to win one of these. (shows her the blue ribbon) Does he have a costume?
lines.zh: 赢一个可没那么容易。（给她看蓝绶带）它有装扮服吗？

lines.en: They had a costume contest. You should have seen this little girl. She and her dog wore matching princess costumes!
lines.zh: 他们有个装扮比赛。你真该看看有个小女孩，她和她的狗穿着配套的公主装！

lines.en: Dublin doesn't wear costumes.
lines.zh: 都柏林不穿装扮服。

lines.en: Does he know any tricks?
lines.zh: 它会什么把戏吗？

lines.en: Come this way. Now, watch this. (Dublin chases a toy)
lines.zh: 这边来。看好了。（都柏林去追一个玩具）

lines.en: You caught it, Dublin! And you killed it! Good dog! Ashley, he could have won the Best Catch contest! Aw, good boy! Ashley, pets are fun, aren't they?
lines.zh: 你抓到了，都柏林！还把它“咬死”了！好狗狗！阿什莉，它能赢“最佳接球”比赛！哦，好孩子！阿什莉，宠物很好玩，对吧？

lines.en: Yes. And they become part of your family. (she drinks from her Dublin mug)
lines.zh: 是啊，它们会成为你家庭的一员。（她用印着都柏林的杯子喝水）

lines.en: Ashley, I think I want a dog. No. I know I want a dog!
lines.zh: 阿什莉，我想我想要一只狗。不，我知道我想要一只狗！

lines.en: It's a big responsibility. You may want to spend time with a dog first.
lines.zh: 那是很大的责任。你也许应该先和狗相处一段时间。

lines.en: That is a great idea. But where can I find a dog?
lines.zh: 好主意。可我上哪儿找狗呢？

lines.en: You know, Anna, I have some shopping to do. Do you want to watch Dublin for a couple of hours?
lines.zh: 你知道吗，安娜，我有些东西要去买。你想帮我照看都柏林几个小时吗？

lines.en: Yes! I would! I will take very good care of him!
lines.zh: 想！我愿意！我会好好照顾它的！

lines.en: I know you will. Here's his leash.
lines.zh: 我知道你会的。这是它的牵引绳。

lines.en: Thank you.
lines.zh: 谢谢你。

lines.en: (to Dublin) Okay, I'll miss you!
lines.zh: （对都柏林）好了，我会想你的！

lines.en: Aw. I don't want you to be lonely. Here, Rocky can stay with you. (puts pet rock on wall)
lines.zh: 哦。我不想让你孤单。来，让洛奇陪着你。（把宠物石头放在墙上）

lines.en: Anna, I really don't need … Okay. Thanks, Anna.
lines.zh: 安娜，我真的不需要……好吧，谢谢，安娜。

lines.en: Sure. Bye, Ashley. (to Dublin) Come on, Dublin! Bye, Rocky!
lines.zh: 不客气。拜拜，阿什莉。（对都柏林）走吧，都柏林！拜拜，洛奇！

lines.en: Bye!
lines.zh: 拜拜！

lines.en: Anna's rock is cute, isn't it? Oh, there is another tag question! You found some more, didn't you?
lines.zh: 安娜的石头很可爱，不是吗？哦，又一个反意疑问句！你又找到一些了，对吧？

lines.en: You haven't met my dog, have you?
lines.zh: You haven't met my dog, have you?

lines.en: Go to the VOA Learning English website to learn more.
lines.zh: 去 VOA Learning English 网站了解更多。

qs.q: How did Anna win a pet contest?
qs.why: "the closest thing I have is my pet rock."

qs.q: What is a tag question?
opts: a small question at the end of a sentence
qs.a: a small question at the end of a sentence
qs.why: "a small question at the end of a sentence."

qs.q: What does Ashley ask Anna to do?
opts: watch Dublin for a couple of hours
qs.a: watch Dublin for a couple of hours
qs.why: "Do you want to watch Dublin for a couple of hours?"

lessons.title: Visit to Peru
lessons.zh: “去”秘鲁：wish 和 hope

lines.en: Hi, Anna!
lines.zh: 嗨，安娜！

lines.en: Hi, Bruna! What's up?
lines.zh: 嗨，布鲁娜！怎么了？

lines.en: I thought we could meet for lunch today.
lines.zh: 我想我们今天可以一起吃午饭。

lines.en: I wish I could, but I can't. I have to research Peru for a story.
lines.zh: 我也希望能去，可我去不了。我得为一篇报道研究秘鲁。

lines.en: How's it going?
lines.zh: 进展怎么样？

lines.en: Not so good. I've been reading about Peru and listening to Peruvian music. I really want to understand Peru. I hope it's enough.
lines.zh: 不太好。我一直在读关于秘鲁的东西，听秘鲁音乐。我真的很想了解秘鲁，希望这些够了。

lines.en: You should visit Peru.
lines.zh: 你应该去秘鲁看看。

lines.en: I wish!
lines.zh: 我也想啊！

lines.en: You can!
lines.zh: 你能去！

lines.en: Bruna, I don't have the money or time to go to Peru. My deadline is tomorrow!
lines.zh: 布鲁娜，我没钱也没时间去秘鲁。我明天就截稿了！

lines.en: No, I don't mean to really go there. The museum where I work is having a Peruvian festival today! …. Anna? Anna? Anna, are you there?
lines.zh: 不，我不是说真的去那儿。我工作的博物馆今天在办秘鲁文化节！……安娜？安娜？安娜，你在吗？

lines.en: Hello again! Professor Bot here. Today we will hear about wishes and hopes. Bruna asked Anna to go to lunch, but she answered,
lines.zh: 大家好！我是机器人教授。今天我们来听听愿望和希望。布鲁娜请安娜去吃午饭，可她回答：

lines.en: I wish I could, but I can't. Listen for more hope and wish sentences.
lines.zh: I wish I could, but I can't. 注意听更多带 hope 和 wish 的句子。

lines.en: Hi, Anna!
lines.zh: 嗨，安娜！

lines.en: Hi, Bruna! Thanks for telling me about this event.
lines.zh: 嗨，布鲁娜！谢谢你告诉我这个活动。

lines.en: Sure! It's much better than staring at your computer. I hope it helps with your story.
lines.zh: 不客气！这比盯着电脑强多了。希望对你的报道有帮助。

lines.en: I'm sure it will. So, what should we see first?
lines.zh: 肯定有。那我们先看什么？

lines.en: Dance and music are very important to Peruvian culture, so let's watch the dancers.
lines.zh: 舞蹈和音乐对秘鲁文化非常重要，我们去看舞蹈吧。

lines.en: Great! Let's go!
lines.zh: 太好了！走吧！

lines.en: There's this very special Peruvian dance called Marinera Norteña.
lines.zh: 有一种很特别的秘鲁舞蹈叫 Marinera Norteña（北方马里内拉舞）。

lines.en: I love the Marinera Nortina… !
lines.zh: 我爱 Marinera Nortina……！

lines.en: Marinera Norteña.
lines.zh: Marinera Norteña。

lines.en: Marinera Norten… ?
lines.zh: Marinera Norten……？

lines.en: No. Marinera Norteña.
lines.zh: 不对，Marinera Norteña。

lines.en: I love the … marriage dance!
lines.zh: 我爱那个……婚礼舞！

lines.en: Bruna, I read about this dance. But it is much more romantic in person!
lines.zh: 布鲁娜，我读到过这种舞。可现场看浪漫多了！

lines.en: The dancers are giving lessons after their performance. You should try it!
lines.zh: 舞者们表演完会教课，你应该试试！

lines.en: I'd love to. But I'm not ready to get married. I mean, one day I hope to meet the right guy. We'll buy matching motorcycles and ride into the sunset -- the wind blowing through our hair!
lines.zh: 我很想试。可我还没准备好结婚。我是说，有一天我希望遇到对的人。我们会买配套的摩托车，骑向夕阳——风吹过我们的头发！

lines.en: Anna, the dance just shows the courtship tradition. It doesn't mean you will get married.
lines.zh: 安娜，这个舞只是展示求爱的传统，并不代表你要结婚。

lines.en: Oh. Well, I'll try anyway.
lines.zh: 哦。好吧，那我还是试试。

lines.en: Don't forget. This festival also shows Peruvian art!
lines.zh: 别忘了，这个文化节也展示秘鲁艺术！

lines.en: I hope I have time to see everything!
lines.zh: 希望我有时间把所有东西都看了！

lines.en: Anna, I wish I could join you. But I have some work to do.
lines.zh: 安娜，我真希望能陪你，可我还有工作要做。

lines.en: Of course, of course. You go back to work. I'll check out the art.
lines.zh: 当然，当然。你回去工作吧，我去看看艺术品。

lines.en: Okay, I'm hoping to finish in about an hour. Let's meet then.
lines.zh: 好，我希望大概一小时后能做完，到时候碰面。

lines.en: Great. See you then!
lines.zh: 好的，到时见！

lines.en: See ya!
lines.zh: 回见！

lines.en: Did you notice any sentences with hope or wish?
lines.zh: 你注意到带 hope 或 wish 的句子了吗？

lines.en: Anna says, "One day I hope to meet the right guy." That's an example of using "hope" with an infinitive to talk about doing something in the future. Keep watching!
lines.zh: 安娜说：“One day I hope to meet the right guy.”这是 hope 加不定式、谈论将来做某事的例子。继续看！

lines.en: Oh, wow! I can make my own Peruvian art!
lines.zh: 哦，哇！我可以自己做秘鲁艺术品！

lines.en: Anna, how's it going?
lines.zh: 安娜，怎么样了？

lines.en: Hi, Bruna!
lines.zh: 嗨，布鲁娜！

lines.en: You know you're in the kid's section, right?
lines.zh: 你知道你在儿童区吧？

lines.en: I'm in the art making section.
lines.zh: 我在艺术制作区。

lines.en: I see that. Your art is very nice. I wish I could do art like that.
lines.zh: 我看出来了。你的作品很好看。真希望我也能做出这样的艺术品。

lines.en: Oh, this one's not mine. This is mine.
lines.zh: 哦，这个不是我的。这个才是我的。

lines.en: Wow! Really? That's really nice!
lines.zh: 哇！真的？真好看！

lines.en: Thanks! And thanks for telling me about this festival. I learned so much about Peru. Ooh, we still have time!
lines.zh: 谢谢！也谢谢你告诉我这个文化节。我学到了好多关于秘鲁的东西。哦，我们还有时间！

lines.en: Time for what?
lines.zh: 有时间干什么？

lines.en: Time for Marinera Norteña!
lines.zh: 有时间跳 Marinera Norteña！

lines.en: Do you remember what Anna said? "I really want to understand Peru." I hope you understand Peru a little better now, too. And I wish I could talk with you more about grammar, but that's all the time we have today! Go to the website to learn more!
lines.zh: 还记得安娜说什么吗？“I really want to understand Peru.”我希望你现在也更了解秘鲁了。我真希望能和你多聊聊语法，可今天的时间就到这儿了！去网站了解更多吧！

qs.q: Why can't Anna go to lunch?
opts: She has to research Peru for a story.
qs.a: She has to research Peru for a story.
qs.why: "I have to research Peru for a story."

qs.q: Where is the Peruvian festival?
opts: at the museum where Bruna works
qs.a: at the museum where Bruna works
qs.why: "The museum where I work is having a Peruvian festival today!"

qs.q: Which sentence uses "hope" for the future?
opts: One day I hope to meet the right guy.
I wish I could, but I can't.
I wish I could do art like that.
qs.a: One day I hope to meet the right guy.
qs.why: hope + 不定式，谈论将来。

lessons.title: The Big Snow
lessons.zh: 大雪：现在完成时和过去完成时

lines.en: Hi, Anna. Why do you have all this weather stuff?
lines.zh: 嗨，安娜。你怎么有这么多天气相关的东西？

lines.en: I love weather.
lines.zh: 我爱天气。

lines.en: Me too! Weather is so important.
lines.zh: 我也是！天气太重要了。

lines.en: It is. It affects people's lives!
lines.zh: 是啊，它影响人们的生活！

lines.en: Have you ever reported on a big weather event?
lines.zh: 你报道过大的天气事件吗？

lines.en: I have. I've reported on a blizzard.
lines.zh: 报道过。我报道过一场暴风雪。

lines.en: Do mean the one last weekend?
lines.zh: 你是说上周末那场？

lines.en: Yes! I had been waiting for that blizzard for years. When it came, I was ready.
lines.zh: 对！那场暴风雪我已经等了好多年了。它来的时候，我早就准备好了。

lines.en: Welcome to our most perfect lesson! Why is it perfect? Today we are reviewing the present perfect and past perfect verb tenses. These show that an action is completed.
lines.zh: 欢迎来到我们最“完美”的一课！为什么完美？今天我们复习现在完成时和过去完成时（perfect tenses），它们表示一个动作已经完成。

lines.en: Kelly uses the present perfect when she says,
lines.zh: 凯莉用了现在完成时，她说：

lines.en: Have you ever reported on a big weather event?
lines.zh: 你报道过大的天气事件吗？

lines.en: Anna uses the past perfect when she says,
lines.zh: 安娜用了过去完成时，她说：

lines.en: I had been waiting for that blizzard for years.
lines.zh: 那场暴风雪我已经等了好多年了。

lines.en: Listen for "have" or "had" and the past participle to find more sentences with the perfect tense. I'll color those words to help you.
lines.zh: 注意听 have 或 had 加过去分词，找出更多完成时的句子。我会把这些词标上颜色帮你。

lines.en: I have wanted to report on a big weather event my whole life.
lines.zh: 我这辈子一直想报道一次大的天气事件。

lines.en: Who hasn't? Did you report all weekend ... by yourself?
lines.zh: 谁不想呢？你整个周末都在报道……就你一个人？

lines.en: No, no. I volunteered Pete to help me.
lines.zh: 不不，我“自愿”让皮特来帮我了。

lines.en: Why am I here on a Saturday? Why are you carrying things? Why? Why?
lines.zh: 我为什么周六在这儿？你为什么拿着东西？为什么？为什么？

lines.en: Pete, these are my supplies – food, a blanket; warm clothing. Where are your supplies?
lines.zh: 皮特，这些是我的补给——吃的、毯子、保暖衣服。你的补给呢？

lines.en: Pete, Pete, Pete. This could be the "blizzard of the century."
lines.zh: 皮特，皮特，皮特。这可能是“世纪暴风雪”。

lines.en: It'll be fine.
lines.zh: 不会有事的。

lines.en: How else had you prepared?
lines.zh: 你还做了什么准备？

lines.en: Well, I had just bought the latest weather forecasting software. So, I brought it!
lines.zh: 嗯，我刚买了最新的天气预报软件，所以就带来了！

lines.en: Do you mean The Weather Genie Pro?
lines.zh: 你是说“天气精灵专业版”？

lines.en: You know it. Pete thought it was pretty great too.
lines.zh: 可不是嘛。皮特也觉得它挺棒的。

lines.en: Do you have any games on that thing?
lines.zh: 那东西上有游戏吗？

lines.en: Yes! I have the best weather survival game. Boom!
lines.zh: 有！我有最好玩的天气求生游戏。轰！

lines.en: Sounds fun.
lines.zh: 听着挺好玩。

lines.en: It is. But right now, Pete, this computer is a work tool. It will give us the temperature, wind speed, wind direction and amount of snowfall … in real time! Boom, boom!
lines.zh: 是挺好玩。可现在，皮特，这台电脑是工作工具。它能实时告诉我们气温、风速、风向和降雪量！轰，轰！

lines.en: I can't wait.
lines.zh: 我等不及了。

lines.en: Pete, we need a name for this blizzard.
lines.zh: 皮特，我们得给这场暴风雪起个名字。

lines.en: No, we don't.
lines.zh: 不，不用。

lines.en: All the great storms have names.
lines.zh: 所有大风暴都有名字。

lines.en: No, they don't.
lines.zh: 不，没有。

lines.en: I know -- "The Big Snow!"
lines.zh: 我想到了——“大雪”！

lines.en: I am not saying "The Big Snow."
lines.zh: 我才不说“大雪”。

lines.en: Welcome to "The Big Snow."
lines.zh: 欢迎收看“大雪”。

lines.en: The Big Snow broke all kinds of records, didn't it?
lines.zh: 这场大雪打破了各种纪录，对吧？

lines.en: Yes it did. And every time a record was broken, we celebrated!
lines.zh: 是的。每次打破纪录，我们都庆祝一下！

lines.en: So far, in Washington, D.C. 29 inches of snow has fallen. That, my dear listeners, is a record! (Honks horn)
lines.zh: 到目前为止，华盛顿已经下了 29 英寸的雪。亲爱的听众们，这是一项纪录！（按喇叭）

lines.en: We just broke the wind speed record! (Honks horn)
lines.zh: 我们刚刚打破了风速纪录！（按喇叭）

lines.en: Snow has been falling for 30 hours straight! That's another record! (Honks horn. Pete comes into room and breaks the horn.)
lines.zh: 雪已经连续下了 30 个小时！又是一项纪录！（按喇叭。皮特进屋把喇叭弄坏了）

lines.en: By Saturday night, stores and restaurants had closed. Did you bring enough food?
lines.zh: 到周六晚上，商店和餐馆都关门了。你带够吃的了吗？

lines.en: I thought I had brought enough food. But I ran out.
lines.zh: 我以为我带够了，可还是吃完了。

lines.en: Hey, Pete, where is my bag of popcorn?
lines.zh: 嘿，皮特，我那袋爆米花呢？

lines.en: Maybe you ate it already.
lines.zh: 也许你已经吃了。

lines.en: No, I didn't.
lines.zh: 不，我没吃。

lines.en: I haven't seen it. (Pete has popcorn in his beard. Anna tries to hit him.)
lines.zh: 我没看见。（皮特的胡子上沾着爆米花。安娜想打他）

lines.en: We had reported together for 48 hours straight!
lines.zh: 我们俩一起连续报道了 48 个小时！

lines.en: Wow. That must have been a great team-building exercise for you and Pete.
lines.zh: 哇。那对你和皮特来说一定是很棒的团队建设练习。

lines.en: Yeah. You - you could say that.
lines.zh: 是啊。你——你可以这么说。

lines.en: I hope you found all the sentences with perfect tenses. Learn more on our website!
lines.zh: 希望你找到了所有用完成时的句子。去我们的网站了解更多！

qs.q: What did Anna report on?
qs.why: "I've reported on a blizzard."

qs.q: What name does Anna give the storm?
qs.why: "I know -- 'The Big Snow!'"

qs.q: Who ate Anna's popcorn?
qs.why: 皮特胡子上沾着爆米花。

lessons.title: Run! Bees!
lessons.zh: 快跑！蜜蜂！条件句

lines.en: Wow. Did you know that bees are dying?
lines.zh: 哇。你知道蜜蜂正在死去吗？

lines.en: That is bad news. If all the bees died, there would be no food. Bees are very important.
lines.zh: 那可是坏消息。如果蜜蜂都死了，就没有食物了。蜜蜂非常重要。

lines.en: (buzz sound)
lines.zh: （嗡嗡声）

lines.en: Yes, they are. Speaking of bees, one of our little friends is here now.
lines.zh: 是啊。说到蜜蜂，我们的一个小朋友现在就在这儿。

lines.en: You know, Anna, if you ignore it, it will fly away. But if you swat it, it might sting you.
lines.zh: 你知道吗，安娜，如果你不理它，它就会飞走。可如果你拍它，它可能会蛰你。

lines.en: I'll ignore it. I can ignore it. See, I'm ignoring it. (she is swatting at the bee)
lines.zh: 我不理它。我能不理它。看，我在不理它。（她在拍打蜜蜂）

lines.en: Anna, are you afraid of bees?
lines.zh: 安娜，你怕蜜蜂吗？

lines.en: What makes you say that?
lines.zh: 你为什么这么说？

lines.en: Anna, you should call my friend, Caroline. She is a beekeeper and a bee educator. If you talk to her, she'll probably help you get over your fear of bees.
lines.zh: 安娜，你应该给我朋友卡罗琳打个电话。她是养蜂人，也是蜜蜂科普老师。如果你跟她聊聊，她大概能帮你克服对蜜蜂的恐惧。

lines.en: I am not afraid of bees.
lines.zh: 我不怕蜜蜂。

lines.en: Here's her card.
lines.zh: 这是她的名片。

lines.en: Ahhh!
lines.zh: 啊啊啊！

lines.en: In this lesson, you can learn about conditionals. They have "if" and "will" or "would." There are two kinds of conditional sentences in this lesson.
lines.zh: 这一课你可以学条件句。条件句里有 if 和 will 或 would。这一课有两种条件句。

lines.en: Type 1 conditionals have a real event, and a result that probably will happen. Chances are good. Here is the pattern:
lines.zh: 第一类条件句：有一个真实的情况，以及很可能会发生的结果，可能性很大。句型是：

lines.en: If +present tense verb ... will + future tense verb.
lines.zh: If + 一般现在时动词……will + 动词原形（将来）。

lines.en: Kaveh uses this when he says: "If you ignore it, it will fly away."
lines.zh: 卡维说“If you ignore it, it will fly away.”时就用了这个句型。

lines.en: Type 2 conditionals have a possible event and a result that may or may not happen. We don't know. Here is the pattern:
lines.zh: 第二类条件句：有一个假设的情况，结果可能发生也可能不发生，我们不知道。句型是：

lines.en: If + past tense verb ...would + infinitive verb.
lines.zh: If + 过去式动词……would + 动词原形。

lines.en: Kaveh uses this pattern when he says, "If all the bees died, there would be no food."
lines.zh: 卡维说“If all the bees died, there would be no food.”时用了这个句型。

lines.en: Look for the "if" in a sentence to find more conditionals in today's lesson. I'll color them, too!
lines.zh: 在句子里找 if，就能找到本课更多的条件句。我也会把它们标上颜色！

lines.en: I think I'm at the wrong address. This does not look like a place where bees are kept. ​(knocks on door)
lines.zh: 我好像走错地址了。这儿看起来不像养蜂的地方。（敲门）

lines.en: Oh, sorry to bother you. I'm looking for beekeeper Caroline. I'm here to take her "Learn to Love Bees!" class.
lines.zh: 哦，抱歉打扰。我找养蜂人卡罗琳。我来上她的“学会爱上蜜蜂！”课。

lines.en: You're in the right place! I'm Caroline!
lines.zh: 你没走错！我就是卡罗琳！

lines.en: Oh, nice to meet you! Um, Caroline, I thought this class used real bees and real hives.
lines.zh: 哦，很高兴认识你！嗯，卡罗琳，我以为这门课用真蜜蜂、真蜂箱。

lines.en: It does! If you look in my backyard, you will see my bees! I'm a home beekeeper!
lines.zh: 是啊！如果你看看我家后院，就会看到我的蜜蜂！我是在家养蜂的！

lines.en: What? You live with bees? That is really amazing! And at the same time really scary.
lines.zh: 什么？你和蜜蜂住在一起？真了不起！同时也真吓人。

lines.en: It's not scary. If you come, I'll show you.
lines.zh: 不吓人。你过来，我带你看。

lines.en: Caroline, how many bees are in that hive?
lines.zh: 卡罗琳，那个蜂箱里有多少只蜜蜂？

lines.en: About thirty thousand (30,000) in each.
lines.zh: 每个大约三万只。

lines.en: What? That's amazing! But, aren't you afraid that they are gonna come out and kill you?
lines.zh: 什么？太惊人了！可你不怕它们出来把你蛰死吗？

lines.en: No, not at all, Anna. Even my children help me. Tell me, why are you afraid of bees?
lines.zh: 一点也不，安娜。连我的孩子都帮我。告诉我，你为什么怕蜜蜂？

lines.en: I don't know. Well, when I was a little girl my mom ran out of honey. And I really wanted honey for my pancakes. So, I climbed high into a tree and hit a beehive with a stick … several times. Then I reached inside with my bare hands to pull the honey out. That's when I got stung … a lot.
lines.zh: 我也不知道。嗯，我小时候，有一次我妈妈的蜂蜜吃完了。我特别想在煎饼上抹蜂蜜，就爬到很高的树上，用棍子打一个蜂窝……打了好几下。然后我空手伸进去掏蜂蜜。就是那时我被蛰了……蛰了好多下。

lines.en: Caroline, if you hit a beehive with a stick and reach inside, you might get stung.
lines.zh: 卡罗琳，如果你用棍子打蜂窝再把手伸进去，你可能会被蛰。

lines.en: No, Anna. If you do those things, you will get stung.
lines.zh: 不，安娜。如果你做了那些事，你一定会被蛰。

lines.en: Yes. I did.
lines.zh: 是的。我就被蛰了。

lines.en: And you know that it was your fault you got stung, don't you?
lines.zh: 你也知道被蛰是你自己的错，对吧？

lines.en: Yes. I did.
lines.zh: 是的。我知道。

lines.en: Bees know your feelings. And if you stay calm, the bees will be calm. If you're nervous, the bees will be nervous. And if bees are nervous, they may sting. So, please be calm.
lines.zh: 蜜蜂能感觉到你的情绪。如果你保持冷静，蜜蜂也会冷静。如果你紧张，蜜蜂也会紧张。蜜蜂一紧张，就可能蛰人。所以请保持冷静。

lines.en: I will be calm. I am calm. Okay, I'm ready. I'm ready
lines.zh: 我会冷静的。我很冷静。好，我准备好了。我准备好了。

lines.en: Great. Let's get our equipment on.
lines.zh: 很好。我们把装备穿上吧。

lines.en: Wait! Wait! I'm not ready! I'm nervous! Give me a minute to be calm.
lines.zh: 等等！等等！我还没准备好！我紧张！给我一分钟冷静一下。

lines.en: Are you ready for one more conditional sentence?
lines.zh: 准备好再听一个条件句了吗？

lines.en: If you are not afraid, you will join us next time to learn more about bees!
lines.zh: 如果你不害怕，下次就跟我们一起来多了解蜜蜂吧！

qs.q: Why is Anna afraid of bees?
opts: She got stung a lot as a little girl.
qs.a: She got stung a lot as a little girl.
qs.why: "That's when I got stung … a lot."

qs.q: How many bees are in each hive?
qs.why: "About thirty thousand (30,000) in each."

qs.q: Which is a Type 1 conditional?
opts: If you ignore it, it will fly away.
If all the bees died, there would be no food.
qs.a: If you ignore it, it will fly away.
qs.why: If + 一般现在时，will + 动词原形。

lessons.title: Save the Bees!
lessons.zh: 拯救蜜蜂！条件句（续）

lines.en: We are back with Anna and Caroline and the bees. Last time, Anna was afraid. (Anna: I'm not afraid of bees!) But Caroline is helping her to stay safe. Look at sentences that start with "If" to find more conditional sentences. Remember, Type 1 conditionals use the present tense and "will," and Type 2 use the past tense and "would." Now, let's find out what happens with Anna and the bees.
lines.zh: 我们又回到安娜、卡罗琳和蜜蜂这儿了。上次安娜很害怕。（安娜：我不怕蜜蜂！）不过卡罗琳正在帮她保证安全。找以 If 开头的句子，就能找到更多条件句。记住，第一类条件句用一般现在时和 will，第二类用过去式和 would。现在看看安娜和蜜蜂怎么样了。

lines.en: I have a feeling that your fear of bees will be gone soon. There are things beekeepers do to protect ourselves. For example, we wear protective clothing. This is a beekeeper's veil, suit and gloves. There are other things we can do, too. If I use a smoker, the bees will stay calm.
lines.zh: 我有种感觉，你对蜜蜂的恐惧很快就会消失。养蜂人有办法保护自己。比如，我们穿防护服。这是养蜂人的面纱、防护衣和手套。我们还能做别的事。如果我用喷烟器，蜜蜂就会保持安静。

lines.en: Let's use smoke … lots of smoke.
lines.zh: 那就用烟……用好多烟。

lines.en: Okay, Anna, that's enough smoke. Another thing you can do is stay calm. Okay. When I lift the frame, you will see the bees.
lines.zh: 好了，安娜，烟够了。你还可以做的一件事就是保持冷静。好。我把巢框提起来，你就能看到蜜蜂了。

lines.en: I'm ready. Let's do this thing!
lines.zh: 我准备好了。开始吧！

lines.en: Okay, let's put on our protective clothing.
lines.zh: 好，我们穿上防护服吧。

lines.en: I will carefully take out a frame. This is where the bees live. There are worker bees, drone bees and the queen bee. The bees have different jobs. The queen bee lays the eggs. The worker bees collect nectar and pollen ​from flowers and bring it back to the hive. Then they make honey! Now, you hold the frame. There are the bees.
lines.zh: 我要小心地拿出一个巢框。这就是蜜蜂住的地方。有工蜂、雄蜂和蜂王。蜜蜂分工不同。蜂王负责产卵。工蜂从花上采集花蜜和花粉带回蜂箱，然后酿成蜂蜜！现在你拿着巢框。蜜蜂就在那儿。

lines.en: There are so many! And they are so busy! Now I know why we say, "busy as a bee!"
lines.zh: 好多啊！它们好忙！现在我知道为什么我们说“像蜜蜂一样忙”了！

lines.en: Good job, Anna.
lines.zh: 做得好，安娜。

lines.en: Caroline, bees are beautiful and important. If I wanted to help the bees, what would I do?
lines.zh: 卡罗琳，蜜蜂又漂亮又重要。如果我想帮助蜜蜂，我该做什么？

lines.en: Great question. You can plant native flowers that bees like. Here's a book to help you know which ones to plant.
lines.zh: 好问题。你可以种蜜蜂喜欢的本地花。这本书能帮你知道该种哪些。

lines.en: It's a beautiful book. And look, it tells you which bees like which types of flowers.
lines.zh: 这本书真漂亮。你看，它还告诉你哪种蜜蜂喜欢哪种花。

lines.en: It also tells you how the flowers affect the flavor of the honey.
lines.zh: 它还告诉你花怎么影响蜂蜜的味道。

lines.en: Flowers make a big difference to bees. If they don't eat, they won't live.
lines.zh: 花对蜜蜂影响太大了。如果它们吃不上东西，就活不下去。

lines.en: Buying local honey also helps the bees. If you want to help bees, do those two things.
lines.zh: 买本地的蜂蜜也能帮助蜜蜂。如果你想帮蜜蜂，就做这两件事。

lines.en: I learned a lot about bees. Hey, if I worked with bees, I would not need protective clothing! Guess what? That was a Type 2 conditional. And I heard a Type 1 conditional, too. (Anna: If they don't eat, they won't live.)
lines.zh: 我学到了好多关于蜜蜂的知识。嘿，如果我和蜜蜂一起工作，我就不需要防护服！你猜怎么着？这是一个第二类条件句。我还听到了一个第一类条件句。（安娜：If they don't eat, they won't live.）

lines.en: Thanks for the book, Caroline, and the bee puppet and for teaching me about bees. Look … I'm not scared.
lines.zh: 谢谢你送我书和蜜蜂玩偶，也谢谢你教我认识蜜蜂，卡罗琳。看……我不害怕了。

lines.en: Good job, Anna. If you ever want to see the bees again, I'll be here! You have my business card. I'll let you see yourself out.
lines.zh: 做得好，安娜。如果你什么时候想再来看蜜蜂，我都在！你有我的名片。你自己出去吧，我就不送了。

lines.en: Thanks! Bye! I will plant tons of flowers!
lines.zh: 谢谢！再见！我要种好多好多花！

lines.en: Thanks, Anna. (bees spell out the words)
lines.zh: 谢谢你，安娜。（蜜蜂排成了文字）

lines.en: Sure thing, bees! Oh, and I'm sorry about hitting that hive when I was a little girl.
lines.zh: 不客气，蜜蜂们！哦，还有，我小时候打蜂窝的事，对不起。

lines.en: We love you, Anna. (bees make a heart sign.)
lines.zh: 我们爱你，安娜。（蜜蜂排成一个爱心）

lines.en: Take care, bees! (to herself) Which way is the Metro?
lines.zh: 保重，蜜蜂们！（自言自语）地铁站往哪儿走？

lines.en: That way. (they draw an arrow)
lines.zh: 那边。（它们排成一个箭头）

lines.en: Thanks!
lines.zh: 谢谢！

lines.en: So, if I you want to learn more about bees, visit your local beekeeper like Anna did. Maybe you can try some local honey, too.
lines.zh: 所以，如果你想多了解蜜蜂，就像安娜一样去拜访当地的养蜂人吧。也许你还能尝尝本地蜂蜜。

lines.en: Now it's your turn. Practice making conditional sentences. If you practice, you will become better at them. That's type 1!
lines.zh: 现在轮到你了。练习造条件句吧。如果你多练习，你就会越来越好。这就是第一类！

qs.q: What does a smoker do?
qs.why: "If I use a smoker, the bees will stay calm."

qs.q: What does the queen bee do?
qs.why: "The queen bee lays the eggs."

qs.q: How can you help bees?
opts: plant native flowers and buy local honey
qs.a: plant native flowers and buy local honey
qs.why: "If you want to help bees, do those two things."

lessons.title: Made for Each Other
lessons.zh: 天生一对：so、either 连接句子

lines.en: Hello! What are you guys looking at?
lines.zh: 你们好！你们在看什么呢？

lines.en: I'm showing Ashley pictures of my girlfriend. We have so much in common -- even small things. She can't whistle and I can't either.
lines.zh: 我在给阿什莉看我女朋友的照片。我们有好多共同点——连小事都一样。她不会吹口哨，我也不会。

lines.en: (to Pete) And here's a picture of my boyfriend. (sighs)
lines.zh: （对皮特）这是我男朋友的照片。（叹气）

lines.en: My family is big and so is his. I don't like ball sports and he doesn't either! (sighs) We are made for each other ...
lines.zh: 我家人口多，他家也是。我不喜欢球类运动，他也不喜欢！（叹气）我们是天生一对……

lines.en: … and so are we. (sighs)
lines.zh: ……我们也是。（叹气）

lines.en: Uh… you have found perfect partners … and so have I!
lines.zh: 呃……你们都找到了完美的另一半……我也找到了！

lines.en: Pete and Ashley are talking about people they love. They are putting two ideas together with connectors.
lines.zh: 皮特和阿什莉在谈论他们爱的人。他们用连接词把两个意思连在一起。

lines.en: Let's start with these two sentences: She can't whistle. Pete can't whistle. How do you put them together?
lines.zh: 我们从这两个句子开始：She can't whistle. Pete can't whistle. 怎么把它们连起来？

lines.en: Pete says, "She can't whistle and I can't either."
lines.zh: 皮特说：“She can't whistle and I can't either.”

lines.en: You can see we just add the conjunction "either" and take away the verb "whistle." And Ashley says: "I don't like ball sports and he doesn't either!"
lines.zh: 你看，我们只是加上 either，并省去动词 whistle。阿什莉也说：“I don't like ball sports and he doesn't either!”

lines.en: Keep looking for connectors!
lines.zh: 继续找连接词！

lines.en: You met someone, Anna? That's great! What's his name?
lines.zh: 你遇到喜欢的人了，安娜？太好了！他叫什么名字？

lines.en: His name? His name is uh… (stalling, looks around, sees a bus) Bus … ter. (stalling, looks around, sees a car) Car … ter.
lines.zh: 他的名字？他的名字是，呃……（拖延时间，四处看，看到一辆公交车）巴斯……特。（拖延，四处看，看到一辆汽车）卡……特。

lines.en: (says it like Anna did) Bus...ter Car...ter?
lines.zh: （学安娜的语气）巴斯……特·卡……特？

lines.en: It's just Buster Carter, Ashley. I like him and he likes me. We're a great couple.
lines.zh: 就叫巴斯特·卡特，阿什莉。我喜欢他，他也喜欢我。我们是很棒的一对。

lines.en: Hey, let's all get dinner tonight, together. You can bring Buster.
lines.zh: 嘿，今晚我们一起吃晚饭吧。你可以带上巴斯特。

lines.en: (laughing) Yeah, I can't wait to meet him.
lines.zh: （笑）是啊，我等不及要见他了。

lines.en: Thanks, Ashley, but he's really busy tonight with his uh, (looks around, sees squirrel) squirrel collection. Bye, guys! Gotta go!
lines.zh: 谢谢你，阿什莉，可他今晚很忙，要弄他的，呃，（四处看，看到松鼠）松鼠收藏。再见，伙计们！我得走了！

lines.en: Squirrel collection?
lines.zh: 松鼠收藏？

lines.en: You know, she made all that up.
lines.zh: 你知道吧，那都是她编的。

lines.en: That's so sad. She needs to meet someone. Hey, do you know anyone who she might...
lines.zh: 真让人难过。她需要遇到一个人。嘿，你认不认识谁可能……

lines.en: No.
lines.zh: 不认识。

lines.en: (to herself) Anna, Anna, you lied! You lied! Now, they think you have a boyfriend - with a squirrel collection. Here, squirrel. (throws food) Well, you need to tell them the truth. You don't have a boyfriend.
lines.zh: （自言自语）安娜，安娜，你撒谎了！你撒谎了！现在他们以为你有个收藏松鼠的男朋友。给，松鼠。（扔食物）好吧，你得告诉他们真相。你没有男朋友。

lines.en: Excuse me, is this seat taken?
lines.zh: 打扰一下，这个座位有人吗？

lines.en: (Anna shyly shakes head "no")
lines.zh: （安娜害羞地摇头表示“没有”）

lines.en: Ashley, Pete, I need to talk to you. This morning, I lied.
lines.zh: 阿什莉、皮特，我得跟你们说件事。今天早上我撒谎了。

lines.en: Let me guess. There's no Buster Carter. What a surprise!
lines.zh: 我猜猜。根本没有巴斯特·卡特。真是“意外”啊！

lines.en: I'm sorry. But later I really did meet someone and we have a lot in common!
lines.zh: 对不起。可后来我真的遇到了一个人，我们有好多共同点！

lines.en: He's good at flying kites and so am I.
lines.zh: 他擅长放风筝，我也是。

lines.en: He likes to read comics and so do I.
lines.zh: 他喜欢看漫画，我也是。

lines.en: I can play the ukulele and so can he.
lines.zh: 我会弹尤克里里，他也会。

lines.en: He sounds perfect for you, Anna. Can he come tonight?
lines.zh: 他听起来跟你很配，安娜。他今晚能来吗？

lines.en: That's the sad part. You see, he just got a job as a spy, and tonight he leaves on assignment.
lines.zh: 这就是让人难过的地方。你们看，他刚找了份间谍的工作，今晚就要出任务了。

lines.en: Of course he does.
lines.zh: 当然了。

lines.en: But that's okay, because now I know that there is someone out there made for me. (looks at the time) Oh, it's late! I have to see him off at the train station. Bye, you guys!
lines.zh: 不过没关系，因为现在我知道世上有一个为我而生的人。（看时间）哦，这么晚了！我得去火车站送他。再见，伙计们！

lines.en: Bye Anna! Oh dear, she's worse than we thought.
lines.zh: 再见，安娜！天哪，她比我们想的还糟。

lines.en: She's lost her mind.
lines.zh: 她疯了。

lines.en: What should we do?
lines.zh: 我们该怎么办？

lines.en: (happy, excited) Let's tell her!
lines.zh: （又高兴又兴奋）我们告诉她吧！

lines.en: (Pete goes to leave but Ashley pulls him back.)
lines.zh: （皮特要走，阿什莉把他拉了回来。）

lines.en: No, Pete. Mr. Right may not be real but he makes her really happy.
lines.zh: 不，皮特。真命天子也许不是真的，可他让她很开心。

lines.en: Did you find any other connectors? Notice how the words are in a different order in the part after "so." "I am" becomes "am I" and "he can" becomes "can he."
lines.zh: 你找到别的连接词了吗？注意 so 后面的词序不一样了。“I am”变成了“am I”，“he can”变成了“can he”。

lines.en: "He's good at flying kites and so am I. I can play the ukulele and so can he."
lines.zh: “He's good at flying kites and so am I. I can play the ukulele and so can he.”

qs.q: What do Pete and his girlfriend have in common?
qs.why: "She can't whistle and I can't either."

qs.q: Does Buster Carter really exist?
qs.why: "This morning, I lied."

qs.q: Complete: "He likes to read comics and so ___ I."
qs.why: likes 是实义动词，用 do。

lessons.title: Before and After
lessons.zh: 之前和之后：状语从句

lines.en: Penelope, even though we both love speed walking, could we slow down a bit?
lines.zh: 佩内洛普，虽然我们俩都爱竞走，能不能慢一点？

lines.en: No way! I think because I'm walking with you, I'm walking faster.
lines.zh: 不行！我觉得因为跟你一起走，我才走得更快。

lines.en: Come on, Penelope. Let's take a break. We've been speed walking since 8 a.m.! You're so competitive! You even wore your medals!
lines.zh: 拜托，佩内洛普，我们休息一下吧。我们从早上 8 点就开始竞走了！你好胜心太强了！连奖牌都戴上了！

lines.en: You brought your trophies! You're out of shape. When we were little girls, we could speed walk all day! (pulls ahead)
lines.zh: 你还带了奖杯呢！你体能变差了。我们小时候能竞走一整天！（超到前面）

lines.en: (chases her) Hey, wait for me! Hey, you know the speed walking rules! If both feet leave the ground, it's running! You ran!
lines.zh: （追她）嘿，等等我！嘿，你知道竞走规则！要是两只脚都离地，那就是跑！你跑了！

lines.en: Anna and Penelope are doing something they both love - speed walking!
lines.zh: 安娜和佩内洛普正在做她们俩都爱的事——竞走！

lines.en: They are also using adverb clauses.
lines.zh: 她们还在用状语从句。

lines.en: Adverb clauses tell us when, why, how, where and under what conditions.
lines.zh: 状语从句告诉我们何时、为什么、怎样、在哪里以及在什么条件下。

lines.en: For example, "since 8 a.m." tells us when.
lines.zh: 比如“since 8 a.m.”告诉我们时间。

lines.en: Adverb clauses are dependent clauses and need an independent clause to make a complete sentence.
lines.zh: 状语从句是从属分句，需要一个主句才能组成完整的句子。

lines.en: Words like before, after, when, because, since, if and even though can signal an adverb clause.
lines.zh: before、after、when、because、since、if 和 even though 这样的词可以引出状语从句。

lines.en: Keep watching for more adverb clauses!
lines.zh: 继续看，找更多状语从句！

lines.en: Whew! That was great!
lines.zh: 呼！太爽了！

lines.en: (Anna catches up) Wow, Penelope, you're still really fast! Since I've been working in an office, my speed walking has been much slower.
lines.zh: （安娜追上来）哇，佩内洛普，你还是这么快！自从我在办公室上班以来，我竞走慢多了。

lines.en: You are slower, Anna. Maybe you should hire a personal trainer.
lines.zh: 你是慢了，安娜。也许你该请个私人教练。

lines.en: That will be great. As long as the trainer understands speed walking.
lines.zh: 那太好了。只要教练懂竞走就行。

lines.en: (hands her a business card) Try this company. After you fill out an online application, they will match you to the perfect trainer.
lines.zh: （递给她一张名片）试试这家公司。你在网上填完申请之后，他们会给你匹配最合适的教练。

lines.en: As soon as I get home tonight, I'll do it! Thanks.
lines.zh: 我今晚一到家就去填！谢谢。

lines.en: Are you my trainer?
lines.zh: 你是我的教练吗？

lines.en: If you're Anna, then I'm your trainer -- Alaskan Albert. Because I'm from Alaskan wilderness, I'm skilled in all outdoor activities of the wild.
lines.zh: 如果你是安娜，那我就是你的教练——阿拉斯加阿尔伯特。因为我来自阿拉斯加的荒野，所有野外户外活动我都擅长。

lines.en: That's great but what about speed walking?
lines.zh: 那很好，可竞走呢？

lines.en: Speed walking? That's funny! Since I've been living in the city, I've combined wilderness training with a city workout. I call it "Call of the Wild Parkour!" (He howls like a wolf.)
lines.zh: 竞走？真好笑！自从我住到城里，我就把荒野训练和城市健身结合了起来。我管它叫“野性的呼唤跑酷”！（他像狼一样嚎叫）

lines.en: Okay … but seriously, when do we speed walk?
lines.zh: 好吧……可说真的，我们什么时候竞走？

lines.en: Your application did not say how funny you are!
lines.zh: 你的申请表上可没写你这么幽默！

lines.en: No. But it did say that I'm a speed walker! Did you read it? Forget it. We'll have to cancel.
lines.zh: 没写。可上面确实写了我是竞走的！你看了吗？算了。我们得取消。

lines.en: Why?
lines.zh: 为什么？

lines.en: We can't train today because it's too cold and too windy.
lines.zh: 今天没法训练，因为太冷、风太大了。

lines.en: No way! No pain, no gain! When you exercise in really cold weather, you feel alive!
lines.zh: 不行！不吃苦，没收获！在特别冷的天气里锻炼，你会觉得自己活力满满！

lines.en: Really? Because right now I just feel cold.
lines.zh: 真的吗？因为我现在只觉得冷。

lines.en: You're so funny. But seriously, after our training, you will be ready for any extreme physical challenge. Let's get started!
lines.zh: 你真幽默。不过说真的，我们训练之后，你就能应对任何极限体能挑战了。开始吧！

lines.en: (He leads Anna through some parkour exercises.)
lines.zh: （他带着安娜做跑酷练习。）

lines.en: Anna, even though you're trying really hard, you're really bad at Call of the Wild Parkour. (he howls)
lines.zh: 安娜，虽然你很努力，可你“野性的呼唤跑酷”做得真差。（他嚎叫）

lines.en: I'm bad at Call of the Wild Parkour because I don't want to do Call of the Wild Parkour! (she howls) I am a speed walker. It's what I do. It's part of who I am.
lines.zh: 我跑酷做得差，是因为我根本不想做“野性的呼唤跑酷”！（她嚎叫）我是竞走的。这是我做的事，是我的一部分。

lines.en: Why didn't you say something?
lines.zh: 你怎么不早说？

lines.en: I did. Several times! You thought I was joking.
lines.zh: 我说了，说了好几遍！你以为我在开玩笑。

lines.en: Now I understand. Anna, I can help you., if you follow my advice, I'll put the speed back in your speed walk.
lines.zh: 现在我明白了。安娜，我能帮你。如果你听我的建议，我会让你的竞走重新快起来。

lines.en: (He shows her how to improve her speed walking)
lines.zh: （他教她怎么提高竞走速度）

lines.en: Go, Anna, go!
lines.zh: 加油，安娜，加油！

lines.en: For more about adverb clauses, visit our website!
lines.zh: 想了解更多状语从句，请访问我们的网站！

qs.q: What sport do Anna and Penelope love?
qs.why: "we both love speed walking"

qs.q: What does Alaskan Albert teach at first?
qs.why: "I call it 'Call of the Wild Parkour!'"

qs.q: Which word can signal an adverb clause?
qs.why: before、after、when、because、since、if、even though。

lessons.title: Find Your Joy!
lessons.zh: 找到你的快乐！used to 和 would

lines.en: Hi, Kaveh! Let's go to lunch!
lines.zh: 嗨，卡维！我们去吃午饭吧！

lines.en: Ooh, I know a great place. When I first started working here, I would go every day!
lines.zh: 哦，我知道一个好地方。我刚来这儿上班的时候，每天都去！

lines.en: Great. Oh, no.
lines.zh: 太好了。哦，糟了。

lines.en: What's wrong?
lines.zh: 怎么了？

lines.en: I lost my key! I just had it this morning.
lines.zh: 我的钥匙丢了！今天早上还在呢。

lines.en: You should check the Lost & Found office.
lines.zh: 你应该去失物招领处看看。

lines.en: Great idea. Where is it?
lines.zh: 好主意。在哪儿？

lines.en: Oh, it used to be across from the cafeteria. But now it's down in the basement next to the elevators. It's really hard to find.
lines.zh: 哦，以前在食堂对面。可现在搬到地下室电梯旁边了。特别难找。

lines.en: The Lost & Found is hard to find. That's funny.
lines.zh: 失物招领处很难找。真好笑。

lines.en: It is.
lines.zh: 是挺好笑。

lines.en: I hope Anna can find the Lost & Found office!
lines.zh: 希望安娜能找到失物招领处！

lines.en: Used to and would describe something that happened repeatedly in the past.
lines.zh: used to 和 would 都描述过去反复发生的事。

lines.en: Kaveh uses would when he says, "When I first started working here, I would go every day!
lines.zh: 卡维说“When I first started working here, I would go every day!”时用了 would。

lines.en: There are two differences between used to and would.
lines.zh: used to 和 would 有两点区别。

lines.en: We use would only when we say the time period first.
lines.zh: 第一：只有先说出时间段时才用 would。

lines.en: For verbs like be, think, feel, see and understand, we can only use used to.
lines.zh: 第二：be、think、feel、see、understand 这类动词只能用 used to。

lines.en: Kaveh says, "It used to be across from the cafeteria."
lines.zh: 卡维说：“It used to be across from the cafeteria.”

lines.en: Keep listening for more!
lines.zh: 继续听，找更多！

lines.en: (A worker moves the sign for the Lost & Found office. So, Anna walks into the wrong office without knowing it.)
lines.zh: （一个工人挪动了失物招领处的牌子，所以安娜不知不觉走进了错误的办公室。）

lines.en: Come in! I am Serenity.
lines.zh: 请进！我是塞莲妮蒂。

lines.en: Hi, Serenity. I'm Anna!
lines.zh: 嗨，塞莲妮蒂。我是安娜！

lines.en: Please, sit down. How can I help you?
lines.zh: 请坐。我能帮你什么？

lines.en: I lost something very important.
lines.zh: 我丢了很重要的东西。

lines.en: Shh. I already know. You need help.
lines.zh: 嘘。我已经知道了。你需要帮助。

lines.en: Yes. I need help finding the key …
lines.zh: 是的。我需要帮忙找钥匙……

lines.en: Shh. You need to find the key – the key that will give you happiness.
lines.zh: 嘘。你需要找到钥匙——那把能给你带来幸福的钥匙。

lines.en: Yes. Finding this key will make me very happy.
lines.zh: 是的。找到这把钥匙我会非常开心。
