lines.en: First, Anna, let me tell you a little bit about myself.
lines.zh: 首先，安娜，让我先讲讲我自己。

lines.en: Okay.
lines.zh: 好的。

lines.en: I used to be a very important person with a very important job. I made a lot of money -- I mean a lot.
lines.zh: 我以前是个很重要的人，有一份很重要的工作。我赚了很多钱——我是说很多。

lines.en: Wow. Good for you!
lines.zh: 哇。真为你高兴！

lines.en: No! No, it was bad for me. I lost the most important thing – the key! You've lost it too, haven't you, Anna? Haven't you?
lines.zh: 不！不，那对我不好。我丢了最重要的东西——钥匙！你也丢了，对吧，安娜？是不是？

lines.en: I guess. So, how does this work? Do I have to fill out a form or something?
lines.zh: 大概吧。那这个怎么弄？我要填表什么的吗？

lines.en: No. No forms. Just answer this one question: As a child, what did you use to do to feel happy?
lines.zh: 不用。不用填表。只要回答一个问题：小时候，你以前常做什么让自己开心？

lines.en: When I was little, I used to sing all the time with my family. Those were good times.
lines.zh: 我小时候常常和家人一起唱歌。那是一段美好时光。

lines.en: Singing is so joyful! I used to sing. But now that I've started my business, I've just been too busy. Too busy! Anna, why don't you sing again?
lines.zh: 唱歌太快乐了！我以前也唱歌。可自从开始创业，我就太忙了。太忙了！安娜，你为什么不再唱起来呢？

lines.en: I sing everywhere! I sing in the office. I sing on the metro. I sing in the elevators. I sing on the escalators. I sing in the bathroom. Serenity! Serenity! I really need to find my key. Yeah!
lines.zh: 我到处唱！我在办公室唱，在地铁上唱，在电梯里唱，在扶梯上唱，在卫生间唱。塞莲妮蒂！塞莲妮蒂！我真的得找到我的钥匙。耶！

lines.en: Yes, we need to find the key … the key to happiness.
lines.zh: 是的，我们需要找到钥匙……幸福的钥匙。

lines.en: No, no. I just need to find the key to my apartment.
lines.zh: 不不。我只需要找到我公寓的钥匙。

lines.en: I used to know. But now I don't! Do you, Anna?
lines.zh: 我以前知道它在哪儿。可现在不知道了！你知道吗，安娜？

lines.en: I don't know. I think I left it in the ladies' room. You know, this isn't the Lost & Found, is it?
lines.zh: 我不知道。我想我把它落在女卫生间了。你知道吗，这儿不是失物招领处，对吧？

lines.en: (Anna starts walking out of the room)
lines.zh: （安娜开始往外走）

lines.en: It could be the Lost & Found. I'm lost! And I used to find joy for people! I used to find joy!
lines.zh: 这儿可以是失物招领处。我迷失了！我以前为人们找到快乐！我以前能找到快乐！

lines.en: You know, this is a bad time for you. I'll find the Lost & Found myself. Bye, thanks.
lines.zh: 你知道吗，你现在状态不好。我自己去找失物招领处吧。再见，谢谢。

lines.en: I used to find joy. I used to find joy! I used to find joy!
lines.zh: 我以前能找到快乐。我以前能找到快乐！我以前能找到快乐！

lines.en: Ah, I found my key!
lines.zh: 啊，我找到钥匙了！

lines.en: I used to find joy!
lines.zh: 我以前能找到快乐！

lines.en: Oh no. Serenity lost her joy. But at least Anna found her key! Check out our website for more!
lines.zh: 哦不。塞莲妮蒂丢了她的快乐。不过至少安娜找到了钥匙！去我们的网站看更多吧！

qs.q: Where is the Lost & Found office now?
opts: in the basement next to the elevators
qs.a: in the basement next to the elevators
qs.why: "now it's down in the basement next to the elevators."

qs.q: What did Anna use to do as a child to feel happy?
qs.why: "I used to sing all the time with my family."

qs.q: Which verb can only use "used to", not "would"?
qs.why: be、think、feel 等状态动词只能用 used to。

lessons.title: Flour Baby, Part 1
lessons.zh: 面粉宝宝（上）：反身代词

lines.en: Anna, Pete, I have a new assignment for you -- a show on single parents! What is it like for a mother or a father to raise a child by herself or himself?
lines.zh: 安娜、皮特，我给你们一个新任务——做一期关于单亲父母的节目！一个妈妈或爸爸独自抚养孩子是什么样的？

lines.en: We can interview single parents. They can share their experiences themselves.
lines.zh: 我们可以采访单亲父母，让他们自己讲讲经历。

lines.en: Yes, but you need to experience parenthood yourselves.
lines.zh: 是的，可你们得亲自体验一下当父母。

lines.en: Ourselves?
lines.zh: 我们自己？

lines.en: Yeah, how do we do that? We're not parents.
lines.zh: 是啊，怎么体验？我们又不是父母。

lines.en: I asked myself the same question. I said, "Caty, how are they gonna do that?" Then an idea came to me. I will give you the babies!
lines.zh: 我也问过自己同样的问题。我说：“凯蒂，他们怎么做到呢？”然后我想到一个主意。我给你们宝宝！

lines.en: You may be asking yourself the same thing that I'm asking myself: what is Ms. Weaver talking about!? I am sure we will find out shortly.
lines.zh: 你可能也在问自己我正在问自己的问题：韦弗女士在说什么？！我相信我们很快就会知道。

lines.en: This lesson teaches reflexive pronouns.
lines.zh: 这一课教反身代词。

lines.en: Reflexive pronouns refer back to the subject of a sentence or clause. We use them when the subject and the object are the same person or thing.
lines.zh: 反身代词指回句子或分句的主语。当主语和宾语是同一个人或物时，我们就用它。

lines.en: For example, Ms. Weaver says, "I asked myself the same question."
lines.zh: 比如，韦弗女士说：“I asked myself the same question.”

lines.en: "I" is the subject and "myself" refers back to it. Here, she would not use the pronoun "me." You need to use the reflexive pronoun "myself."
lines.zh: “I”是主语，“myself”指回它。这里她不会用代词 me，而要用反身代词 myself。

lines.en: Reflexive pronouns are easy to find: they end in "self" or "selves." I have a feeling we are going to see a lot of reflexive pronouns. Listen for them!
lines.zh: 反身代词很好找：它们以 self 或 selves 结尾。我有种感觉，我们会看到很多反身代词。注意听！

lines.en: (Pete and Anna continue their meeting with Ms. Weaver. She puts two bags of flour on the table. Pete and Anna still look confused.)
lines.zh: （皮特和安娜继续和韦弗女士开会。她把两袋面粉放在桌上。皮特和安娜还是一脸困惑。）

lines.en: Here are your babies!
lines.zh: 这是你们的宝宝！

lines.en: Those are bags of flour.
lines.zh: 那是两袋面粉。

lines.en: No, Pete, for the next six days, this is your baby. Here are your instructions. Do not leave your babies alone. A baby cannot take care of itself. And you two must do everything by yourselves.
lines.zh: 不，皮特，接下来六天，这就是你的宝宝。这是说明：不要把宝宝单独留下。宝宝不能照顾自己。你们两个必须一切都自己来。

lines.en: We will meet next Friday. Oh, and the person who does the best research will get an extra day of vacation. Help yourself to a baby.
lines.zh: 我们下周五见。哦，研究做得最好的人可以多放一天假。自己拿一个宝宝吧。

lines.en: Pete, look, my baby is organic and whole grain. Your baby is ordinary.
lines.zh: 皮特，看，我的宝宝是有机全麦的。你的宝宝很普通。

lines.en: (Pete pushes her flour baby off desk.)
lines.zh: （皮特把她的面粉宝宝推下了桌子。）

lines.en: (to Pete) Monster! (to Caty) This is a great idea, Ms. Weaver!
lines.zh: （对皮特）恶魔！（对凯蒂）这个主意太棒了，韦弗女士！

lines.en: (Pete and Anna are now outside.)
lines.zh: （皮特和安娜现在在外面。）

lines.en: This is a terrible idea.
lines.zh: 这个主意糟透了。

lines.en: Speak for yourself, Pete! We need to throw ourselves into the research! I'm starting right now!
lines.zh: 那是你自己的看法，皮特！我们得全身心投入研究！我现在就开始！

lines.en: (She leaves but forgets her Flour Baby.)
lines.zh: （她走了，却忘了她的面粉宝宝。）

lines.en: Hey Anna, you forgot your baby!
lines.zh: 嘿，安娜，你忘了你的宝宝！

lines.en: (She turns and looks at Pete.)
lines.zh: （她转身看着皮特。）

lines.en: Come to mama!
lines.zh: 到妈妈这儿来！

lines.en: (The bag of flour flies at her. She catches it.)
lines.zh: （面粉袋飞向她，她接住了。）

lines.en: Good girl! Good girl!
lines.zh: 好女孩！好女孩！

lines.en: Singular reflexive pronouns end in "self." Plural ones end in "selves."
lines.zh: 单数反身代词以 self 结尾，复数的以 selves 结尾。

lines.en: Anna says, "We need to throw ourselves into the research!" The subject "we" is plural. So, we must use the plural reflexive pronoun "ourselves."
lines.zh: 安娜说：“We need to throw ourselves into the research!”主语 we 是复数，所以必须用复数反身代词 ourselves。

lines.en: (The parenting research begins. Anna tries to open a baby stroller but can't. A man walking by helps her. She pushes Flour Baby in the stroller but it falls out. On another day, she jogs with it. After several days, she is tired!)
lines.zh: （育儿研究开始了。安娜想打开婴儿车却打不开，一个路过的男人帮了她。她推着面粉宝宝，可宝宝掉了出来。又有一天，她带着它慢跑。几天后，她累坏了！）

lines.en: This is hard! I hope Pete is not doing well. I really need that vacation day!
lines.zh: 太难了！希望皮特做得不好。我真的很需要那天假期！

lines.en: We will all see how Pete is doing in the next episode. We'll also learn when not to use reflexive pronouns.
lines.zh: 下一集我们会看看皮特做得怎么样。我们还会学什么时候不用反身代词。

qs.q: What are the "babies"?
qs.why: "Those are bags of flour."

qs.q: What will the person with the best research get?
qs.why: "will get an extra day of vacation."

qs.q: Which is a plural reflexive pronoun?
qs.why: 复数以 selves 结尾。

lessons.title: Flour Baby, Part 2
lessons.zh: 面粉宝宝（下）：什么时候不用反身代词

lines.en: In Part 1 of this two-part lesson, Ms. Weaver gave Anna and Pete an assignment. Ms. Weaver instructed them to do everything by themselves.
lines.zh: 在这个两集课程的上集里，韦弗女士给安娜和皮特布置了任务，要求他们一切都自己来（by themselves）。

lines.en: "Themselves" is a reflexive pronoun.
lines.zh: “themselves”是一个反身代词。

lines.en: In today's lesson, Ms. Weaver will look at Pete's and Anna's research. First, let's see Pete's experiment.
lines.zh: 今天这课，韦弗女士要看皮特和安娜的研究。先看看皮特的实验。

lines.en: (Pete throws the bag of flour on his chair and throws many other things on his flour baby. Next, we see him outside enjoying ice-cream without his flour baby.)
lines.zh: （皮特把面粉袋扔在椅子上，又往面粉宝宝身上扔了一堆东西。接着我们看到他在外面吃冰淇淋，没带面粉宝宝。）

lines.en: Okay, Pete, let me see your research first.
lines.zh: 好，皮特，先让我看看你的研究。

lines.en: (Pete hands her a big binder filled with research.)
lines.zh: （皮特递给她一个装满研究资料的大文件夹。）

lines.en: That's a heavy binder. And you and your Baby look great.
lines.zh: 好重的文件夹。你和你的宝宝看起来都很好。

lines.en: Thanks, Ms. Weaver. We feel great!
lines.zh: 谢谢，韦弗女士。我们感觉很好！

lines.en: Anna. Anna, you're next. Anna? Anna wake up!
lines.zh: 安娜。安娜，该你了。安娜？安娜，醒醒！

lines.en: (She wakes up but is very confused.)
lines.zh: （她醒了，可一脸迷糊。）

lines.en: I'm here, Baby! I'm here! I'm here! Here's your bottle.
lines.zh: 我在这儿，宝宝！我在这儿！我在这儿！这是你的奶瓶。

lines.en: (She accidentally squirts her bottle and milk goes everywhere.)
lines.zh: （她不小心挤了奶瓶，牛奶溅得到处都是。）

lines.en: Anna, you and your baby look awful. What happened?
lines.zh: 安娜，你和你的宝宝看起来糟透了。怎么回事？

lines.en: Well, I took her everywhere. Everywhere. And I fed her every three hours. So, I haven't slept since … what day is it?
lines.zh: 嗯，我带着她到处走。到处走。我每三个小时喂她一次。所以我从……今天星期几？……就没睡过觉了。

lines.en: It's Friday. What happened there?
lines.zh: 今天星期五。那儿怎么了？

lines.en: (Ms. Weaver points to a large bandage on Anna's flour baby.)
lines.zh: （韦弗女士指着安娜面粉宝宝身上的一大块绷带。）

lines.en: Oh, that. Oh, that. I was making myself a salad and had a little accident with a knife. I put my flour baby in front of me. And then I accidentally stabbed it. But I gave it First Aid!
lines.zh: 哦，那个。哦，那个啊。我给自己做沙拉时，用刀出了点小意外。我把面粉宝宝放在我面前，然后不小心戳到了它。不过我给它做了急救！

lines.en: Is that a burn?
lines.zh: 那是烧伤吗？

lines.en: Yes. Yes it is. While I was making myself dinner, I put Baby next to me. I accidentally knocked her into the sink. So I put her in the microwave to dry. That's when she caught fire.
lines.zh: 是的，是的。我给自己做晚饭时，把宝宝放在我旁边。我不小心把她碰进了水槽，所以就把她放进微波炉烘干。然后她就着火了。

lines.en: (Pete smiles, thinking he's won.)
lines.zh: （皮特笑了，以为自己赢了。）

lines.en: Okay. So, we use a reflexive pronoun when it refers to the subject of a sentence or clause.
lines.zh: 好了。我们在反身代词指回句子或分句的主语时使用它。

lines.en: But we DON'T use a reflexive pronoun with prepositions of place.
lines.zh: 但是在表示地点的介词后面不用反身代词。

lines.en: Anna uses examples of both in one sentence: While I was making myself dinner, I put Baby next to me.
lines.zh: 安娜在一句话里同时用了两种情况：While I was making myself dinner, I put Baby next to me.

lines.en: We use a reflexive pronoun in the first part of the sentence. "Myself" refers to the subject "I."
lines.zh: 句子前半部分用了反身代词，myself 指回主语 I。

lines.en: But in the second part of the sentence, we don't use a reflexive pronoun in the prepositional phrase. We use the pronoun "me." Why? "next to" is a preposition of place.
lines.zh: 但在后半部分的介词短语里，我们不用反身代词，而用代词 me。为什么？因为 next to 是表示地点的介词。

lines.en: (Back in the meeting room, we're about to learn who won the parenting experiment. Pete is smiling, thinking he won.)
lines.zh: （回到会议室，我们马上要知道谁赢了育儿实验。皮特在笑，以为自己赢了。）

lines.en: Anna, Anna, you should be very proud of yourself.
lines.zh: 安娜，安娜，你应该为自己感到骄傲。

lines.en: Proud? She stabbed and burned her baby!! And she only did one page of research…and it's covered in milk. Ew.
lines.zh: 骄傲？她又戳又烧她的宝宝！！她只写了一页研究……还沾满了牛奶。呃。

lines.en: Yes, Pete. But she followed instructions.
lines.zh: 是的，皮特。可她遵守了说明。

lines.en: Hey, I did ...
lines.zh: 嘿，我也……

lines.en: Please, Pete. Anna, I think your baby has lost some weight. Is there something else you want to share?
lines.zh: 拜托，皮特。安娜，我觉得你的宝宝瘦了一些。你还有什么想分享的吗？

lines.en: Yes. I'd like to share … these! I made them myself this morning.
lines.zh: 有。我想分享……这些！今天早上我自己做的。

lines.en: You baked your baby? You should be ashamed of yourself!
lines.zh: 你把你的宝宝烤了？你应该为自己感到羞愧！

lines.en: I baked them at the end of the experiment, Pete. At that point, this was just a bag of flour.
lines.zh: 我是在实验结束后才烤的，皮特。到那时，这只是一袋面粉。

lines.en: It was always just a bag of flour!!
lines.zh: 它一直都只是一袋面粉！！

lines.en: Pete, will you listen to yourself?! You sound crazy.
lines.zh: 皮特，你听听你自己说的话！你听起来疯了。

lines.en: I sound crazy! This whole experiment was crazy!! She was the one who carried around and fed it and ...
lines.zh: 我听起来疯了！整个实验才疯呢！！她就是那个带着它到处走、喂它……

lines.en: (Anna puts a cookie into his mouth. He chews it and begins to smile.)
lines.zh: （安娜把一块饼干塞进他嘴里。他嚼着嚼着笑了起来。）

lines.en: Mmm. That is good.
lines.zh: 嗯。真好吃。

lines.en: (They all agree and eat the cookies.)
lines.zh: （大家都同意，一起吃饼干。）

lines.en: So, what have we learned? We've learned when to use reflexive pronouns and when not to.
lines.zh: 那我们学到了什么？我们学到了什么时候用反身代词、什么时候不用。

lines.en: Go to our website for more information! You can practice using reflexive pronouns in our comments section.
lines.zh: 去我们的网站了解更多！你可以在评论区练习使用反身代词。

qs.q: Why does Ms. Weaver say Anna should be proud?
opts: She wrote a lot of research.
qs.why: "But she followed instructions."

qs.q: What did Anna make with her flour baby?
qs.why: 她用面粉做了饼干。

qs.q: Choose the right word: "I put Baby next to ___."
qs.why: 地点介词 next to 后面不用反身代词。

lessons.title: Movie Night
lessons.zh: 电影之夜：间接疑问句

lines.en: Hi, can you tell me how to get to your movie theater?
lines.zh: 你好，能告诉我怎么去你们电影院吗？

lines.en: (Movie theater worker on the phone gives directions.)
lines.zh: （电影院的工作人员在电话里指路。）

lines.en: Oh, that's easy. OK, thank you. Bye.
lines.zh: 哦，很简单。好的，谢谢。再见。

lines.en: (Anna meets Pete outside of the theater.)
lines.zh: （安娜在电影院外面见到皮特。）

lines.en: Hi, Pete! Thanks for the movie invitation.
lines.zh: 嗨，皮特！谢谢你请我看电影。

lines.en: Yeah, sure Anna.
lines.zh: 嗯，不客气，安娜。

lines.en: I love movies. I love the plot! I love the set design! I love the costumes! I love -
lines.zh: 我爱电影。我爱剧情！我爱布景！我爱服装！我爱——

lines.en: Anna, I take movies very seriously. You're not one of those people who talks during a movie, are you?
lines.zh: 安娜，我看电影是很认真的。你不是那种看电影时说话的人吧？

lines.en: No.
lines.zh: 不是。

lines.en: Good.
lines.zh: 很好。

lines.en: Anna loves movies. And..she loves talking about movies. And Pete doesn't sound happy about that.
lines.zh: 安娜爱电影。而且……她爱聊电影。皮特听起来可不太高兴。

lines.en: But he's trying to be polite. He can do that with Indirect Questions.
lines.zh: 不过他在努力保持礼貌。他可以用间接疑问句做到这一点。

lines.en: We can ask a question directly: Where is your movie theater? or indirectly as Anna does:
lines.zh: 我们可以直接问：Where is your movie theater?（你们电影院在哪儿？）也可以像安娜那样间接地问：

lines.en: Can you tell me how to get to your movie theater?
lines.zh: 能告诉我怎么去你们电影院吗？

lines.en: They have the same meaning. But indirect questions are more polite and a little more formal.
lines.zh: 意思一样，但间接疑问句更礼貌，也更正式一点。

lines.en: Many indirect questions begin with:
lines.zh: 很多间接疑问句以这些开头：

lines.en: Can/Could you tell me…
lines.zh: Can/Could you tell me…（你能告诉我……）

lines.en: Would/Do you mind…
lines.zh: Would/Do you mind…（你介意……）

lines.en: Would it be possible…
lines.zh: Would it be possible…（有没有可能……）

lines.en: or
lines.zh: 或者

lines.en: Do you know…
lines.zh: Do you know…（你知道……吗）

lines.en: Hmm, do you know if Anna will stop talking? I sure don't.
lines.zh: 嗯，你知道安娜会不会停止说话吗？我可不知道。

lines.en: Keep watching. And, this time look for indirect questions that begin with: Would you mind…
lines.zh: 继续看。这次注意找以 Would you mind… 开头的间接疑问句。

lines.en: I love the smell of popcorn. I love seats that rock.
lines.zh: 我爱爆米花的香味。我爱能摇的座椅。

lines.en: (Her chair makes noise as she rocks back and forth.)
lines.zh: （她前后摇着，椅子吱吱作响。）

lines.en: I love when people are quiet.
lines.zh: 我爱大家安静的时候。

lines.en: (The lights go down and we see movie light on their faces.)
lines.zh: （灯光暗下来，银幕的光照在他们脸上。）

lines.en: Ooh look, the previews are starting. I love to see what movies are coming out. Oh, this one looks good!
lines.zh: 哦，看，预告片开始了。我爱看有什么新电影要上映。哦，这部看起来不错！

lines.en: Anna, the previews are part of the movie experience. So, would you mind not talking?
lines.zh: 安娜，预告片也是看电影体验的一部分。所以，你介意不说话吗？

lines.en: Oh, sure, sure.
lines.zh: 哦，好，好。

lines.en: (Anna eats her popcorn loudly. Then, she begins drinking her milkshake loudly.)
lines.zh: （安娜很响地吃爆米花，接着又很响地喝奶昔。）

lines.en: Anna, I was wondering: are you almost finished with that?
lines.zh: 安娜，我想问一下：你那个快喝完了吗？

lines.en: No. There's still a lot of milkshake at the bottom.
lines.zh: 没有。底下还有好多奶昔。

lines.en: (She drinks loudly again. And again.)
lines.zh: （她又大声地喝，一次又一次。）

lines.en: Anna, do you mind not drinking so loudly?
lines.zh: 安娜，你介意别喝得这么响吗？

lines.en: I'll try. But it's really thick.
lines.zh: 我尽量。可它真的很稠。

lines.en: (She moves the straw around and makes even more noise.)
lines.zh: （她用吸管搅来搅去，声音更大了。）

lines.en: Anna, what are you doing?!
lines.zh: 安娜，你在干什么？！

lines.en: (A person in the audience shushes Pete.)
lines.zh: （观众中有人对皮特“嘘”。）

lines.en: Shh!
lines.zh: 嘘！

lines.en: (Pete tells the person what was happening.)
lines.zh: （皮特跟那人解释是怎么回事。）

lines.en: I'm not the one making all the noise.
lines.zh: 吵的人又不是我。

lines.en: Shhh!
I'm done now.
lines.zh: 我喝完了。

lines.en: (Anna now holds many noisy boxes of candy. Finally, she chooses a candy bar.)
lines.zh: （安娜现在拿着好几盒哗哗响的糖果。最后她挑了一根巧克力棒。）

lines.en: Anna, would you mind opening that a little bit more quietly?
lines.zh: 安娜，你介意打开得再轻一点吗？

lines.en: I'll try.
lines.zh: 我尽量。

lines.en: (She tries to open it quietly but cannot.)
lines.zh: （她想轻轻打开，可做不到。）

lines.en: Anna, just give it to me!
lines.zh: 安娜，给我吧！

lines.en: (He tears it open with his mouth. It makes a loud noise. Again, someone in the audience thinks he is making too much noise.)
lines.zh: （他用嘴把包装撕开，发出很大的声音。观众里又有人觉得他太吵。）

lines.en: Shhh!
(to the person) It's not mine. I'm opening it for her. Here.
lines.zh: （对那人）不是我的。我帮她打开的。给。

lines.en: Shhhhhh!!
(He gives the candy bar quickly back to her.)
lines.zh: （他赶紧把巧克力棒还给她。）

lines.en: Here!
lines.zh: 给！

lines.en: Thanks, Pete.
lines.zh: 谢谢你，皮特。

lines.en: Now, would you mind being more quiet?
lines.zh: 现在，你介意再安静一点吗？

lines.en: (The light of someone's phone shines in Pete's face. He asks the person a question.)
lines.zh: （有人的手机光照到皮特脸上。他问那人一个问题。）

lines.en: Excuse me, would you mind turning down your phone light?
lines.zh: 打扰一下，你介意把手机亮度调低一点吗？

lines.en: (Then, Anna's phone rings.)
lines.zh: （接着，安娜的手机响了。）

lines.en: Oh, sorry! I forgot to turn my phone off.
lines.zh: 哦，对不起！我忘了关手机。

lines.en: (She tries to turn it off but drops it under the seat.)
lines.zh: （她想关机，却把手机掉到了座位底下。）

lines.en: Oh no! I dropped it. Where is it?
lines.zh: 哦不！掉了。在哪儿呢？

lines.en: (She looks under the seat in front of her.)
lines.zh: （她在前排座位底下找。）

lines.en: Anna, can you please turn off your phone?
lines.zh: 安娜，你能把手机关了吗？

lines.en: (She speaks to the person Pete just asked to turn their phone light down.)
lines.zh: （她对刚才被皮特要求调暗手机的人说话。）

lines.en: Excuse me, would you mind lending me your phone light for a minute?
lines.zh: 打扰一下，你介意借我用一下手机的灯吗？

lines.en: No! I'll get it!
lines.zh: 不！我来捡！

lines.en: Shhhhh!
(People shush Pete again. He finally has had enough.)
lines.zh: （大家又嘘皮特。他终于忍无可忍了。）

lines.en: Look, people, I'm not the noisy one here! So, you all need to shush the right person. And I should know about shushing! I shush people all the time!!
lines.zh: 听着，各位，吵的人不是我！你们要嘘就嘘对人。我可是嘘人的行家！我一直在嘘别人！！

lines.en: Excuse me, sir. You can't yell in a movie theater. Would you mind coming with me?
lines.zh: 打扰一下，先生。电影院里不能大喊大叫。您介意跟我走一趟吗？

lines.en: You're kicking me out? Me? But I'm always the quiet one in the movie!
lines.zh: 你要把我赶出去？我？可我看电影一向是最安静的那个！

lines.en: (The security guard takes Pete out. Anna watches the movie and eats quietly from her bag of popcorn.)
lines.zh: （保安把皮特带了出去。安娜安静地看电影，从袋子里吃着爆米花。）

lines.en: Pete should know better. You have to be quiet in a movie theater. Shh, the movie's starting!
lines.zh: 皮特应该懂的。在电影院里必须保持安静。嘘，电影开始了！

lines.en: Well, that's a surprise! I thought Anna would be the noisy one.
lines.zh: 哎，真意外！我还以为吵的会是安娜。

lines.en: Well, she was … with her food. But Pete did all of the talking. At least he tried to be polite by using indirect questions.
lines.zh: 嗯，她是吵……吃东西的时候。可说话的全是皮特。至少他用间接疑问句努力保持了礼貌。

qs.q: Why are indirect questions useful?
qs.why: "indirect questions are more polite and a little more formal."

qs.q: Who gets kicked out of the movie theater?
qs.why: "You're kicking me out? Me?"

qs.q: Which is an indirect question?
qs.why: Would you mind… 是间接、礼貌的问法。

lessons.title: The Test Drive
lessons.zh: 试驾：间接引语

lines.en: (to Penelope) That's a great idea. (to Rick) Rick, I think we should use this as the opening shot.
lines.zh: （对佩内洛普）好主意。（对里克）里克，我觉得我们用这个做开场镜头。

lines.en: Anna, did Ms. Weaver give us instructions for covering the car show?
lines.zh: 安娜，韦弗女士给我们报道车展的指示了吗？

lines.en: She did. She said that we need to show lots of cars. She said we need to interview people. And she also said that we should have fun.
lines.zh: 给了。她说我们需要展示很多车。她说我们需要采访人。她还说我们应该玩得开心。

lines.en: Those were her exact words?
lines.zh: 这是她的原话？

lines.en: Yeah. She said, "Have fun, Anna!" And she is the boss.
lines.zh: 是啊。她说：“玩得开心，安娜！”她可是老板。

lines.en: (to Rick) Okay, Rick, are you - are you ready? OK. Hello, I'm Anna Matteo. Welcome to the Washington Car Show!
lines.zh: （对里克）好，里克，你——你准备好了吗？好。大家好，我是安娜·马泰奥。欢迎来到华盛顿车展！

lines.en: People all over town are saying that if you like cars, this is the place to be! So, let's see what people are talking about. (at Rick) How was that? Okay? Is that Good?
lines.zh: 全城的人都在说，如果你喜欢车，就该来这儿！那我们去看看大家在聊什么。（对里克）怎么样？还行？好吗？

lines.en: Anna, Penelope and Rick are making a news story about the Washington Car Show. Ms. Weaver gave them instructions.
lines.zh: 安娜、佩内洛普和里克正在做一条关于华盛顿车展的新闻。韦弗女士给了他们指示。

lines.en: We often need to tell others what someone else said.
lines.zh: 我们经常需要告诉别人另一个人说了什么。

lines.en: There are two ways to do this. One is to use the person's exact words and use quotation marks. We call this "direct speech."
lines.zh: 有两种方法。一种是用这个人的原话，加上引号。我们叫它“直接引语”。

lines.en: For example, Ms. Weaver had said, "You need to show lots of cars."
lines.zh: 比如，韦弗女士说过：“You need to show lots of cars.”

lines.en: The other way is to talk about what someone said. We call this "reported speech."
lines.zh: 另一种方法是转述别人说了什么。我们叫它“间接引语”。

lines.en: She said that we need to show lots of cars.
lines.zh: 她说我们需要展示很多车。

lines.en: In this sentence, "she," is the subject, "said" is the reporting verb, "that" is the conjunction and "we need to show lots of cars" is the reporting clause.
lines.zh: 在这个句子里，she 是主语，said 是转述动词，that 是连词，“we need to show lots of cars”是转述的内容。

lines.en: Keep watching, and listen for sentences where Anna talks about what someone else said!
lines.zh: 继续看，注意听安娜转述别人话的句子！

lines.en: This car show has many styles of vehicles. There are utility vehicles, classic cars, trucks, sports cars, and everyday vehicles.
lines.zh: 这次车展有很多种车。有多功能车、经典老爷车、卡车、跑车，还有日常用车。

lines.en: Okay, I think we got good interviews.
lines.zh: 好，我觉得我们的采访不错。

lines.en: Me too! People had very different opinions. But they all said they loved cars.
lines.zh: 我也觉得！大家看法很不一样，可他们都说爱车。

lines.en: Anna, look -- a robot!
lines.zh: 安娜，看——一个机器人！

lines.en: A robot!
lines.zh: 机器人！

lines.en: A robot!
lines.zh: 机器人！

lines.en: Rick, we have to use the robot in the show!
lines.zh: 里克，节目里一定要用这个机器人！

lines.en: (They walk over to the robot. Anna begins to dance like a robot.)
lines.zh: （她们走到机器人面前。安娜开始跳机器人舞。）

lines.en: What is your first name?
lines.zh: 你的名字是什么？

lines.en: Anna! Anna!
lines.zh: 安娜！安娜！

lines.en: Anna, you know, what an effort. What an effort to robot dance. How about a round of applause for Anna! I've never seen anyone try so hard.
lines.zh: 安娜，你知道吗，真努力啊。跳机器人舞真努力。大家为安娜鼓掌吧！我从没见过谁这么卖力。

lines.en: Penelope, did you hear that? Hank the Robot said that he has never seen anyone dance like me.
lines.zh: 佩内洛普，你听到了吗？机器人汉克说他从没见过谁跳得像我这样。

lines.en: Uh, I think many people here are saying that, Anna.
lines.zh: 呃，我觉得这儿很多人都在这么说，安娜。

lines.en: That was fun. You know what someone told me? You can test drive a Jaguar at this car show.
lines.zh: 真好玩。你知道有人告诉我什么吗？在这个车展可以试驾捷豹。

lines.en: Now, that sounds fun.
lines.zh: 这个听起来好玩。

lines.en: Let's go.
lines.zh: 走吧。

lines.en: Okay.
lines.zh: 好。

lines.en: This course is smooth. So you can drive faster.
lines.zh: 这条赛道很平，所以可以开快一点。

lines.en: He said...that I can't drive, unfortunately.
lines.zh: 他说……很遗憾，我不能开。

lines.en: (They begin the test drive. Kurt, the stunt driver, does the driving.)
lines.zh: （她们开始试驾。特技车手库尔特负责驾驶。）

lines.en: Oh my gosh…reverse.
lines.zh: 天哪……倒车。

lines.en: That was great. This is awesome.
lines.zh: 太棒了。真厉害。

lines.en: Are you ready to go on the rollercoaster?
lines.zh: 准备好坐过山车了吗？

lines.en: I'm ready.
lines.zh: 我准备好了。

lines.en: Here we go!
lines.zh: 出发！

lines.en: That's awesome.
lines.zh: 太棒了。

lines.en: That was...That was awesome! I just want to go one more time. I promise. That's it. Just one more time.
lines.zh: 刚才……刚才太棒了！我就想再来一次。我保证，就这样，再来一次。

lines.en: This course is bumpy and uneven. I was told that I could drive this course. So I am.
lines.zh: 这条赛道颠簸不平。有人告诉我可以开这条赛道，所以我就来了。

lines.en: (to Rick) Okay, Rick, are you rolling? Awesome. Okay, this course is uneven. But I think the ride will be smooth.
lines.zh: （对里克）好，里克，在拍吗？太好了。好，这条赛道不平，不过我觉得坐起来会很稳。

lines.en: Ooh. This hill is really steep.
lines.zh: 哦。这个坡真陡。

lines.en: Oh my gosh. I can't tell you how much fun this is.
lines.zh: 天哪。我都没法告诉你这有多好玩。

lines.en: Penelope, that was so much fun! I think I need to go again.
lines.zh: 佩内洛普，太好玩了！我觉得我得再去一次。

lines.en: Uh, Anna, I think we have enough test drive video.
lines.zh: 呃，安娜，我觉得试驾的视频够了。

lines.en: Ms. Weaver said to get a lot. So, I think I should go again. (to Rick) Rick, I'm going to go again. Until next time!
lines.zh: 韦弗女士说要多拍点。所以我觉得我应该再去一次。（对里克）里克，我要再去一次。下次见！

lines.en: But I want to get lunch, Anna!
lines.zh: 可我想去吃午饭，安娜！

lines.en: Penelope said she wants to go to lunch. But I don't think that's going to happen soon. Visit our website for more!
lines.zh: 佩内洛普说她想去吃午饭。不过我觉得这一时半会儿不会发生。访问我们的网站了解更多！

qs.q: What did Ms. Weaver tell them to do?
opts: show lots of cars, interview people and have fun
qs.a: show lots of cars, interview people and have fun
qs.why: Anna 转述了韦弗女士的三条指示。

qs.q: Which sentence is reported speech?
opts: She said that we need to show lots of cars.
qs.a: She said that we need to show lots of cars.
qs.why: 转述动词 said + that 从句。

qs.q: Who drives the Jaguar?
qs.why: "Kurt, the stunt driver, does the driving."

lessons.title: Trash to Treasure, Part 1
lessons.zh: 变废为宝（上）：talk 和 speak

lines.en: (on phone, to Pete) Got it. Pete, I promise. I won't tell anyone. (to herself) Bye. He is so strange.
lines.zh: （打电话，对皮特）知道了。皮特，我保证，我不告诉任何人。（自言自语）拜拜。他真怪。

lines.en: Hey, Anna!
lines.zh: 嘿，安娜！

lines.en: Hi, Ashley!
lines.zh: 嗨，阿什莉！

lines.en: Are you talking to yourself again?
lines.zh: 你又在自言自语了？

lines.en: No, not this time. I was talking to Pete.
lines.zh: 没有，这次没有。我在跟皮特说话。

lines.en: How's he doing?
lines.zh: 他怎么样？

lines.en: Good. He has a birthday coming up! But he told me not to tell anyone.
lines.zh: 挺好。他快过生日了！可他叫我别告诉任何人。

lines.en: Why?
lines.zh: 为什么？

lines.en: Well, from the way he was speaking, I don't think he likes cake or presents or fun.
lines.zh: 嗯，听他说话的样子，我觉得他不喜欢蛋糕、礼物，也不喜欢好玩的事。

lines.en: That sounds like Pete.
lines.zh: 听起来就是皮特。

lines.en: Well, I don't care. I'm getting him a present. Do you know where I can buy something unique?
lines.zh: 算了，我不管。我要给他买个礼物。你知道哪儿能买到独特的东西吗？

lines.en: I do -- Tanglewood Works. You will definitely find something unique there.
lines.zh: 知道——Tanglewood Works。你在那儿肯定能找到独特的东西。

lines.en: Great. I'll go this weekend. Now, speaking of Pete's birthday, what else should I do? I know. I'll rent him a clown!
lines.zh: 太好了。我这个周末就去。说到皮特的生日，我还该做什么呢？有了。我给他租个小丑！

lines.en: Yeah, he'll never speak to you again.
lines.zh: 是啊，那他就再也不跟你说话了。

lines.en: Did you hear Ashley and Anna using the words talk and speak?
lines.zh: 你听到阿什莉和安娜用 talk 和 speak 这两个词了吗？

lines.en: Talk and speak both mean "to say words." And, many times, you can use either word without losing any meaning. But there are some differences in when we use these words.
lines.zh: talk 和 speak 都表示“说话”。很多时候两个词都可以用，意思不变。但用法上有一些区别。

lines.en: The word talk is usually used:
lines.zh: talk 通常用于：

lines.en: for conversations between two or more people
lines.zh: 两个或更多人之间的对话

lines.en: and informal situations, such as between friends or family
lines.zh: 以及非正式场合，比如朋友或家人之间

lines.en: For example, Ashley asks Anna: "Are you talking to yourself again?"
lines.zh: 比如，阿什莉问安娜：“Are you talking to yourself again?”

lines.en: Speak is usually used:
lines.zh: speak 通常用于：

lines.en: for one-way communication, such as presentations
lines.zh: 单向的交流，比如演讲

lines.en: formal situations, such as a boss speaking with her workers
lines.zh: 正式场合，比如老板对员工讲话

lines.en: to talk about language ability
lines.zh: 谈论语言能力

lines.en: and in polite requests
lines.zh: 以及礼貌的请求

lines.en: Keep watching, and listen for the words talk and speak.
lines.zh: 继续看，注意听 talk 和 speak 这两个词。

lines.en: (Anna goes to Tanglewood Works.)
lines.zh: （安娜来到 Tanglewood Works。）

lines.en: Hey there. Welcome to Tanglewood Works! I'm Sue. How can I help you today?
lines.zh: 你好呀。欢迎来到 Tanglewood Works！我是苏。今天有什么能帮你的？

lines.en: Hi Sue, I'm Anna. A friend told me about your store. She said, "Anna, this place is really unique!"
lines.zh: 嗨，苏，我是安娜。一个朋友跟我说起你的店。她说：“安娜，这地方真的很独特！”

lines.en: We are! Here at Tanglewood Works, we focus on things that are handmade, reclaimed and recycled.
lines.zh: 我们是挺独特的！在 Tanglewood Works，我们专注于手工制作、回收再造和循环利用的东西。

lines.en: Wow! That is really good for the environment.
lines.zh: 哇！这对环境真好。

lines.en: It's good for you too. Local artists made all of these one-of-a-kind pieces. And I paint most of the furniture.
lines.zh: 对你也好。这些独一无二的作品都是本地艺术家做的。大部分家具是我涂的漆。

lines.en: Can I look around?
lines.zh: 我能随便看看吗？

lines.en: Oh, please do.
lines.zh: 哦，请便。

lines.en: (Anna walks around the store.)
lines.zh: （安娜在店里转。）

lines.en: So, Anna, do you like to make things?
lines.zh: 那么，安娜，你喜欢自己动手做东西吗？

lines.en: Me? Oh, no. Every time I try to make something, something goes wrong.
lines.zh: 我？哦，不。我每次想做点什么，总会出岔子。

lines.en: (She knocks down many things.)
lines.zh: （她碰倒了好多东西。）

lines.en: Oh, sorry. Sorry.
lines.zh: 哦，对不起。对不起。

lines.en: It's okay. Anna, everybody can make something.
lines.zh: 没关系。安娜，每个人都能做出点东西。

lines.en: Sue, this piece is very interesting!
lines.zh: 苏，这件东西真有意思！

lines.en: You know, when I found these pieces, they were broken and in a dumpster. But they spoke to me. And they said, "Save me, Sue! Save me!"
lines.zh: 你知道吗，我发现这些东西的时候，它们是坏的，在一个大垃圾箱里。可它们对我说话了。它们说：“救救我，苏！救救我！”

lines.en: Sue, what do you mean they "spoke" to you?
lines.zh: 苏，你说它们“跟你说话”是什么意思？

lines.en: When I see something special that someone has thrown away, I can almost hear it talk.
lines.zh: 当我看到别人扔掉的特别的东西时，我几乎能听到它说话。

lines.en: It's not saying anything!
lines.zh: 它什么也没说啊！

lines.en: Anna, it's not easy to see the treasure in trash.
lines.zh: 安娜，从垃圾里看出宝贝可不容易。

lines.en: Or hear it talk.
lines.zh: 或者听到它说话。

lines.en: But you can learn. In fact, I teach private classes. And one is called Turning Trash to Treasure.
lines.zh: 不过你可以学。其实我开私人课程，有一门课叫“变废为宝”。

lines.en: Next week, bring in some trash and we'll turn it into treasure. Just remember – pick some trash that "speaks" to you.
lines.zh: 下周带点垃圾来，我们把它变成宝贝。只要记住——挑一些会“跟你说话”的垃圾。

lines.en: Got it! I'll see you next week!
lines.zh: 知道了！下周见！

lines.en: Will Anna find trash that "speaks" to her? What will it say? We'll find out next week!
lines.zh: 安娜能找到“跟她说话”的垃圾吗？它会说什么？下周见分晓！

qs.q: What kind of things does Tanglewood Works sell?
qs.why: "we focus on things that are handmade, reclaimed and recycled."

qs.q: When do we usually use "speak"?
qs.why: speak 用于单向交流、正式场合、语言能力和礼貌请求。

qs.q: What is Sue's class called?
qs.why: "one is called Turning Trash to Treasure."

lessons.title: Trash to Treasure, Part 2
lessons.zh: 变废为宝（下）：tell 和 say

lines.en: Welcome to class, Anna. I can't wait to see your trash!
lines.zh: 欢迎来上课，安娜。我等不及看你的垃圾了！

lines.en: Oh, okay. Alright, it's a -- it's a net with a … oh, it's got a hole in it. Tell me about that.
lines.zh: 哦，好吧。好，这是一个——一个网，带着……哦，上面有个洞。跟我说说这个。

lines.en: This net said to me, "Anna, I used to catch stuff. I don't anymore. So, use me, Anna." That's what it said. It said, "Use me, Anna."
lines.zh: 这个网对我说：“安娜，我以前能抓东西，现在不能了。所以，用我吧，安娜。”它就是这么说的。它说：“用我吧，安娜。”

lines.en: Okay. So...it's a plastic helmet.
lines.zh: 好吧。那……这是一个塑料头盔。

lines.en: This plastic helmet said, "Anna. Hey, Anna, find me a head."
lines.zh: 这个塑料头盔说：“安娜。嘿，安娜，给我找个脑袋。”

lines.en: Okay, um...and a broken toy.
lines.zh: 好吧，嗯……还有一个坏玩具。

lines.en: This broken toy … this broken toy said to me – it said, "Anna, help me find fun." "Help me, Anna" is what it said.
lines.zh: 这个坏玩具……这个坏玩具对我说——它说：“安娜，帮我找到乐趣。”“帮帮我，安娜”，它是这么说的。

lines.en: Anna, this stuff is not saying anything to you or me or anyone. It's what we like to call in the business … garbage.
lines.zh: 安娜，这些东西没对你、对我、对任何人说任何话。它们就是我们行内所说的……垃圾。

lines.en: But you said to bring in trash.
lines.zh: 可你说要带垃圾来的。

lines.en: Sometimes trash is treasure. Sometimes it's just trash.
lines.zh: 有时候垃圾是宝贝。有时候它就只是垃圾。

lines.en: Anna, don't worry. Next week, I could teach you decoupage.
lines.zh: 安娜，别担心。下周我可以教你拼贴画（decoupage）。

lines.en: Decoupage. Decoupage. That's fun to say.
lines.zh: 拼贴画。拼贴画。这个词说起来真好玩。

lines.en: All you need to bring is a clean shoe box. A box that held shoes.
lines.zh: 你只需要带一个干净的鞋盒来，就是装过鞋的盒子。

lines.en: I got it. I got it! See you next week!
lines.zh: 知道了，知道了！下周见！

lines.en: Ut oh. It looks like Anna doesn't know the difference between treasure and trash. She thinks those things are telling her something!
lines.zh: 哎呀。看来安娜分不清宝贝和垃圾。她以为那些东西在跟她说话！

lines.en: The words tell and say have similar meanings. But we use them in different ways.
lines.zh: tell 和 say 意思相近，但用法不同。

lines.en: Tell means "to inform or instruct someone with words" and is almost always followed by an indirect object. For example, Sue says, "Tell me about that."
lines.zh: tell 的意思是“用话语告知或指示某人”，后面几乎总是跟一个间接宾语。比如苏说：“Tell me about that.”

lines.en: The word me is the indirect object and tells us who is being told.
lines.zh: me 是间接宾语，告诉我们被告知的是谁。

lines.en: Say means "to express something with words" and focuses more on the words used. For example, Anna says, "That's what it said. It said, 'Use me, Anna.'"
lines.zh: say 的意思是“用话语表达某事”，更侧重说出的话本身。比如安娜说：“That's what it said. It said, 'Use me, Anna.'”

lines.en: Listen for when Anna and Sue use tell and say.
lines.zh: 注意听安娜和苏什么时候用 tell，什么时候用 say。

lines.en: Anna, welcome to Decoupage class. Decoupage is just gluing pretty pictures onto stuff.
lines.zh: 安娜，欢迎来到拼贴画课。拼贴画就是把漂亮的图片粘到东西上。

lines.en: (Sue gets a phone call.)
lines.zh: （苏接到一个电话。）

lines.en: Anna, I've got to talk to this person. I'll be right back. Don't start without me.
lines.zh: 安娜，我得跟这个人说几句。我马上回来。别在我回来前开始。

lines.en: Got it.
lines.zh: 知道了。

lines.en: (Sue leaves to take her phone call. Anna gets glue everywhere. She becomes covered with glue and paper.)
lines.zh: （苏出去接电话。安娜把胶水弄得到处都是，自己身上粘满了胶水和纸。）

lines.en: Okay. I can fix this.
lines.zh: 好吧，我能搞定。

lines.en: Anna, what happened? I told you to wait for me!
lines.zh: 安娜，怎么回事？我告诉过你等我！

lines.en: Actually, you told me not to start without you, which I didn't. Your glue is really sticky.
lines.zh: 其实，你告诉我的是别在你回来前开始，我没开始啊。你的胶水真粘。

lines.en: Next week, let's try lamp making. There's – there's no glue. Here's a flier.
lines.zh: 下周我们试试做台灯吧。那个——那个不用胶水。这是传单。

lines.en: Thanks. See you next week.
lines.zh: 谢谢。下周见。

lines.en: Anna, you did really well this week. I think lamp making might be your thing!
lines.zh: 安娜，你这周做得很好。我觉得做台灯可能正适合你！

lines.en: Thanks, Sue. I did everything you told me to do.
lines.zh: 谢谢你，苏。你告诉我做的我都做了。

lines.en: Remember: I said to read the instructions really carefully. Where are those instructions?
lines.zh: 记住：我说过要非常仔细地读说明书。说明书呢？

lines.en: Let's just plug it in!
lines.zh: 我们直接插上电吧！

lines.en: (Anna plugs in the lamp and, suddenly, the city loses electricity.)
lines.zh: （安娜给台灯插上电，突然，整座城市都停电了。）

lines.en: So, what class will you be teaching next week?
lines.zh: 那么，你下周要教什么课？

lines.en: Too bad Anna didn't follow instructions! Visit our website for more on tell and say!
lines.zh: 可惜安娜没按说明做！访问我们的网站了解更多 tell 和 say 的用法！

qs.q: What does Sue call Anna's things?
qs.why: "It's what we like to call in the business … garbage."

qs.q: Which word is almost always followed by an indirect object?
qs.why: "Tell me about that." me 是间接宾语。

qs.q: What happens when Anna plugs in the lamp?
qs.why: 整座城市停电了。

lessons.title: Rock Star
lessons.zh: 摇滚明星：将来进行时

lines.en: Hello?
lines.zh: 喂？

lines.en: Anna, this is Ms. Weaver.
lines.zh: 安娜，我是韦弗女士。

lines.en: Ms. Weaver!
lines.zh: 韦弗女士！

lines.en: Tomorrow, you'll be interviewing musician Emma G.
lines.zh: 明天你要采访音乐人艾玛·G。

lines.en: (Anna is very excited. She loves Emma G's music.)
lines.zh: （安娜非常激动。她很爱艾玛·G 的音乐。）

lines.en: Emma G?! I will be talking to Emma G?!
lines.zh: 艾玛·G？！我要和艾玛·G 说话？！

lines.en: Anna? Anna, are you there?
lines.zh: 安娜？安娜，你在吗？

lines.en: Anna and Ms. Weaver used the future continuous verb tense to talk about the interview.
lines.zh: 安娜和韦弗女士用将来进行时谈论这次采访。

lines.en: We use future continuous to talk about actions that will be in progress at or around a time in the future.
lines.zh: 将来进行时用来谈论在将来某个时间或前后正在进行的动作。

lines.en: For example, Ms. Weaver says, "Tomorrow, you'll be interviewing musician Emma G."
lines.zh: 比如，韦弗女士说：“Tomorrow, you'll be interviewing musician Emma G.”

lines.en: There are two options for future continuous. The first is: will be + the -ing form of the verb
lines.zh: 将来进行时有两种形式。第一种是：will be + 动词 -ing 形式

lines.en: And the second is: be + going to be + the -ing form of the verb. Keep watching for more!
lines.zh: 第二种是：be + going to be + 动词 -ing 形式。继续看，找更多！

lines.en: Hello and welcome to The Music! Today, musician Emma G will be joining us here!
lines.zh: 大家好，欢迎收看《音乐》！今天，音乐人艾玛·G 将来到我们节目！

lines.en: She is a wonderful songwriter and an amazing singer. And I love her! Let's give a warm welcome to Emma G!
lines.zh: 她是一位出色的词曲作者，也是一位了不起的歌手。我爱她！让我们热烈欢迎艾玛·G！

lines.en: Hi. Thank you for coming on the show, Emma G.
lines.zh: 嗨。谢谢你来上节目，艾玛·G。

lines.en: Of course. It's great to be here.
lines.zh: 当然。很高兴来这儿。

lines.en: Well, we can't wait to hear you sing. I listen to your music a lot. So, I feel like I know you. Is that strange?
lines.zh: 我们都等不及听你唱歌了。我经常听你的音乐，所以感觉我认识你。这奇怪吗？

lines.en: Anna, listening to music can be a very personal experience. So, no, that's not strange.
lines.zh: 安娜，听音乐可以是很私人的体验。所以，不，这不奇怪。

lines.en: Good because I made something for you -- a video scrapbook of our friendship.
lines.zh: 太好了，因为我给你做了个东西——一本记录我们友谊的视频剪贴簿。

lines.en: I took photos of you and added myself. I worked on it all weekend.
lines.zh: 我拿了你的照片，把我自己加了进去。我整个周末都在弄。

lines.en: Well, that -- that's strange. Is that even -- is that even legal?
lines.zh: 嗯，那——那就有点奇怪了。这——这合法吗？

lines.en: Now, Emma, let's talk about your schedule. Tell me ... I mean, tell us exactly where you will be and when. Exactly.
lines.zh: 好了，艾玛，我们聊聊你的日程吧。告诉我……我是说，告诉我们你什么时候会在哪儿。要具体。

lines.en: Sure. Well, in early June, I'll be performing at several venues across Austin, Texas.
lines.zh: 好的。嗯，六月初，我会在德克萨斯州奥斯汀的几个场馆演出。

lines.en: That's my vacation week. I can meet you there! We can tour the city. We can have lunch.
lines.zh: 那正是我的休假周。我可以去那儿见你！我们可以一起逛城市，一起吃午饭。

lines.en: Um, yeah maybe. Then in mid-July, I'm going to be teaching at a music camp in Chicago.
lines.zh: 嗯，是啊，也许吧。然后七月中旬，我会在芝加哥的一个音乐营教课。

lines.en: I'll be visiting my sister then. She only lives about six hours from Chicago! I could drive over. We could hang out.
lines.zh: 那时我会去看我姐姐。她家离芝加哥只有大约六小时车程！我可以开车过去，我们可以一起玩。

lines.en: Yeah, uh maybe. You know, maybe now is a good time for some music.
lines.zh: 是啊，呃，也许吧。你知道吗，也许现在该来点音乐了。

lines.en: That's a great idea. Now, let's hear a song from Emma G.!
lines.zh: 好主意。现在，我们来听艾玛·G 的一首歌！

lines.en: I wrote this song a couple of years ago. It's called "Wary."
lines.zh: 这首歌是我几年前写的，叫《Wary》（警惕）。

lines.en: Do you believe in happy endings?
lines.zh: Do you believe in happy endings?（你相信圆满的结局吗？）

lines.en: Endings...
lines.zh: 结局……

lines.en: Do you really believe that we could be…
lines.zh: Do you really believe that we could be…（你真的相信我们能够……）

lines.en: Be...
lines.zh: 能够……

lines.en: I think something is wrong. I hear a voice in the background.
lines.zh: 我觉得有点不对劲。我听到背景里有人在出声。

lines.en: Sorry. Sorry, Emma. That was me. I'm just so excited.
lines.zh: 抱歉。抱歉，艾玛。是我。我太激动了。

lines.en: No problem. I'm glad you like the song.
lines.zh: 没关系。很高兴你喜欢这首歌。

lines.en: You go ahead. You go ahead.
lines.zh: 你继续，你继续。

lines.en: Okay. Do you believe in happy endings?
lines.zh: 好。Do you believe in happy endings?

lines.en: (She hears a tambourine playing and looks at Anna.)
lines.zh: （她听到有人在打铃鼓，于是看向安娜。）

lines.en: Anna, there's no tambourine in this.
lines.zh: 安娜，这首歌里没有铃鼓。

lines.en: I'm so sorry. I'm so sorry, Emma. See, I've always wanted to sing with you.
lines.zh: 太对不起了。太对不起了，艾玛。你看，我一直想跟你一起唱歌。

lines.en: Well, come on over then and we can sing a song together first.
lines.zh: 那你过来吧，我们先一起唱一首。

lines.en: No, I couldn't.
lines.zh: 不不，我不行。

lines.en: Come on. It'll be fun.
lines.zh: 来嘛，会很好玩的。

lines.en: Okay! Here. I brought my favorite song.
lines.zh: 好！给。我带了我最爱的歌。

lines.en: Oh, uh okay. Actually, I like this song. Um, are you ready?
lines.zh: 哦，呃，好吧。其实我也喜欢这首歌。嗯，准备好了吗？

lines.en: Yes! Yes!
lines.zh: 好了！好了！

lines.en: Okay.
lines.zh: 好。

lines.en: Emma G / Anna together:
lines.zh: 艾玛·G 和安娜一起：

lines.en: (They sing a song together.)
lines.zh: （她们一起唱起一首歌。）

qs.q: Who will Anna interview?
qs.why: "you'll be interviewing musician Emma G."

qs.q: Where will Emma G be teaching in mid-July?
opts: at a music camp in Chicago
qs.a: at a music camp in Chicago
qs.why: "I'm going to be teaching at a music camp in Chicago."

qs.q: Which is future continuous?
qs.why: will be + 动词 -ing。

lessons.title: I Feel Super!
lessons.zh: 我感觉超棒！had better 和 would rather

lines.en: Hi! I see you like superhero culture. Me too.
lines.zh: 嗨！我看你喜欢超级英雄文化。我也是。

lines.en: In fact, tonight I'm going to the big superhero convention. Are you going?
lines.zh: 其实，今晚我要去那个超级英雄大会。你去吗？

lines.en: Um, I don't know.
lines.zh: 嗯，我不知道。

lines.en: Well, you'd better decide soon. Last year, it sold out.
lines.zh: 那你最好快点决定。去年票都卖光了。

lines.en: So, since we're talking about superheroes: would you rather become a superhero by accident, like Spiderman, or be born a superhero, like Wonder Woman?
lines.zh: 既然我们在聊超级英雄：你宁愿像蜘蛛侠那样意外成为超级英雄，还是像神奇女侠那样生来就是超级英雄？

lines.en: Take your time. It's a big question. I thought about it for days –
lines.zh: 慢慢想。这是个大问题。我想了好几天——

lines.en: Okay. If I had to choose, I'd rather be born a superhero.
lines.zh: 好吧。如果非要选，我宁愿生来就是超级英雄。

lines.en: I'd rather become a superhero by an unexpected accident!
lines.zh: 我宁愿因为一次意想不到的意外成为超级英雄！

lines.en: Aren't all accidents unexpected?
lines.zh: 意外不都是意想不到的吗？

lines.en: Well, yeah.
lines.zh: 嗯，也对。

lines.en: What was that!? Are you okay?
lines.zh: 那是什么！？你没事吧？

lines.en: I'm better than okay. I feel super!
lines.zh: 我不只是没事。我感觉超棒！

lines.en: Oh No! Anna was just hit by lightning. She had better get help.
lines.zh: 哦不！安娜刚被闪电击中了。她最好去找人帮忙。

lines.en: We use had better to give advice. It is very informal and stronger than should and ought to. For example, Anna says: "You'd better decide soon. Last year, it sold out."
lines.zh: 我们用 had better 给建议。它很口语，比 should 和 ought to 语气更强。比如安娜说：“You'd better decide soon. Last year, it sold out.”

lines.en: When we use had better, we usually shorten the word had for personal pronouns.
lines.zh: 用 had better 时，人称代词后面的 had 通常要缩写。

lines.en: We use would rather to say what we or someone else prefers to do or have. For example, the boy says: "Okay. If I had to choose, I'd rather be born a superhero.
lines.zh: 我们用 would rather 说我们或别人更想做什么、更想要什么。比如男孩说：“Okay. If I had to choose, I'd rather be born a superhero.”

lines.en: With would rather, we also shorten the word would when used with personal pronouns. Keep watching and listen for had better and would rather.
lines.zh: 用 would rather 时，人称代词后面的 would 也要缩写。继续看，注意听 had better 和 would rather。

lines.en: You'd better see a doctor.
lines.zh: 你最好去看医生。

lines.en: I've never felt better!
lines.zh: 我从没感觉这么好过！

lines.en: You were just struck by lightning!! And what happened to your hair and your clothes?
lines.zh: 你刚被闪电击中了！！你的头发和衣服怎么了？

lines.en: I don't know. Wait, I do know. This is my super suit! And this is my origin story.
lines.zh: 我不知道。等等，我知道了。这是我的超级战衣！这是我的起源故事。

lines.en: What are you talking about?
lines.zh: 你在说什么？

lines.en: An origin story tells the beginning of a superhero. You should know that.
lines.zh: 起源故事讲的是超级英雄的开端。你应该知道的。

lines.en: You're not making any sense, lady.
lines.zh: 你说的话一点道理都没有，女士。

lines.en: I would rather be called Lightning Bolt Lady! It'll sound great in a theme song: Lightning Bolt Lady!
lines.zh: 我宁愿被叫作“闪电女侠”！放在主题曲里一定很好听：闪电女侠！

lines.en: Now, I need to find my superpowers --
lines.zh: 现在，我得找到我的超能力——

lines.en: Um, I really think --
lines.zh: 呃，我真的觉得——

lines.en: Wait. Don't tell me. I'll read your mind. You are thinking you'd like to be my super helper.
lines.zh: 等等，别告诉我。我来读你的心。你在想你想当我的超级助手。

lines.en: I was not thinking that.
lines.zh: 我没那么想。

lines.en: ... that you'd like to live in a treehouse.
lines.zh: ……你想住在树屋里。

lines.en: No.
lines.zh: 不是。

lines.en: … that you should eat more vegetables.
lines.zh: ……你应该多吃蔬菜。

lines.en: Please, stop talking. You really should get some help.
lines.zh: 求你别说了。你真该去找人帮帮你。

lines.en: Mind reading is not my superpower. Maybe I can become invisible. I … am … invisible!
lines.zh: 读心术不是我的超能力。也许我能隐身。我……隐……身……了！

lines.en: You can't see me. Who am I? I'm not here. You can't see me.
lines.zh: 你看不见我。我是谁？我不在这儿。你看不见我。

lines.en: I can see you and so can everybody else.
lines.zh: 我看得见你，别人也都看得见。

lines.en: No power of invisibility. Maybe I can create a force field. I feel it working. Nothing can hurt –
lines.zh: 没有隐身能力。也许我能制造力场。我感觉它起作用了。什么也伤不了——

lines.en: (Someone throws a piece of paper and it hits her head.)
lines.zh: （有人扔来一张纸，打在她头上。）

lines.en: Ow, that wasn't very nice. I see I have a lot of work to do. Well, goodbye, non-super person!
lines.zh: 哎哟，真不友好。看来我还有很多功课要做。好了，再见，非超能力人士！

lines.en: Wait. I'd better go with you. You might get worse…if that's even possible.
lines.zh: 等等。我最好跟你一起去。你可能会变得更糟……如果还能更糟的话。

lines.en: That's very nice of you, ordinary human. But I'd rather go by myself. This is a quest.
lines.zh: 你真好心，普通人类。不过我宁愿自己去。这是一场探险之旅。

lines.en: Every time you speak, I get more confused.
lines.zh: 你每说一句话，我就更糊涂一点。

lines.en: A quest is a part of all superhero stories. You really need to work on your superhero studies. Now, stand back. I've never flown before.
lines.zh: 探险之旅是所有超级英雄故事的一部分。你真得好好补补超级英雄知识了。现在，退后。我还从没飞过。

lines.en: And you're not flying now.
lines.zh: 你现在也没在飞。

lines.en: Flying is also not my superpower. That's too bad. It's going to be expensive to Uber everywhere. You know, I'd rather walk. It's a nice day. Goodbye, non-super person.
lines.zh: 飞行也不是我的超能力。太可惜了。到哪儿都打 Uber 会很贵的。你知道吗，我宁愿走路。今天天气不错。再见，非超能力人士。

lines.en: I am not talking to strangers again.
lines.zh: 我再也不跟陌生人说话了。

lines.en: Will Lightning Bolt Lady find her superpowers … ever? Ouch! Did that brick wall hurt? Will the young man ever talk to a stranger again?
lines.zh: 闪电女侠能找到她的超能力吗……到底能不能？哎哟！那堵砖墙撞疼了吧？年轻人还会再跟陌生人说话吗？

lines.en: Find out on the next episode of Let's Learn English!
lines.zh: 请看下一集《一起学英语》！

qs.q: What happened to Anna?
qs.why: "Anna was just hit by lightning."

qs.q: What does "had better" do?
qs.why: "We use had better to give advice."

qs.q: What name does Anna want?
qs.why: "I would rather be called Lightning Bolt Lady!"

lessons.title: Only Human
lessons.zh: 终究是凡人：过去完成进行时

lines.en: When last we saw Anna, she had made a new friend. And they had been talking about superheroes for a while when suddenly Anna became Lightning Bolt Lady!
lines.zh: 上次我们见到安娜时，她交了个新朋友。他们聊超级英雄聊了一阵子，突然安娜变成了闪电女侠！

lines.en: She tried to find her superpowers. But it did not go well.
lines.zh: 她努力寻找自己的超能力，可进展不太顺利。

lines.en: She can't fly, become invisible or create a force field. And she really cannot walk through walls. Ouch, Lightning Bolt Lady.
lines.zh: 她不会飞，不会隐身，也不会制造力场。她更不能穿墙。哎哟，闪电女侠。

lines.en: She had been walking into that wall for about 15 minutes when she had a great idea.
lines.zh: 她往那堵墙上撞了大约 15 分钟，这时她想到了一个好主意。

lines.en: I just had a great idea!
lines.zh: 我刚想到一个好主意！

lines.en: I can't wait to hear this one! But first, let's talk about grammar.
lines.zh: 我等不及听听了！不过先来讲讲语法。

lines.en: Professor Bot is on vacation this week. I'm the announcer. So, I'm going to tell you about the past perfect continuous.
lines.zh: 机器人教授这周休假。我是旁白，所以由我来讲过去完成进行时。

lines.en: We use this verb tense to show that an action started in the past and continued to another time or action in the past.
lines.zh: 这个时态表示一个动作在过去开始，并持续到过去的另一个时间或动作。

lines.en: For example, I said, "She had been walking into that wall for about 15 minutes when she had a great idea."
lines.zh: 比如，我说：“She had been walking into that wall for about 15 minutes when she had a great idea.”

lines.en: Had been walking is the past perfect continuous of the verb walk. It's had been plus the -ing form of the verb.
lines.zh: had been walking 是动词 walk 的过去完成进行时，结构是 had been + 动词 -ing 形式。

lines.en: You'll hear me use this verb tense a few more times today.
lines.zh: 今天你还会听到我用几次这个时态。

lines.en: Now, what am I forgetting? Oh right! Lightning Bolt Lady's great idea.
lines.zh: 我忘了什么来着？哦对！闪电女侠的好主意。

lines.en: If I want to know my superpowers, I'll need to learn about lightning!
lines.zh: 如果我想知道自己的超能力，我就得了解闪电！

lines.en: So, she read many books about lightning.
lines.zh: 于是，她读了很多关于闪电的书。

lines.en: Wow. A lightning strike usually lasts less than a second.
lines.zh: 哇。一次闪电通常持续不到一秒。

lines.en: (She tells this to a person and he slowly moves away.)
lines.zh: （她把这个告诉一个人，那人慢慢走开了。）

lines.en: Lightning is really fast and I like speed walking. So, maybe one of my superpowers is super-speed walking! (to stranger) Bye!
lines.zh: 闪电非常快，而我喜欢竞走。所以，也许我的超能力之一是超速竞走！（对陌生人）拜拜！

lines.en: (She begins to super-speed walk.)
lines.zh: （她开始超速竞走。）

lines.en: Check! Super-speed walking is definitely one of my superpowers.
lines.zh: 搞定！超速竞走肯定是我的超能力之一。

lines.en: Lightning has millions of volts of electricity. Amazing!
lines.zh: 闪电有几百万伏的电。太神奇了！

lines.en: (She puts her hand up and lightning bolts shoot from her fingers.)
lines.zh: （她举起手，闪电从她指尖射出。）

lines.en: Wow! I can charge a lot of batteries with this superpower!
lines.zh: 哇！有了这个超能力，我能给好多电池充电！

lines.en: She had been looking for hours for someone to help when she found her chance.
lines.zh: 她找了好几个小时需要帮助的人，终于找到了机会。

lines.en: Hello? Hello? I'm sorry. I'm going to have to call you back. My phone is dying.
lines.zh: 喂？喂？抱歉，我得回头再打给你。我的手机快没电了。

lines.en: Excuse me, I can charge your phone.
lines.zh: 打扰一下，我可以给你的手机充电。

lines.en: Really? Thanks!
lines.zh: 真的吗？谢谢！

lines.en: I'm Lightning Bolt Lady!
lines.zh: 我是闪电女侠！

lines.en: (She takes the woman's phone and shoots it with a lightning bolt. But it turns into ashes. Then, she gives the woman lots of money and smiles and says goodbye.)
lines.zh: （她拿过女人的手机，用闪电一击，手机却变成了灰。然后她给了女人很多钱，笑着说再见。）

lines.en: She had been practicing her superpowers all day. Suddenly, she heard a terrible sound – a child's disappointment.
lines.zh: 她一整天都在练习超能力。突然，她听到一个可怕的声音——孩子的失望。

lines.en: These children tried to light a fire for over an hour. But then, they gave up.
lines.zh: 这些孩子想生火生了一个多小时，可后来放弃了。

lines.en: Hey kids, that wood will never burn. It'is too wet.
lines.zh: 嘿，孩子们，那木头永远也烧不着，太湿了。

lines.en: Small humans, what is wrong?
lines.zh: 小人类们，怎么了？

lines.en: Stranger danger!
lines.zh: 陌生人危险！

lines.en: I'm Lightning Bolt Lady!
lines.zh: 我是闪电女侠！

lines.en: Oh no. It's you.
lines.zh: 哦不。又是你。

lines.en: (to YOUNG MAN:) We meet again. And guess what: I found my superpowers.
lines.zh: （对年轻人）我们又见面了。你猜怎么着：我找到我的超能力了。

lines.en: Well, we need a fire to toast the marshmallows to make S'mores.
lines.zh: 嗯，我们需要生火烤棉花糖做 S'mores（夹心饼干）。

lines.en: I can help.
lines.zh: 我能帮忙。

lines.en: We don't need a super-speed walker but thanks!
lines.zh: 我们不需要超速竞走的人，不过谢谢！

lines.en: Super-speed walking is just one of my superpowers. I can also do this!
lines.zh: 超速竞走只是我的超能力之一。我还能做这个！

lines.en: (She tries to use her lightning bolts but it doesn't go well.)
lines.zh: （她试着用闪电，可效果不太好。）

lines.en: Sorry! Let me do it again.
lines.zh: 抱歉！让我再来一次。

lines.en: (She lights the fire with her lightning bolts.)
lines.zh: （她用闪电点燃了火。）

lines.en: Thanks, Lightning Bolt Lady!
lines.zh: 谢谢你，闪电女侠！

lines.en: Lightning Bolt Lady
lines.zh: 闪电女侠

lines.en: You're welcome. But you don't have enough firewood. Using my super-speed walking, I will get more.
lines.zh: 不客气。不过你们的柴火不够。我用超速竞走去多拿点。

lines.en: (She super-speed walks around to get firewood.)
lines.zh: （她超速竞走着到处捡柴火。）

lines.en: Lightning Bolt Lady, come back! A lightning storm is coming!
lines.zh: 闪电女侠，回来！雷暴要来了！

lines.en: Not a chance! There's not a cloud in the …
lines.zh: 不可能！天上一朵云都没……

lines.en: Lightning Bolt Lady, are you okay?
lines.zh: 闪电女侠，你没事吧？

lines.en: Where's your super-suit?
lines.zh: 你的超级战衣呢？

lines.en: Oh no! I've lost my superpowers!
lines.zh: 哦不！我失去超能力了！

lines.en: It's starting to rain. Do you want to go inside and eat some S'mores?
lines.zh: 开始下雨了。你想进去吃点 S'mores 吗？

lines.en: You read my mind.
lines.zh: 你读懂了我的心。

lines.en: You know, I thought mind reading would be one of my superpowers. But it wasn't.
lines.zh: 你知道吗，我以为读心术会是我的超能力之一。可惜不是。

lines.en: That'd be a cool superpower.
lines.zh: 那会是很酷的超能力。

lines.en: But I'd rather be able to talk to animals.
lines.zh: 不过我宁愿能跟动物说话。

qs.q: What is one of Lightning Bolt Lady's superpowers?
qs.why: "Super-speed walking is definitely one of my superpowers."

qs.q: What happened to the woman's phone?
qs.why: 手机变成了灰。

qs.q: What is the past perfect continuous form?
qs.why: "It's had been plus the -ing form of the verb."

lessons.title: Look-alikes
lessons.zh: 长得像的人

lines.en: This article is so interesting. Pete, listen to this: "Somewhere in the world there is someone who looks just like you."
lines.zh: 这篇文章太有意思了。皮特，你听：“世界上某个地方有一个人长得和你一模一样。”

lines.en: No one is this handsome.
lines.zh: 没人有我这么帅。

lines.en: Oh Pete, there's something between your teeth.
lines.zh: 哦，皮特，你牙缝里有东西。

lines.en: (Pete tries to clean his teeth.)
lines.zh: （皮特试着清理牙齿。）

lines.en: It is gone?
lines.zh: 没了吗？

lines.en: No. No. It's still there. There. You got it. But think of it: There could be two of us in the world!
lines.zh: 没有，没有。还在。那儿。弄掉了。不过想想看：世界上可能有两个我们！

lines.en: Two Annas?
lines.zh: 两个安娜？

lines.en: Actually, Anna, maybe your silly article is right. Yesterday at work, I met a woman who looks just like you.
lines.zh: 其实，安娜，也许你那篇傻文章是对的。昨天上班时，我遇到一个跟你长得一模一样的女人。

lines.en: Really? Wait, are you making fun of me?
lines.zh: 真的？等等，你在取笑我吗？

lines.en: Not this time.
lines.zh: 这次没有。

lines.en: She's tall and has curly hair. But even her face looks like yours. I think she's a career consultant.
lines.zh: 她个子高，卷发。连脸都像你。我想她是职业顾问。

lines.en: I bet she has a lot of great advice. I can't wait to meet her.
lines.zh: 我敢说她有很多好建议。我等不及要见她了。

lines.en: Yes, you can. I met her and she is very difficult.
lines.zh: 不，你等得及。我见过她，她很难相处。

lines.en: Pete, she's just new. We have to give her a chance. What's her name?
lines.zh: 皮特，她只是新来的。我们得给她个机会。她叫什么？

lines.en: Evelyna or something like that. You can't miss her. She always wears a hat.
lines.zh: 叫伊芙琳娜什么的。你一眼就能认出她，她总戴着帽子。

lines.en: So, Anna, have you met the new consultant yet?
lines.zh: 安娜，你见过那个新顾问了吗？

lines.en: No. But I've already heard. We look alike, don't we?
lines.zh: 还没。不过我已经听说了。我们长得很像，对吧？

lines.en: Yeah, but you don't act alike. You're much nicer than she is.
lines.zh: 是啊，可你们为人不像。你比她好多了。

lines.en: Maybe she gets nervous at new jobs. Or maybe she's shy. Let's not judge, Penelope.
lines.zh: 也许她到新工作会紧张，或者她害羞。我们别妄下结论，佩内洛普。

lines.en: She's not nervous or shy. She's mean.
lines.zh: 她不紧张也不害羞。她很刻薄。

lines.en: You know, we should get to know her better. Let's invite her to lunch!
lines.zh: 你知道吗，我们应该多了解她。我们请她吃午饭吧！

lines.en: Sorry but I'm busy that day.
lines.zh: 抱歉，那天我有事。

lines.en: (Penelope walks away. Anna yells after her.)
lines.zh: （佩内洛普走开了。安娜在后面喊她。）

lines.en: Oh, that's too bad. Hey, I haven't picked a day yet!
lines.zh: 哦，太可惜了。嘿，我还没定哪天呢！

lines.en: (Anna and Pete are playing a game.)
lines.zh: （安娜和皮特在玩游戏。）

lines.en: This is going to be so much fun. Boy, I can't wait to play this game.
lines.zh: 这会很好玩的。天哪，我等不及玩这个游戏了。

lines.en: How much longer are you going to be?
lines.zh: 你们还要多久？

lines.en: We'll be just a minute …
lines.zh: 我们马上就好……

lines.en: (Anna turns around and sees her look-alike.)
lines.zh: （安娜转身，看到了跟她长得像的人。）

lines.en: You must be Evelana. I'm Anna. We are look-alikes!
lines.zh: 你一定是伊芙琳娜。我是安娜。我们长得一样！

lines.en: No, we're not. And my name is pronounced "Evil-ana."
lines.zh: 不，不一样。我的名字读作“伊维拉娜”（Evil-ana，邪恶安娜）。

lines.en: Oh. This is going to be fun.
lines.zh: 哦。这下有意思了。

lines.en: You had better hurry up. I need this room for a lecture. It's called: "If You Want to Win, Others Must Lose." What is all this stuff, anyway?
lines.zh: 你们最好快点。我要用这个房间讲课，题目是：“想赢，别人就必须输。”这些到底都是什么东西？

lines.en: It's a game. We're going to play at lunch.
lines.zh: 是个游戏。我们午饭时要玩。

lines.en: It's a stupid child's game!
lines.zh: 这是个愚蠢的小孩游戏！

lines.en: It's a fun game. But yes, it is for children.
lines.zh: 这是个好玩的游戏。不过没错，是给小孩玩的。

lines.en: Well, you may be childish but I'm not. And you look stupid with that thing on your head.
lines.zh: 哼，你也许很幼稚，可我不是。你头上戴着那玩意儿看起来很蠢。

lines.en: Well, you look serious with that look on your face. Come on, Pete. Let's play somewhere else.
lines.zh: 嗯，你脸上那副表情看起来很严肃。走吧，皮特，我们去别处玩。

lines.en: Actually, I'm going to stay for Evilana's lecture.
lines.zh: 其实，我要留下来听伊维拉娜的课。

lines.en: Fine. You can learn new ways to beat people.
lines.zh: 好吧。你可以学学打败别人的新办法。

lines.en: He will. He will.
lines.zh: 他会的。他会的。

lines.en: (Days later, Anna and Penelope are playing the game. Pete comes in. He has a problem with his eye.)
lines.zh: （几天后，安娜和佩内洛普在玩游戏。皮特进来了，他的眼睛受了伤。）

lines.en: Okay. Am I a food?
lines.zh: 好。我是一种食物吗？

lines.en: Nope.
lines.zh: 不是。

lines.en: Hey, do you guys have room for one more?
lines.zh: 嘿，你们还能再加一个人吗？

lines.en: Sure, Pete! Come on over. What happened to your eye?
lines.zh: 当然，皮特！过来吧。你的眼睛怎么了？

lines.en: Evilana "accidentally" hit me. And she didn't even say sorry. She's so mean!
lines.zh: 伊维拉娜“不小心”打了我。她连声对不起都没说。她太刻薄了！

lines.en: I told you so.
lines.zh: 我早就跟你说过。

lines.en: Here, Pete. Put on this headband. You'll feel better. Penelope, you're right. Evilana is an awful person!
lines.zh: 给，皮特，戴上这个头箍，你会感觉好点。佩内洛普，你说得对。伊维拉娜是个糟糕的人！

lines.en: And violent. And now we have to work with her!
lines.zh: 还很暴力。现在我们还得跟她一起工作！

lines.en: Haven't you heard? She's gone! She was given another assignment.
lines.zh: 你没听说吗？她走了！她被派去做别的任务了。

lines.en: What assignment?
lines.zh: 什么任务？

lines.en: I'm not sure. I think it has something to do with outdoors. Anyway, let's play! Pete it's your turn.
lines.zh: 我不太确定。好像跟户外有关。不管了，我们玩吧！皮特，该你了。

qs.q: What does the article say?
opts: Someone in the world looks just like you.
qs.a: Someone in the world looks just like you.
qs.why: "Somewhere in the world there is someone who looks just like you."

qs.q: How is Evilana different from Anna?
qs.why: "She's mean."

qs.q: What happened to Pete's eye?
qs.why: "Evilana 'accidentally' hit me."

lessons.title: Fish out of Water
lessons.zh: 离水之鱼：非正式邀请

lines.en: Hello, Ms. Weaver!
lines.zh: 你好，韦弗女士！

lines.en: Oh, Anna. I've invited some people to dinner Saturday. We're going to that new seafood restaurant -- Fish on a Dish.
lines.zh: 哦，安娜。我请了几个人周六吃晚饭。我们去那家新开的海鲜餐厅——“盘中鱼”。

lines.en: Why don't you join us? My treat.
lines.zh: 你也一起来吧？我请客。

lines.en: Thanks, Ms. Weaver. But I already have plans. My friend has invited me to her houseboat.
lines.zh: 谢谢您，韦弗女士。可我已经有安排了。我朋友请我去她的船屋。

lines.en: Houseboat, really? That's unique.
lines.zh: 船屋，真的？真特别。

lines.en: Yes, it is. In fact, I'm thinking of living on a houseboat.
lines.zh: 是啊。其实我在考虑住到船屋上。

lines.en: Aren't you too tall and klutzy to live on a houseboat?
lines.zh: 你个子那么高，又笨手笨脚的，住船屋不太合适吧？

lines.en: I am not too tall!
lines.zh: 我才没那么高！

lines.en: (She knocks over a display board.)
lines.zh: （她碰倒了一块展示板。）

lines.en: Is Anna really ready for a houseboat?
lines.zh: 安娜真的准备好住船屋了吗？

lines.en: Ms. Weaver invited Anna to dinner. When we make friendly, informal invitations, we use phrases like "Why don't…?"
lines.zh: 韦弗女士邀请安娜吃晚饭。发出友好、非正式的邀请时，我们用“Why don't…?”这样的说法。

lines.en: For example, Ms. Weaver said, "Why don't you join us? My treat!" That's: Why don't plus the subject plus the simple form of the verb.
lines.zh: 比如，韦弗女士说：“Why don't you join us? My treat!”结构是：Why don't + 主语 + 动词原形。

lines.en: Anna responded to the invitation by saying, "Thanks, but I already have plans." Keep watching for more examples of informal invitations!
lines.zh: 安娜回应邀请时说：“Thanks, but I already have plans.”（谢谢，不过我已经有安排了。）继续看，找更多非正式邀请的例子！

lines.en: Anna, I'm so glad you could come!
lines.zh: 安娜，你能来我太高兴了！

lines.en: Hi, Fanny!
lines.zh: 嗨，范妮！

lines.en: Hi, this is my son, Phoenix.
lines.zh: 嗨，这是我儿子菲尼克斯。

lines.en: Hi, Phoenix.
lines.zh: 嗨，菲尼克斯。

lines.en: How about you give Anna a tour and I will make some lunch?
lines.zh: 你带安娜参观一下，我来做午饭，怎么样？

lines.en: Aye, aye, captain!
lines.zh: 遵命，船长！

lines.en: Great!
lines.zh: 太好了！

lines.en: Do you really call her "captain"?
lines.zh: 你真的叫她“船长”？

lines.en: I kind of have to.
lines.zh: 算是不得不这么叫吧。

lines.en: So, Phoenix, I think I'd like to live on a houseboat. Do you like living here?
lines.zh: 那么，菲尼克斯，我觉得我想住船屋。你喜欢住在这儿吗？

lines.en: I love it! It's much different than living in a house.
lines.zh: 我爱住这儿！这和住在房子里很不一样。

lines.en: Oh, I bet. I bet you had to get rid of a lot of stuff, didn't you?
lines.zh: 哦，我猜也是。我猜你们得扔掉很多东西吧？

lines.en: No way! We moved from a 3-story house to a boat! So, we really had to downsize!
lines.zh: 可不是！我们从一栋三层的房子搬到一条船上！所以真的得精简！

lines.en: I'd have to get rid of a lot of stuff. I have a rock collection and I have some really big rocks.
lines.zh: 我得扔掉很多东西。我有个石头收藏，有些石头特别大。

lines.en: Can you stop this boat from rocking for a minute?
lines.zh: 你能让这条船停一会儿别晃吗？

lines.en: No. We're floating on water. I can't do that.
lines.zh: 不能。我们漂在水上，我做不到。

lines.en: Well, since you live on the water, aren't you afraid of great white sharks?
lines.zh: 嗯，既然你住在水上，你不怕大白鲨吗？

lines.en: No, not really. They don't live in these waters.
lines.zh: 不怎么怕。这片水域里没有大白鲨。

lines.en: … that you know of. What about killer whales?
lines.zh: ……据你所知没有。那虎鲸呢？

lines.en: No.
lines.zh: 没有。

lines.en: Electric eels?
lines.zh: 电鳗呢？

lines.en: No.
lines.zh: 没有。

lines.en: Barracudas?
lines.zh: 梭子鱼呢？

lines.en: No.
lines.zh: 没有。

lines.en: Piranhas?
lines.zh: 食人鱼呢？

lines.en: Uh-uh.
lines.zh: 没有。

lines.en: You know, Anna, if you're afraid of sea life, maybe you shouldn't live on a houseboat. Do you have any boating experience?
lines.zh: 你知道吗，安娜，如果你怕海洋生物，也许你不该住船屋。你有坐船的经验吗？

lines.en: Oh, oh yeah, Fanny. I have battled the great waters before -- once on a swan boat and once in a duck boat ... bus. It was a boat that turned into a bus.
lines.zh: 哦，哦，有啊，范妮。我以前和大水搏斗过——一次是坐天鹅船，一次是坐鸭子船……巴士。那是一条能变成巴士的船。

lines.en: Yeah, I don't think that counts.
lines.zh: 嗯，我觉得那不算。

lines.en: Fanny, does this rocking ever bother you?
lines.zh: 范妮，这么晃你不难受吗？

lines.en: No, I love it. It goes up and down and side to side and up and down. Anna, I love it!
lines.zh: 不难受，我爱这种感觉。上上下下，左左右右，上上下下。安娜，我爱死了！

lines.en: (Because of the rocking, Anna begins to feel seasick.)
lines.zh: （因为摇晃，安娜开始晕船。）

lines.en: Anna, are you feeling okay?
lines.zh: 安娜，你还好吗？

lines.en: Yeah, yeah. You know, I just need some fresh air.
lines.zh: 还好，还好。你知道吗，我只是需要点新鲜空气。

lines.en: Let me open a window for you.
lines.zh: 我给你开扇窗。

lines.en: No, I need some fresh land air. I mean, I need to breathe air on land. Oh, is that the time? I should really be going.
lines.zh: 不用，我需要陆地上的新鲜空气。我是说，我需要在陆地上呼吸空气。哦，都这个时间了？我真该走了。

lines.en: Thanks for lunch, Fanny, and a tour of your houseboat. It's given me a great idea!
lines.zh: 谢谢你的午饭，范妮，也谢谢你带我参观船屋。它给了我一个好主意！

lines.en: You're going to live on a houseboat?
lines.zh: 你要住船屋了？

lines.en: Sort of. Thanks again!
lines.zh: 算是吧。再次感谢！

lines.en: Hi! How would you like to hang out on my boat? Great! See you then!
lines.zh: 嗨！要不要来我的船上玩？太好了！到时见！

lines.en: (Ms. Weaver and Anna sit in a boat on land.)
lines.zh: （韦弗女士和安娜坐在陆地上的一条船里。）

lines.en: …and this is my shark net.
lines.zh: ……这是我的防鲨网。

lines.en: Thank you for the invitation, Anna.
lines.zh: 谢谢你的邀请，安娜。

lines.en: Of course, would you like more orange juice?
lines.zh: 不客气，还要点橙汁吗？

lines.en: Uh..
(to young man) Ahoy!
lines.zh: （对年轻人）喂——！

qs.q: Where does Anna's friend live?
qs.why: "My friend has invited me to her houseboat."

qs.q: How do we make a friendly, informal invitation?
qs.why: Why don't + 主语 + 动词原形。

qs.q: Why does Anna leave the houseboat?
qs.why: "Anna begins to feel seasick."

lessons.title: For the Birds
lessons.zh: 给鸟儿的：be supposed to、have to、ought to

lines.en: Oh, Anna, there you are! I am so glad we joined the Great City Bird Count! Aren't you?
lines.zh: 哦，安娜，你在这儿！我真高兴我们参加了“城市观鸟大统计”！你不高兴吗？

lines.en: No. Today has been a bust … a flop … a bummer!
lines.zh: 不高兴。今天真是失败……泡汤……扫兴！

lines.en: I'm sensing a little disappointment.
lines.zh: 我感觉到你有点失望。

lines.en: A little?
lines.zh: 有点？

lines.en: My official bird-watching form is almost full!
lines.zh: 我的正式观鸟表快填满了！

lines.en: I've only seen pigeons ... lots and lots of pigeons! But I did write down some other valuable information.
lines.zh: 我只看到了鸽子……好多好多鸽子！不过我确实记下了一些别的有价值的信息。

lines.en: Did you find a bird's nest?!
lines.zh: 你找到鸟窝了吗？！

lines.en: No.
lines.zh: 没有。

lines.en: (She shows Kelly a map of ice cream trucks.)
lines.zh: （她给凯莉看一张冰淇淋车分布图。）

lines.en: I found 10 ice cream trucks in this five-block area.​ Their music seems to follow me everywhere.
lines.zh: 我在这五个街区里找到了 10 辆冰淇淋车。它们的音乐好像走到哪儿都跟着我。

lines.en: We're supposed to be counting birds, not ice cream trucks. This is important scientific work!
lines.zh: 我们应该数鸟，不是数冰淇淋车。这是重要的科学工作！

lines.en: Well, when you want ice cream, my data will be pretty important.
lines.zh: 嗯，等你想吃冰淇淋的时候，我的数据就很重要了。

lines.en: Anna, birds are everywhere! I'm sure you'll find something. Use your imagination! But, make sure that you put it on the official form.
lines.zh: 安娜，鸟到处都是！我相信你会找到的。发挥你的想象力！不过一定要记在正式表格上。

lines.en: (Anna walks away with her ice cream truck map.)
lines.zh: （安娜拿着冰淇淋车地图走开了。）

lines.en: Anna was supposed to find birds, but she didn't.
lines.zh: 安娜本该找鸟，可她没找。

lines.en: Kelly says, "We're supposed to be counting birds, not ice cream trucks." To be supposed to means you are expected to do something.
lines.zh: 凯莉说：“We're supposed to be counting birds, not ice cream trucks.”be supposed to 表示别人期望你做某事。

lines.en: It's different from have to and ought to. Have to means you must do something. And ought to means you should do it but you don't have to.
lines.zh: have to 和 ought to 不一样。have to 表示你必须做某事；ought to 表示你应该做，但不是非做不可。

lines.en: Keep watching for have to and ought to!
lines.zh: 继续看，注意 have to 和 ought to！

lines.en: (Anna looks through binoculars but doesn't see birds. She talks to herself.)
lines.zh: （安娜用望远镜看，可没看到鸟。她自言自语。）

lines.en: No birds. Oh wait, there's another ice cream truck! Anna, focus on birds. Aw, but that truck has my favorite flavor ... banana!
lines.zh: 没有鸟。哦等等，又一辆冰淇淋车！安娜，专心找鸟。噢，可那辆车有我最爱的口味……香蕉！

lines.en: That man is in the way. I can't see the price. I wonder what flavor he's getting.
lines.zh: 那个男人挡住了，我看不见价格。不知道他买的什么口味。

lines.en: Strawberry? He doesn't seem like a strawberry kind of guy.
lines.zh: 草莓？他看起来不像爱吃草莓的人。

lines.en: In fact, he doesn't seem like an ice cream truck kind of guy. That suit looks expensive.
lines.zh: 其实，他看起来就不像会去冰淇淋车买东西的人。那套西装看着很贵。

lines.en: Maybe he's a spy! You know what that means: The ice cream truck driver is a spy, too!
lines.zh: 也许他是个间谍！你知道这意味着什么：冰淇淋车司机也是间谍！

lines.en: Genius! It's a perfect disguise.
lines.zh: 天才！这是完美的伪装。

lines.en: What?! The man in the suit left his briefcase at the ice cream truck!
lines.zh: 什么？！那个穿西装的男人把公文包落在冰淇淋车那儿了！

lines.en: I was right! He is a spy! And, he just dropped off top-secret information! I ought to do something. Something needs to be done! I need to do something.
lines.zh: 我说对了！他是间谍！他刚刚放下了绝密情报！我应该做点什么。必须有人做点什么！我得做点什么。

lines.en: (Anna runs to the ice cream truck and takes the briefcase.)
lines.zh: （安娜跑到冰淇淋车那儿，拿走了公文包。）

lines.en: I did it! I took the spy's briefcase!
lines.zh: 我做到了！我拿到了间谍的公文包！

lines.en: What's that?! The ice cream truck -- it's following me! It wants the case back! I have to hide.
lines.zh: 那是什么？！冰淇淋车——它在跟踪我！它想把箱子要回去！我得躲起来。

lines.en: (She runs and hides behind a tree.)
lines.zh: （她跑到一棵树后面躲起来。）

lines.en: This is my life now -- running, scared, alone.
lines.zh: 这就是我现在的生活——逃跑、害怕、孤身一人。

lines.en: (She runs to another tree.)
lines.zh: （她跑到另一棵树后。）

lines.en: That awful music -- it's following me everywhere!
lines.zh: 那可怕的音乐——到哪儿都跟着我！

lines.en: (The man sees her at the tree.)
lines.zh: （男人在树旁看到了她。）

lines.en: Hey! You found my briefcase.
lines.zh: 嘿！你找到我的公文包了。

lines.en: You caught me! I mean, I caught you!
lines.zh: 你被我抓住了！我是说，我抓住你了！

lines.en: Well, I just want my briefcase. All my poems are in there.
lines.zh: 嗯，我只想要回我的公文包。我的诗都在里面。

lines.en: Poems? You're a poet?
lines.zh: 诗？你是诗人？

lines.en: Well, I'm a lawyer. But I write poems, too.
lines.zh: 嗯，我是律师。不过我也写诗。

lines.en: (Anna gives the man his briefcase.)
lines.zh: （安娜把公文包还给男人。）

lines.en: So, you're not a spy?
lines.zh: 那你不是间谍？

lines.en: You look disappointed.
lines.zh: 你看起来很失望。

lines.en: No, that's okay. It's not your fault. Poems are nice, too. I guess.
lines.zh: 不，没关系。这不怪你。诗也挺好的。大概吧。

lines.en: Well, would you like me to read my latest one?
lines.zh: 那，你想听我读最新的一首吗？

lines.en: Why not?
lines.zh: 为什么不呢？

lines.en: On sunny day walks, my hand reaches for ice cream from fragaria.
lines.zh: 阳光明媚散步时，我的手伸向“fragaria”冰淇淋。（fragaria 是草莓的学名）

lines.en: I love your poem!
lines.zh: 我爱你的诗！

lines.en: I love ice cream.
lines.zh: 我爱冰淇淋。

lines.en: Me too.
lines.zh: 我也是。

lines.en: What's your favorite flavor?
lines.zh: 你最爱什么口味？

lines.en: Banana.
lines.zh: 香蕉。

lines.en: Well, my favorite flavor is ...
lines.zh: 嗯，我最爱的口味是……

lines.en: Strawberry!
lines.zh: 草莓！

lines.en: How did you know that?
lines.zh: 你怎么知道的？

lines.en: A little bird told me.
lines.zh: 一只小鸟告诉我的。

qs.q: What did Anna count instead of birds?
qs.why: "I found 10 ice cream trucks."

qs.q: What is in the man's briefcase?
qs.why: "All my poems are in there."

qs.q: What does "be supposed to" mean?
opts: You are expected to do something.
qs.a: You are expected to do something.
qs.why: "To be supposed to means you are expected to do something."

lessons.title: Where There's Smoke...
lessons.zh: 无风不起浪：条件句与火灾应急用语

lines.en: Hey, Anna. What are you reading?
lines.zh: 嘿，安娜。你在看什么？

lines.en: I'm reading about fire safety. Ms. Weaver named me fire safety monitor.
lines.zh: 我在看消防安全知识。韦弗女士任命我当消防安全员。

lines.en: But the only time we have a fire emergency is when someone burns a piece of toast.
lines.zh: 可我们唯一一次火警，是有人把吐司烤焦了。

lines.en: That is true. But fire safety is very serious – very serious. If there is a fire emergency, I have to help everyone out of the building.
lines.zh: 那倒是。可消防安全非常严肃——非常严肃。如果发生火灾，我得帮大家撤出大楼。

lines.en: Well then, if I were you, I'd learn as much as possible.
lines.zh: 那如果我是你，我会尽量多学点。

lines.en: You're right. And I know just who to call!
lines.zh: 你说得对。我知道该找谁！

lines.en: Hmm, I wonder where Anna's going. Today we are reviewing conditionals and learning helpful language for emergencies.
lines.zh: 嗯，不知道安娜要去哪儿。今天我们复习条件句，并学一些紧急情况下有用的说法。

lines.en: If Anna studies hard, she'll be a great fire safety monitor! That's a conditional. It uses "if" to show that something is true only when something else is true.
lines.zh: 如果安娜努力学习，她会成为很棒的消防安全员！这就是一个条件句。它用 if 表示某件事只有在另一件事成立时才成立。

lines.en: Let's find out where Anna is going. And if you want to learn fire emergency language, keep watching!
lines.zh: 我们来看看安娜去哪儿。如果你想学火灾应急用语，就继续看吧！

lines.en: (Two firefighters welcome Anna to their firehouse.)
lines.zh: （两位消防员欢迎安娜来到消防站。）

lines.en: Hi, Firefighter Jones.
lines.zh: 嗨，琼斯消防员。

lines.en: Hey, how are you, Anna?
lines.zh: 嘿，你好吗，安娜？

lines.en: I'm well, thanks. How are you? Hi, Firefighter Hatcher.
lines.zh: 我很好，谢谢。你呢？嗨，哈彻消防员。

lines.en: Hi, Anna. How are you?
lines.zh: 嗨，安娜。你好吗？

lines.en: I'm well, thanks.
lines.zh: 我很好，谢谢。

lines.en: Welcome to our firehouse.
lines.zh: 欢迎来到我们消防站。

lines.en: Thank you.
lines.zh: 谢谢。

lines.en: Come on in.
lines.zh: 请进。

lines.en: Thanks.
lines.zh: 谢谢。

lines.en: This is where the firefighters eat. This is where we rest. This is where we exercise. This is where the firetrucks are parked and maintained.
lines.zh: 这是消防员吃饭的地方，这是我们休息的地方，这是我们锻炼的地方，这是消防车停放和保养的地方。

lines.en: This place is beautiful.
lines.zh: 这地方真漂亮。

lines.en: You know, the firehouse is a firefighter's second home.
lines.zh: 你知道吗，消防站是消防员的第二个家。

lines.en: Firefighter Jones, Firefighter Hatcher: Can you tell me some ways to prepare for a fire emergency?
lines.zh: 琼斯消防员、哈彻消防员：能告诉我一些应对火灾的准备方法吗？

lines.en: Sure, Anna. There's one really important thing you can do: Install a fire alarm. Test it monthly and make sure the batteries are fully charged.
lines.zh: 当然，安娜。有一件非常重要的事你可以做：安装火灾报警器。每月测试一次，确保电池电量充足。

lines.en: Let's talk about those emergency exits.
lines.zh: 我们说说紧急出口吧。

lines.en: In your home, office and schools, know where your emergency exits are located.
lines.zh: 在家里、办公室和学校，都要知道紧急出口在哪里。

lines.en: What about fire extinguishers?
lines.zh: 灭火器呢？

lines.en: Everyone should know how to use a fire extinguisher. Have one handy and practice using it.
lines.zh: 每个人都应该会用灭火器。放一个在手边，并练习使用。

lines.en: What if we need to get out?
lines.zh: 如果我们需要撤离呢？

lines.en: You should have an evacuation plan. And practice getting out safely with fire drills.
lines.zh: 你应该有一个疏散计划，并通过消防演习练习安全撤离。

lines.en: If I am in a building and it's on fire, should I use the elevator?
lines.zh: 如果我在一栋着火的大楼里，应该坐电梯吗？

lines.en: No. Always use the stairs.
lines.zh: 不。一定要走楼梯。

lines.en: What other safety tips should I know?
lines.zh: 我还应该知道哪些安全提示？

lines.en: Stay low. Smoke rises. The air is clearer close to the ground.
lines.zh: 保持低姿态。烟会往上升，靠近地面的空气更干净。

lines.en: Stay low. Anything else?
lines.zh: 保持低姿态。还有吗？

lines.en: If you touch a door and it's hot, don't open it. There might be a fire on the other side.
lines.zh: 如果你摸到一扇门是烫的，不要打开。门的另一边可能着火了。

lines.en: What do I do if my clothes catch on fire?
lines.zh: 如果我的衣服着火了怎么办？

lines.en: Do not run. If you run, the fire will burn faster. You must stop, drop and roll.
lines.zh: 不要跑。如果你跑，火会烧得更快。你必须停下、卧倒、打滚。

lines.en: Thanks so much! I've learned a lot. And I can't wait to share this information with others.
lines.zh: 太感谢了！我学到了很多。我等不及要把这些分享给别人了。

lines.en: Thanks for coming, Anna.
lines.zh: 谢谢你来，安娜。

lines.en: It's been a pleasure meeting you.
lines.zh: 很高兴认识你。

lines.en: (Anna is back at the office talking to Penelope.)
lines.zh: （安娜回到办公室，和佩内洛普聊天。）

lines.en: So, Anna, how was the visit to the fire station?
lines.zh: 那么，安娜，参观消防站怎么样？

lines.en: I learned a lot! And firefighters have a very difficult job.
lines.zh: 我学到了好多！消防员的工作真的很艰难。

lines.en: Do you smell smoke?
lines.zh: 你闻到烟味了吗？

lines.en: No. So, like I was saying, I learned how to …
lines.zh: 没有。就像我刚才说的，我学会了怎么……

lines.en: Anna, I smell smoke.
lines.zh: 安娜，我闻到烟味了。

lines.en: If you smell smoke, call the fire department!
lines.zh: 如果你闻到烟味，就打电话叫消防队！

lines.en: (Anna begins to evacuate her coworkers.)
lines.zh: （安娜开始疏散同事。）

lines.en: If you smell smoke, get out of the building. Come on people, we have a fire emergency! Leave your things and evacuate calmly and quickly. Very good. Very good.
lines.zh: 如果闻到烟味，就离开大楼。大家快，我们遇到火灾了！别管东西，冷静快速地撤离。很好，很好。

lines.en: We have a fire emergency. No, take the stairs Let's get out. Let's get out safely.
lines.zh: 我们遇到火灾了。不，走楼梯。我们出去。安全地出去。

lines.en: (Anna and coworkers stand outside of the building.)
lines.zh: （安娜和同事们站在大楼外面。）

lines.en: We got out in less than 6 minutes! Good job, people! Wait. Where's Pete?
lines.zh: 我们不到 6 分钟就出来了！大家做得好！等等，皮特呢？

lines.en: I know where he is. I'll go get him.
lines.zh: 我知道他在哪儿。我去叫他。

lines.en: No! Never go back into a burning building! The fire department is coming. Stay calm, Pete. Help is on the way! Help is on the way!
lines.zh: 不！永远不要回到着火的大楼里！消防队马上就到。保持冷静，皮特。救援马上就到！救援马上就到！

qs.q: Should you use the elevator in a fire?
qs.why: "No. Always use the stairs."

qs.q: Why should you stay low in a fire?
opts: Smoke rises; the air is clearer near the ground.
qs.a: Smoke rises; the air is clearer near the ground.
qs.why: "Smoke rises. The air is clearer close to the ground."

qs.q: What should you do if your clothes catch on fire?
qs.why: "You must stop, drop and roll."

lessons.title: Dream a Little Dream
lessons.zh: 追梦：第二级大结局

lines.en: Anna, where are you going in such a hurry?
lines.zh: 安娜，你急急忙忙去哪儿？

lines.en: Hi, Ashley. The nurse's office. Today I get the results from my blood test.
lines.zh: 嗨，阿什莉。去医务室。今天我去拿验血结果。

lines.en: I'm sure you're fine. Don't worry.
lines.zh: 你肯定没事的。别担心。

lines.en: You know, I used to dream of being a nurse. It is such an honorable career. Is there something you've dreamed of doing?
lines.zh: 你知道吗，我以前梦想当护士。那是很光荣的职业。你有没有梦想过做什么？

lines.en: Sure! I would love to be a dog trainer. Actually, I've taught my dog, Dublin, lots of tricks!
lines.zh: 当然！我很想当驯狗师。其实，我已经教会我的狗都柏林好多把戏了！

lines.en: Well, I'm off to the nurse. Bye, Ashley.
lines.zh: 好了，我去医务室了。拜拜，阿什莉。

lines.en: Bye, Anna.
lines.zh: 拜拜，安娜。

lines.en: Bye, Dublin.
lines.zh: 拜拜，都柏林。

lines.en: (Anna stands near the nurse's office and listens to her phone call.)
lines.zh: （安娜站在医务室门口，听到护士在打电话。）

lines.en: I'm looking at her test results and they're not good. In fact, I'm afraid she's not going to make it.
lines.zh: 我在看她的检查结果，不太好。说实话，恐怕她挺不过去了。

lines.en: What?! I'm not going to make it? I'm dying??
lines.zh: 什么？！我挺不过去了？我要死了？？

lines.en: Anna, come in. How are you?
lines.zh: 安娜，进来吧。你好吗？

lines.en: I guess..not so good. I'm dying!?
lines.zh: 我想……不太好。我要死了！？

lines.en: What are you talking about?
lines.zh: 你在说什么？

lines.en: I just heard you on the phone. Just tell me: How much longer do I have?
lines.zh: 我刚才听到你打电话了。直接告诉我吧：我还有多久？

lines.en: I wasn't talking about you. A student of mine didn't do well on her science test. So, she won't be able to make it ... to graduation.
lines.zh: 我说的不是你。我的一个学生科学考试没考好，所以她没法……顺利毕业（make it to graduation）。

lines.en: Whew. Thank goodness! For a minute, my whole life passed before my eyes. There are so many things I haven't done yet.
lines.zh: 呼。谢天谢地！刚才那一分钟，我的一生都在眼前闪过。还有好多事我都没做过呢。

lines.en: Well, life is short. It's important to do something you love every day.
lines.zh: 嗯，人生苦短。每天做点自己热爱的事很重要。

lines.en: I couldn't agree more.
lines.zh: 我太同意了。

lines.en: Now, let's talk about your blood test. Your cholesterol is really low.
lines.zh: 好了，我们来说说你的验血结果。你的胆固醇很低。

lines.en: Awesome!
lines.zh: 太棒了！

lines.en: (Next, Anna is sitting in a sound studio with Jonathan.)
lines.zh: （接着，安娜和乔纳森坐在录音棚里。）

lines.en: Okay, Anna, say something and I'll check your sound level.
lines.zh: 好，安娜，说句话，我来测一下你的音量。

lines.en: Testing 1, 2, 3. Testing. Jonathan, I've been wondering something: What's at the top of your bucket list?
lines.zh: 测试 1、2、3。测试。乔纳森，我一直想问：你人生愿望清单上排第一的是什么？

lines.en: That's easy. I'd love to win the World Karaoke Contest.
lines.zh: 这个简单。我很想赢得世界卡拉 OK 大赛。

lines.en: This is so strange. I just saw on Twitter that they are having auditions in D.C. this weekend!
lines.zh: 太巧了。我刚在推特上看到，他们这个周末在华盛顿举行海选！

lines.en: Are you serious? Can you read the story by yourself?
lines.zh: 你说真的？你能自己读这篇稿子吗？

lines.en: Sure, absolutely.
lines.zh: 当然，没问题。

lines.en: Thanks!
lines.zh: 谢谢！

lines.en: You go.
lines.zh: 你去吧。

lines.en: (Anna goes outside and talks to Penelope.)
lines.zh: （安娜走到外面和佩内洛普说话。）

lines.en: Penelope, I was wondering if you still dream of being a dancer.
lines.zh: 佩内洛普，我想问你是不是还梦想当舞蹈演员。

lines.en: Only every day!
lines.zh: 每天都在梦想！

lines.en: Well, guess what: A famous dancer is having a flash mob around the corner! Hundreds of people are dancing together!
lines.zh: 嗯，你猜怎么着：一位著名舞者正在街角组织快闪！几百个人一起跳舞！

lines.en: No way!
lines.zh: 不会吧！

lines.en: Way! If you leave right now, you can join them! Bye!
lines.zh: 真的！你现在就走，还能加入他们！拜拜！

lines.en: (Anna then sits with Pete in the office kitchen.)
lines.zh: （安娜接着和皮特坐在办公室茶水间。）

lines.en: Pete, what's one of your dreams?
lines.zh: 皮特，你有什么梦想？

lines.en: Well, last night I dreamt I was in a spaceship. I was flying through outer space with these two beautiful...
lines.zh: 嗯，昨晚我梦见自己在一艘宇宙飞船里，和两个美丽的……一起在外太空飞……

lines.en: Pete -- not that kind of dream. I mean your hopes for the future.
lines.zh: 皮特——不是那种梦。我是说你对未来的希望。

lines.en: Oh. I plan on selling my book to Hollywood and becoming rich and famous.
lines.zh: 哦。我打算把我的书卖给好莱坞，然后名利双收。

lines.en: That's going to be difficult.
lines.zh: 那会很难。

lines.en: It's my agent! Hello? Uh-huh. Sure! I can be in Los Angeles tomorrow!
lines.zh: 是我的经纪人！喂？嗯嗯。当然！我明天就能到洛杉矶！

lines.en: Well, good job, Anna! My work here is done … almost.
lines.zh: 好了，干得好，安娜！我在这儿的工作完成了……差不多。

lines.en: (Music plays as Anna talks to many more coworkers)
lines.zh: （音乐响起，安娜又和许多同事聊了起来）

lines.en: You can search but you won't find the answer without a dream. You can reach for the stars but you won't get there without a dream...without a dream.
lines.zh: 你可以去寻找，可没有梦想你找不到答案。你可以伸手摘星，可没有梦想你到不了那里……没有梦想。

lines.en: (Then, Anna is sitting at her work desk.)
lines.zh: （然后，安娜坐在自己的办公桌前。）

lines.en: Anna, what's going on? Where is everybody?
lines.zh: 安娜，怎么回事？大家都去哪儿了？

lines.en: I don't know. Maybe something is, uh, going around the office.
lines.zh: 我不知道。也许办公室里有什么东西，呃，在传播。

lines.en: You mean germs? Anna, you'd better use some of this hand cleaner. You don't want to get sick, too.
lines.zh: 你是说病菌？安娜，你最好用点这个洗手液。你可不想也生病。

lines.en: Right. Okay, thanks. Not germs – dreams, Ms. Weaver. Dreams.
lines.zh: 对。好的，谢谢。不是病菌——是梦想，韦弗女士。梦想。

lines.en: What did you say, Anna?
lines.zh: 你说什么，安娜？

lines.en: Nothing. Nothing.
lines.zh: 没什么。没什么。

lines.en: We hope you have enjoyed Level 2 of Let's Learn English. Everyone is following their dreams, big and small.
lines.zh: 希望你喜欢《一起学英语》第二级。每个人都在追逐自己的梦想，无论大小。

lines.en: What are your dreams? Our dream is for you to keep learning English! Thanks for watching.
lines.zh: 你的梦想是什么？我们的梦想是你继续学英语！感谢收看。

qs.q: Was the nurse talking about Anna?
qs.why: "I wasn't talking about you. A student of mine…"

qs.q: What is Jonathan's dream?
opts: to win the World Karaoke Contest
qs.a: to win the World Karaoke Contest
qs.why: "I'd love to win the World Karaoke Contest."

qs.q: Why is the office empty?
qs.why: "Not germs – dreams."
